# ReqIF Requirements Engineering & Formal Verification

ModelScript delivers first-class support for **ReqIF** (Requirements Interchange Format, OMG ReqIF 1.0/1.2), the global standard for exchanging structured requirements across aerospace, automotive (ISO 26262), and medical device systems. ModelScript elevates requirements from dead documentation into **computable digital contracts** verifiable against physics simulations and architectural constraints.

---

## Capabilities & Supported Formats

| Format                       | Extension         | Description                                                                                                                  |
| :--------------------------- | :---------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **OMG ReqIF XML Document**   | `.reqif`, `.xml`  | XML document defining specification types, spec-objects, hierarchical spec-relations, data types, and attribute definitions. |
| **ReqIF Compressed Archive** | `.reqifz`, `.zip` | Zip archive packaging `.reqif` manifests alongside embedded media, diagrams, and attachments.                                |

### Key Architectural Features

- **Full OMG ReqIF 1.2 Ingestion & Roundtrip:**
  - Robust XML reader and serializer preserving internal identifiers (`IDENTIFIER`), specification hierarchies, multi-level parent-child relations, and custom attribute types (String, Integer, Real, Boolean, Date, Enumeration).
- **Formal Contract Extraction:**
  - Automatically parses mathematical constraints from natural language requirement text (e.g. `latency <= 50 ms`, `pressure >= 15 bar`, `temp in [20, 80] C`).
- **Nelson-Oppen Mathematical Entailment Prover:**
  - Uses the SMT/Nelson-Oppen theory coordinator in `@modelscript/runtime` to prove whether child sub-requirements strictly entail parent system-level requirements:
    $$\bigwedge_{i} \text{SubReq}_i \models \text{ParentReq}$$
  - Generates concrete numeric counterexamples when an entailment gap exists (e.g. child requirements permit a state that violates the parent requirement).
- **Bidirectional Tabular Editor & 2D Traceability Matrix (`@modelscript/reqif/tabular`):**
  - Powered by `@modelscript/dsl`'s declarative `TabularConfig`, ReqIF specifications project into 4 synchronized, bidirectional sheets:
    1. **Requirements Catalog Tree-Table:** Hierarchical WBS (`SPEC-HIERARCHY`) with collapsible sections, inline cell editing for titles, specification text, formal mathematical contracts (`<= 2.5 %`), ISO 26262 ASIL levels, lifecycle status, custom `SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE` attributes, and live Nelson-Oppen SMT entailment badges (`Certified`, `Gap`, `Leaf`).
    2. **2D Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM):** Interactive $N \times M$ cross-reference matrix where clicking any cell cycles `<SPEC-RELATION>` links (`satisfies`, `verifies`, `refines`, `allocates`, `derives`, `conflicts`) and writes back losslessly to the ReqIF XML.
    3. **Spec Relations Table:** Editable table of all `<SPEC-RELATION>` links with inline source, target, and relation stereotype selectors.
    4. **Types & Schema Explorer:** Inspects `<DATATYPES>`, enumeration values, and `<SPEC-TYPES>` attribute definitions.
- **2D Requirement Architecture Diagram (`@modelscript/reqif/diagram`):**
  - Renders hierarchical requirement cards color-coded by ISO 26262 ASIL level, formal contract compartments, SMT entailment badges, parent-child decomposition edges, and typed `SPEC-RELATION` dependency arrows.
- **Automated Verification Projections:**
  - **OMG SysML v2:** Translates spec-objects into formal `requirement def` items with `doc` annotations, attribute definitions, and `satisfy` links.
  - **Modelica Verification Blocks:** Generates acausal Modelica monitor blocks with assertions that trigger simulation failure when requirement bounds are breached.
- **Requirements Linters (`M7001`–`M7008`):**
  - Detects dangling requirement relations, circular requirement hierarchies, unbounded safety contracts on ASIL requirements, and missing mandatory attributes.

---

## Command Line Interface (`msx reqif`)

```bash
msx reqif <action> [files...] [options]
```

| Action            | Description                                                                        | Key Options            |
| :---------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :--------------------- |
| **`import`**      | Parses a ReqIF 1.2 document and prints requirements, hierarchy, and relations.     | `--format table\|json` |
| **`export`**      | Exports SysML v2 requirements into ReqIF 1.2 XML.                                  | `--output`, `--title`  |
| **`lint`**        | Runs structural consistency checks, link validation, and safety contract analysis. | —                      |
| **`verify`**      | Runs Nelson-Oppen formal entailment proofs across requirement hierarchies.         | —                      |
| **`to-sysml`**    | Projects ReqIF specifications into OMG SysML v2 requirement definitions.           | `--out=<file.sysml>`   |
| **`to-modelica`** | Generates Modelica assertion blocks for in-simulation verification.                | `--out=<file.mo>`      |

### Examples

```bash
# Import requirement specifications and hierarchies
msx reqif import SystemRequirements.reqif

# Run pre-flight linting on ASIL safety requirements
msx reqif lint BrakeSafetyRequirements.reqif

# Formally prove requirement hierarchy entailment with SMT counterexample generation
msx reqif verify PowertrainContracts.reqif

# Project requirements to SysML v2 definitions
msx reqif to-sysml AvionicsRequirements.reqif --out=AvionicsRequirements.sysml

# Synthesize executable Modelica verification blocks
msx reqif to-modelica ThermalLimits.reqif --out=ThermalMonitors.mo
```

---

# SSP (System Structure and Parameterization)

`@modelscript/ssp` (`languages/ssp`) implements the Modelica Association **SSP 1.0 / 2.0** standard for packaging and coupling Functional Mock-up Units (FMUs) into multi-domain Co-Simulation architectures.

---

## Supported Extensions & Container Architecture

| Extension | Standard Artifact                       | Role                                                                                               |
| :-------- | :-------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.ssp`    | System Structure Package (ZIP archive)  | Container bundling `SystemStructure.ssd`, `resources/*.fmu`, and `*.ssv` parameter sets            |
| `.ssd`    | System Structure Description (XML)      | Hierarchical `System`, `Components`, `Connectors`, `Connections`, and `DefaultExperiment` topology |
| `.ssv`    | System Structure Parameter Values (XML) | Typed parameter bindings (`Real`, `Integer`, `Boolean`, `String`, `Enumeration`)                   |

### Virtual File System (VFS) Archive Extraction

When a `.ssp` ZIP archive is loaded into the workspace, `sspLanguage.container` (`languages/ssp/src/language.ts`) automatically unpacks and indexes its internal artifacts:

- `*.ssd` and `*.ssv` entries are dispatched via `parse_as_language` into the `@modelscript/ssp` CST & Salsa index.
- `resources/*.fmu` archives are recursively extracted (`extract_nested`) so their internal `modelDescription.xml` ports and parameters are cross-checked against `.ssd` connectors.
- Auxiliary tables and binaries under `resources/*` are mounted into the in-memory VFS (`mount_vfs`).

---

## Interactive 2D Diagram Builder & Bidirectional XML Writeback

`languages/ssp/src/diagram.ts` provides a two-way schematic editor for `.ssd` topologies:

- **2D Schematic Extraction (`buildSspDiagramData`)**: Parses `<ssd:System>`, `<ssd:Component>`, `<ssd:Connector>`, `<ssd:Connection>`, and `<ssd:ElementGeometry>` / `<ssd:ConnectionGeometry>` annotations into positioned block nodes, typed causal ports, and orthogonal routing waypoints.
- **Surgical XML Writeback (`applySspDiagramEdits` / `sspLanguage.writeback`)**: Moving components, adding/removing FMU blocks, drawing `<ssd:Connection>` wires, or editing `<ssv:Parameter>` values updates the underlying `.ssd` or `.ssv` XML document in place while preserving namespace prefixes and custom vendor annotations.

---

## Modelica Architecture Projection (`sspToModelicaBlock`)

`sspToModelicaBlock(ssdDoc)` (`languages/ssp/src/index.ts`) projects any `.ssd` system topology into an equivalent composite Modelica `model`, translating `<ssd:Connector>` definitions into `Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.RealInput` / `RealOutput` (or `Integer`/`Boolean` causal interfaces), `<ssd:Component>` blocks into typed sub-models with `<ssv:Parameter>` modifications, and `<ssd:Connection>` edges into `connect(...)` equations.

---

## Semantic Linter & Diagnostic Codes

`lintSsd` and `lintSsv` (`languages/ssp/src/linter.ts`) validate structural, causal, and type soundness across `.ssd` and `.ssv` files with 20 diagnostic codes (13 `SSP_*` + 7 `SSV_*`):

### `.ssd` System Structure Diagnostics (`lintSsd`)

## Command Line Interface (`msx fmu` & `msx cosim`)

ModelScript CLI provides turnkey subcommands for packaging, validating, and co-simulating SSP archives:

```bash
# Validate an FMU or SSP container
msx fmu validate VehicleChassis.fmu

# Simulate an FMU archive directly via SU2, CVODE, or BDF solvers
msx fmu simulate Powertrain.fmu --stop-time=10.0 --step-size=0.001 --format=csv -o output.csv

# Optimize SSP parameter values using differential evolution (CMA-ES, DE, PSO)
msx cosim optimize PlantModel.ssp --params="kp:0.1:10.0,kd:0.01:1.0" --objective="tracking_error"
```

---

## Polyglot TGG Rules

`@modelscript/ssp` registers 8 bidirectional Triple Graph Grammar (TGG) rules in `languages/ssp/src/language.ts`:

# OWL2 Ontology (`.owl`, `.owl2`, `.ofn`, `.ttl`)

`@modelscript/owl2` (`languages/owl2`) brings formal ontological engineering, Description Logic ($\mathcal{SROIQ}(\mathcal{D})$) reasoning, and SPARQL / Leapfrog Triejoin graph querying directly into the ModelScript compiler.

---

## Supported Extensions & Formats

| Extension               | Format                                                             |
| :---------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.owl`, `.owl2`, `.ofn` | W3C OWL 2 Functional-Style Syntax (`Prefix(...)`, `Ontology(...)`) |
| `.ttl`                  | RDF Turtle / Ontological Triple Assertions                         |

---

## OWL 2 DL Axiom & Class Expression Lowering

`lowerCstToAxioms(tree, sourceText)` (`languages/owl2/src/cst-lowering.ts`) lowers the linear-memory CST into an arena-backed `OntologyStore` supporting over 35 OWL 2 DL axiom and class expression constructs:

| Category                                | Supported OWL 2 Functional-Style Constructs                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| :-------------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Declarations**                        | `Declaration(Class(...))`, `Declaration(ObjectProperty(...))`, `Declaration(DataProperty(...))`, `Declaration(NamedIndividual(...))`                                                                                               |
| **Class Axioms**                        | `SubClassOf`, `EquivalentClasses`, `DisjointClasses`                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Boolean & Nominal Class Expressions** | `ObjectIntersectionOf`, `ObjectUnionOf`, `ObjectComplementOf`, `ObjectOneOf`                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Object Property Restrictions**        | `ObjectSomeValuesFrom`, `ObjectAllValuesFrom`, `ObjectHasSelf`, `ObjectHasValue`, `ObjectMinCardinality`, `ObjectMaxCardinality`, `ObjectExactCardinality`                                                                         |
| **Data Property Restrictions**          | `DataSomeValuesFrom`, `DataAllValuesFrom`, `DataMinCardinality`, `DataMaxCardinality`, `DataExactCardinality`                                                                                                                      |
| **Property Hierarchy & Inversion**      | `SubObjectPropertyOf`, `SubDataPropertyOf`, `InverseObjectProperties`, `DisjointObjectProperties`                                                                                                                                  |
| **Property Domains & Ranges**           | `ObjectPropertyDomain`, `ObjectPropertyRange`, `DataPropertyDomain`, `DataPropertyRange`                                                                                                                                           |
| **Property Characteristics**            | `FunctionalObjectProperty`, `InverseFunctionalObjectProperty`, `ReflexiveObjectProperty`, `IrreflexiveObjectProperty`, `SymmetricObjectProperty`, `AsymmetricObjectProperty`, `TransitiveObjectProperty`, `FunctionalDataProperty` |
| **ABox Individual Assertions**          | `ClassAssertion`, `ObjectPropertyAssertion`, `DataPropertyAssertion`, `NegativeObjectPropertyAssertion`, `NegativeDataPropertyAssertion`, `SameIndividual`, `DifferentIndividuals`                                                 |

```lisp
Prefix(:=<http://example.org/spacecraft#>)
Ontology(<http://example.org/spacecraft>
  Declaration(Class(:Thruster))
  Declaration(Class(:Actuator))
  Declaration(ObjectProperty(:mountedOn))
  Declaration(DataProperty(:nominalThrustN))
  SubClassOf(:Thruster :Actuator)
  SubClassOf(:Thruster ObjectSomeValuesFrom(:mountedOn :ReactionControlPod))
  ClassAssertion(:Thruster :RCS_Thruster_A1)
  DataPropertyAssertion(:nominalThrustN :RCS_Thruster_A1 "22.0"^^xsd:double)
)
```

---

## Description Logic Tableau Reasoner & Leapfrog Triejoin

`@modelscript/owl2` includes an in-memory **$\mathcal{SROIQ}(\mathcal{D})$ Tableau Reasoner** (`TableauReasoner` in `languages/owl2/src/reasoner/`) and a worst-case optimal **Leapfrog Triejoin** engine (`executeBGP` in `languages/owl2/src/query/leapfrog.ts`):

1. **Consistency & Satisfiability Checking**: Detects unsatisfiable classes (`DisjointClasses` violations, cardinality contradictions, irreflexive/asymmetric cycles, negative property assertion conflicts) and surfaces exact source diagnostics (`OWL2001`–`OWL2005`).
2. **Justification & Explanation Tracing**: Computes minimal unsatisfiability justifications (`explain_inference`) explaining why a class or individual violates ontology axioms.
3. **SPARQL & Multi-Way BGP Joins**: Evaluates conjunctive Basic Graph Patterns (BGPs) in $O(\text{AGM bound})$ worst-case optimal time without materializing intermediate Cartesian products.

---

## Interactive 2D Ontology Diagram & Bidirectional Writeback

`languages/owl2/src/diagram/` provides an interactive 2D graph visualization and editing surface for OWL 2 ontologies:

- **Visual Graph Projection**: Renders `Class` nodes, `NamedIndividual` instances, `SubClassOf` inheritance hierarchies, and `ObjectPropertyDomain`/`ObjectPropertyRange` directed edges.
- **Bidirectional CST Writeback (`owl2Language.writeback`)**: Adding/deleting nodes or edges in the diagram (`add_node`, `delete_node`, `add_edge`, `delete_edge`, `rename_node`, `update_parameter`) patches the Functional-Style `.owl` source text directly—inserting or removing `Declaration(...)`, `SubClassOf(...)`, or `DataPropertyAssertion(...)` axioms in place.

---

## Dedicated `owl2-mcp` Server Tools

The `@modelscript/owl2` MCP server (`languages/owl2/src/mcp/server.ts`) exposes five specialized tools to AI agents:

| MCP Tool                      | Description                                                                                                                                                                         |
| :---------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `validate_system_consistency` | Parses an OWL 2 Functional Syntax ontology, runs the $\mathcal{SROIQ}$ Tableau Reasoner, and returns consistency status, unsatisfiable classes, and inferred `SubClassOf` hierarchy |
| `query_ontology_sparql`       | Executes a SPARQL `SELECT` `WHERE` query over the ontology's inferred RDF triple graph                                                                                              |
| `query_ontology_bgp`          | Evaluates a conjunctive Basic Graph Pattern (BGP) using the worst-case optimal Leapfrog Triejoin algorithm                                                                          |
| `explain_inference`           | Computes formal axiomatic justifications explaining why an entailment holds or why a class is unsatisfiable                                                                         |
| `trace_fault_propagation`     | Traces transitive fault propagation (`TransitiveObjectProperty` / causal links) from a starting component individual across the system topology                                     |

---

## Polyglot TGG Rules

`@modelscript/owl2` defines 5 bidirectional Triple Graph Grammar (TGG) rules in `languages/owl2/src/language.ts`:

| Rule Name                            | Source (`owl2`)                  | Target Language | Target Construct            |
| :----------------------------------- | :------------------------------- | :-------------- | :-------------------------- |
| `OWL2ClassToSysML2Part`              | `Declaration` (`Class`)          | `sysml2`        | `PartDef`                   |
| `OWL2SubClassToSysML2Specialization` | `SubClassOf`                     | `sysml2`        | `Specialization` (`:>`)     |
| `OWL2ObjectPropertyToSysML2Port`     | `Declaration` (`ObjectProperty`) | `sysml2`        | `PortUsage`                 |
| `OWL2DataPropertyToSysML2Attribute`  | `Declaration` (`DataProperty`)   | `sysml2`        | `AttributeUsage`            |
| `OWL2ClassToModelicaModel`           | `Declaration` (`Class`)          | `modelica`      | `ClassDefinition` (`model`) |

## Command Line Interface (`msx polyglot`)

OWL2 ontologies can be queried, projected, and validated using ModelScript's polyglot digital thread commands:

```bash
# Project OWL 2 DL class hierarchies and axioms into formal SysML v2 part definitions
msx polyglot project SpacecraftOntology.ofn --target=sysml2 -o Spacecraft.sysml

# Cross-query ontology symbols and digital thread twins in the unified Salsa index
msx polyglot query Spacecraft::ReactionControlPod --domain=owl2

# Verify losslessness and critical pair confluence across OWL 2 TGG synchronization rules
msx polyglot verify --strict
```

# STEP (ISO 10303-21)

`@modelscript/step` (`languages/step`) provides a native WebAssembly GLR parser, assembly hierarchy extractor, AP242 Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T / PMI) analyzer, and Modelica MultiBody kinematic synthesizer for ISO 10303-21 Clear Text Encoding of the Exchange Structure (`.step`, `.stp`, `.p21`).

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension               | Standard                           | Scope                                                                                                                      |
| :---------------------- | :--------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.step`, `.stp`, `.p21` | ISO 10303-21 (AP203, AP214, AP242) | B-Rep solid geometry, product assembly trees (`NEXT_ASSEMBLY_USAGE_OCCURRENCE`), kinematic joints, and PMI/GD&T tolerances |

---

## Capabilities

1. **Zero-Dependency STEP Part 21 Parser**: Parses `HEADER;` and `DATA;` sections, `#id = ENTITY_NAME(...)` instances, nested typed parameters, and enumeration tokens into linear memory.
2. **Assembly Hierarchy & Mass Properties (`extractStepAssembly`)**: Extracts `PRODUCT_DEFINITION` parts, `NEXT_ASSEMBLY_USAGE_OCCURRENCE` parent–child assembly trees, `AXIS2_PLACEMENT_3D` rigid-body frames, bounding boxes, and mass/inertia properties.
3. **AP242 PMI & GD&T Extraction (`extractStepAssembly`)**: Extracts datum features (`DATUM`, `DATUM_FEATURE`, `DATUM_SYSTEM`) and **10 geometric tolerance categories** (`StepGeometricTolerance` in `languages/step/src/extractor.ts`) for 3D tolerance stack-up analysis (`ToleranceStackOracle`):

| GD&T Tolerance Kind | STEP AP242 Entity Name                                                      |
| :------------------ | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `flatness`          | `FLATNESS_TOLERANCE`                                                        |
| `roundness`         | `ROUNDNESS_TOLERANCE` / `CIRCULARITY_TOLERANCE`                             |
| `cylindricity`      | `CYLINDRICITY_TOLERANCE`                                                    |
| `perpendicularity`  | `PERPENDICULARITY_TOLERANCE`                                                |
| `parallelism`       | `PARALLELISM_TOLERANCE`                                                     |
| `position`          | `POSITION_TOLERANCE`                                                        |
| `surface_profile`   | `SURFACE_PROFILE_TOLERANCE`                                                 |
| `concentricity`     | `CONCENTRICITY_TOLERANCE` / `COAXIALITY_TOLERANCE`                          |
| `runout`            | `CIRCULAR_RUNOUT_TOLERANCE` / `TOTAL_RUNOUT_TOLERANCE`                      |
| `general`           | `GEOMETRIC_TOLERANCE` (with `TOLERANCE_VALUE` / `LENGTH_MEASURE_WITH_UNIT`) |

4. **Modelica MultiBody Kinematic Synthesis (`mapStepToMultiBody`)**: `languages/step/src/multibody-mapper.ts` translates STEP kinematic joints and `AXIS2_PLACEMENT_3D` transforms directly into `Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody` components:
   - **Kinematic Joints**: Maps `REVOLUTE_PAIR` $\rightarrow$ `Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody.Joints.Revolute`, `PRISMATIC_PAIR` $\rightarrow$ `Joints.Prismatic`, `CYLINDRICAL_PAIR` $\rightarrow$ `Joints.Cylindrical`, `SPHERICAL_PAIR` $\rightarrow$ `Joints.Spherical`, and `PLANAR_PAIR` $\rightarrow$ `Joints.Planar` with axis vectors `n` and `connect(...)` equations.
   - **Static Frame Placements (`MultiBodyFixedTranslation`)**: Computes exact translation vectors `r = {x, y, z}` (converting `MILLI` to meters) and $3 \times 3$ orthonormal orientation matrices from `AXIS2_PLACEMENT_3D` `axis` ($\hat{z}$) and `ref_direction` ($\hat{x}$) vectors to emit `Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody.Parts.FixedTranslation` and `Parts.BodyBox` / `Parts.BodyCylinder` components.

---

## IDE & CAE Mesh Generation Actions

`stepLanguage.actions` (`languages/step/src/language.ts`) provides 6 built-in CAD/CAE workflows:

| Action ID            | Description                                                                                   |
| :------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `open_cad_viewer`    | Opens the interactive 3D B-Rep & assembly viewer for the `.step` model                        |
| `generate_multibody` | Synthesizes a `Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody` `.mo` model from STEP assembly frames and joints |
| `generate_fea_mesh`  | Tessellates the STEP B-Rep solid into a 3D tetrahedral CalculiX `.inp` finite element mesh    |
| `generate_cfd_mesh`  | Generates an unstructured `.su2` surface/volume fluid mesh from the STEP geometry             |
| `create_fea_setup`   | Scaffolds a parametric `.inpt` CalculiX structural study linked to the STEP part              |
| `create_cfd_setup`   | Scaffolds a parametric `.cfgt` SU2 aerodynamic study linked to the STEP part                  |

---

## Dedicated `step-mcp` Server Tools

The `@modelscript/step` MCP server (`languages/step/src/mcp/server.ts`) exposes two specialized tools for AI engineering agents:

- **`step_extract_entities`**: Parses a `.step` / `.stp` file and returns the structured assembly tree, `AXIS2_PLACEMENT_3D` coordinate frames, kinematic joints, and AP242 GD&T geometric tolerances.
- **`step_to_multibody`**: Generates complete `Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody` code (including `World`, `Parts.Body`, `Parts.FixedTranslation`, `Joints.*`, and `connect(...)` equations) from a STEP assembly.

---

| `StepRevoluteJointToModelicaRevolute`   | `DataEntity` (`REVOLUTE_PAIR`)       | `modelica`      | `ComponentClause` (`Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody.Joints.Revolute`)  |
| `StepPrismaticJointToModelicaPrismatic` | `DataEntity` (`PRISMATIC_PAIR`)      | `modelica`      | `ComponentClause` (`Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody.Joints.Prismatic`) |

```bash
# Parse and inspect the CST of an ISO 10303-21 STEP file

# Project a STEP assembly into a Modelica MultiBody model via TGG rules

# Verify cross-domain alignment between STEP CAD geometry and SysML v2 architecture

```

# OpenSCAD (`.scad`)

`@modelscript/scad` (`languages/scad`) parses parametric OpenSCAD scripts and evaluates Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG) trees via `@modelscript/cad` into exact OpenCascade B-Rep solids, watertight triangle meshes, STEP AP214/AP242 exports, and Modelica MultiBody parameters.

---

## Supported Syntax & Fluent Method Chaining

In addition to standard OpenSCAD primitives (`cube`, `sphere`, `cylinder`, `polyhedron`, `circle`, `square`, `polygon`), boolean operations (`union`, `difference`, `intersection`, `hull`, `minkowski`), extrusions (`linear_extrude`, `rotate_extrude`), and control flow (`module`, `function`, `for`, `if`/`else`), `@modelscript/scad` supports **fluent method chaining** (`ChainedSolid` in `languages/scad/src/evaluator.ts`) and **boundary port tagging**:

```c
wall_thickness = 4.0;
mount_radius = 12.0;

// Fluent method chaining with .fillet(), .chamfer(), .translate(), .rotate()
bracket = cube([60, 40, wall_thickness], center=true)
  .fillet(1.5)
  .translate([0, 0, wall_thickness / 2]);

// Explicit physical port tagging for SysML v2 / Modelica MultiBody & CFD/FEA binding
tag_port("base_mount", "frame", [0, 0, -1])
  difference() {
    bracket;
    cylinder(h=10, r=mount_radius, center=true).chamfer(0.5);
  }
```

### Supported Chained Methods (`ChainedSolid`)

| Method              | Signature                                     | Description                                        |
| :------------------ | :-------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------- |
| `.translate(v)`     | `translate([dx, dy, dz])`                     | Translates the solid by vector `[dx, dy, dz]`      |
| `.rotate(a, v?)`    | `rotate([rx, ry, rz])` or `rotate(deg, axis)` | Rotates the solid by Euler angles or axis-angle    |
| `.scale(v)`         | `scale([sx, sy, sz])`                         | Scales the solid non-uniformly or uniformly        |
| `.mirror(v)`        | `mirror([nx, ny, nz])`                        | Mirrors the solid across the plane with normal `v` |
| `.color(c, alpha?)` | `color("steelblue", 0.9)`                     | Assigns RGBA display metadata                      |
| `.fillet(r)`        | `fillet(radius)`                              | Applies a 3D edge fillet of radius $r > 0$         |
| `.chamfer(d)`       | `chamfer(distance)`                           | Applies a 3D edge chamfer of distance $d > 0$      |

---

## Semantic Linter & Diagnostic Codes

`lintScadCst(sourceText)` (`languages/scad/src/linter.ts`) performs static scope resolution, constant folding, and geometric validity checking across 9 diagnostic rules:

### Diagnostics for OpenSCAD (8 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `K1001` | error | `SCAD_UNDEFINED_VARIABLE` | Undefined variable '<name>'. |
| `K1002` | error | `SCAD_UNDEFINED_FUNCTION` | Undefined function '<name>'. |
| `K1003` | error | `SCAD_UNDEFINED_MODULE` | Undefined module '<name>'. |
| `K1004` | error | `SCAD_DIVISION_BY_ZERO` | Division by zero in expression. |
| `K1005` | error | `SCAD_INVALID_DIMENSION` | Invalid non-positive dimension (<val>) in '<param>': dimensions must be > 0. |
| `K1006` | error | `SCAD_ARGUMENT_COUNT` | Too many arguments to '<name>': expected at most <expected>, got <actual>. |
| `K1007` | error | `SCAD_UNKNOWN_PARAMETER` | Unknown parameter '<param>' in call to '<callable>'. |
| `K1008` | warning | `SCAD_DUPLICATE_DECLARATION` | Variable '<name>' is assigned multiple times in the same scope. |

---

## 3D Viewport Gizmo Writeback (`ScadPatcher`) & STEP Export

- **Surgical AST Writeback (`ScadPatcher` in `languages/scad/src/patcher.ts`)**: When a user drags a 3D translation/rotation/scale gizmo in the CAD viewport, `ScadPatcher` (`patchNode`, `patchVariable`, `patchTransformArgument`, `patchVectorComponent`, `wrapPrimitiveWithTransform`, `patchOrInsertTransform`) updates the exact CST byte spans in the `.scad` source without reformatting surrounding code or comments.
- **STEP AP214/AP242 Export (`compileScadToStep`)**: Evaluates the `.scad` CSG tree and serializes exact B-Rep analytical surfaces (`PLANE`, `CYLINDRICAL_SURFACE`, `SPHERICAL_SURFACE`, `MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP`) to ISO 10303-21 `.step`.

```bash
# Project a parametric OpenSCAD file to an ISO 10303-21 STEP CAD file
npx msx polyglot project bracket.scad --target step --out bracket.step

# Or extract Embedded CSG from a Modelica model to OpenSCAD
npx msx csg SatelliteChassis satellite.mo > bracket.scad
```

---

| `ScadCubeToMultiBodyShape`          | `ModuleInstantiation` (`cube`)                                  | `modelica`      | `ComponentClause` (`Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody.Visualizers.FixedShape` `"box"`)      |
| `ScadCylinderToMultiBodyShape`      | `ModuleInstantiation` (`cylinder`)                              | `modelica`      | `ComponentClause` (`Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody.Visualizers.FixedShape` `"cylinder"`) |
| `ScadSphereToMultiBodyShape`        | `ModuleInstantiation` (`sphere`)                                | `modelica`      | `ComponentClause` (`Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody.Visualizers.FixedShape` `"sphere"`)   |

================================================================================

CANONICAL URL: https://modelscript.org/languages/cfd

# CFD (SU2 & OpenFOAM)

`@modelscript/cfd` (`languages/cfd`) provides native WebAssembly GLR parsing, parametric configuration materialization, 3D CAD boundary marker synthesis, aerodynamic flow regime analysis, and cross-domain TGG synchronization for Computational Fluid Dynamics solver configurations.

---

## Supported Extensions & Dialects

| Extension      | Dialect                 | Description                                                                                                |
| :------------- | :---------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.cfg`, `.su2` | SU2 Configuration       | Native Stanford University Unstructured (`SU2_CFD`) key-value & marker configuration                       |
| `.cfgt`        | Parametric CFD Template | SU2 or OpenFOAM template supporting <code v-pre>{{ expr }}</code> parameter expressions                    |
| `.cfd`         | OpenFOAM / Native CFD   | OpenFOAM dictionary syntax (`FoamFile`, `dimensions`, `internalField`, `boundaryField`) and SU2 directives |

---

## Parametric Template Materialization (<code v-pre>{{ expr }}</code>)

CFD templates (`.cfgt`, `.cfg`, `.cfd`) can embed mathematical expressions in <code v-pre>{{ ... }}</code> blocks bound to SysML v2 or Modelica workspace parameters:

```ini
SOLVER= RANS
KIND_TURB_MODEL= SST
MACH_NUMBER= {{ cruise_speed / sqrt(1.4 * 287.05 * ambient_temp) }}
AOA= {{ angle_of_attack_deg }}
REYNOLDS_NUMBER= {{ rho_air * cruise_speed * chord_length / mu_air }}
MARKER_HEATFLUX= ( battery_plate, {{ heat_dissipation_watts / plate_area }} )
```

`materializeCfdConfig(templateText, parameters)` (`languages/cfd/src/materializer.ts`) evaluates each expression via `evaluateCfdExpression`, supporting arithmetic operators (`+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `^`), built-in math functions (`sin`, `cos`, `tan`, `sqrt`, `abs`, `min`, `max`, `log`, `exp`), and constants (`PI`, `E`).

---

## 3D CAD Boundary Condition Synthesis

When a user assigns a fluid or thermal boundary condition to a 3D CAD face in the viewport, `synthesizeCfdBoundary` and `applyBoundaryActionToConfig` (`languages/cfd/src/boundary-synthesizer.ts`) synthesize and merge the appropriate directives for either **SU2** or **OpenFOAM**:

| Boundary Condition                      | SU2 Directive (`.cfg` / `.su2`)                                    | OpenFOAM `boundaryField` Entry (`.cfd`)                      |
| :-------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Velocity / Total Inlet (`inlet`)**    | `MARKER_INLET= ( <face>, <T_total>, <P_total>, <nx>, <ny>, <nz> )` | `type fixedValue; value uniform (<vx> <vy> <vz>);`           |
| **Pressure Outlet (`outlet`)**          | `MARKER_OUTLET= ( <face>, <back_pressure_Pa> )`                    | `type fixedValue; value uniform <pressure>;`                 |
| **Adiabatic / Heat-Flux Wall (`wall`)** | `MARKER_HEATFLUX= ( <face>, <heat_flux_W_m2> )`                    | `type noSlip;` / `type fixedGradient; gradient uniform <q>;` |
| **Isothermal Wall (`isothermal`)**      | `MARKER_ISOTHERMAL= ( <face>, <temp_K> )`                          | `type fixedValue; value uniform <temp_K>;`                   |
| **Far-Field (`farfield`)**              | `MARKER_FAR= ( <face> )`                                           | `type freestream;`                                           |
| **Symmetry Plane (`symmetry`)**         | `MARKER_SYM= ( <face> )`                                           | `type symmetryPlane;`                                        |

---

## Aerodynamic Theory Slicing & Flow Regime Analysis

`extractCfdSlicingProperties(text)` (`languages/cfd/src/language.ts`) extracts aerodynamic coefficients directly from the CST:

- **`cd`**: Drag coefficient (`DRAG_COEFF`, `CD`, or `C_D`, default `0.3`)
- **`refArea`**: Reference wetted/frontal area (`REF_AREA`, default `1.0` $\text{m}^2$)
- **`density`**: Freestream fluid density (`FREESTREAM_DENSITY` or `RHO`, default `1.225` $\text{kg/m}^3$)
- **`freeStreamVelocity`**: Freestream velocity (`FREESTREAM_VELOCITY`, default `30.0` $\text{m/s}$)

These properties feed directly into Modelica 1D aerodynamic drag models ($F_d = \tfrac{1}{2} \rho v^2 C_d A_{\text{ref}}$), SysML v2 performance requirements, and the Multi-Domain Theory Coordinator (`CaeContractOracle`).

---

## Polyglot TGG Rules

`@modelscript/cfd` registers 6 bidirectional Triple Graph Grammar (TGG) rules in `languages/cfd/src/language.ts`:

| Rule Name                       | Source (`cfd`)                                 | Target Language | Target Construct                                                          |
| :------------------------------ | :--------------------------------------------- | :-------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `CfdDragPolarToModelicaParam`   | `CfdConfig` (`cd`, `refArea`)                  | `modelica`      | `ComponentClause` (`parameter Real Cd`, `A_ref`)                          |
| `CfdDragPolarToSysmlAttribute`  | `CfdConfig` (`cd`, `refArea`)                  | `sysml2`        | `AttributeUsage`                                                          |
| `CfdInletToModelicaFluidPort`   | `Directive` (`MARKER_INLET`)                   | `modelica`      | `ComponentClause` (`Modelica.Fluid.Interfaces.FluidPort_a`)               |
| `CfdHeatFluxToModelicaHeatPort` | `Directive` (`MARKER_HEATFLUX`)                | `modelica`      | `ComponentClause` (`Modelica.Thermal.HeatTransfer.Interfaces.HeatPort_a`) |
| `CfdMarkerToSysmlPort`          | `Directive` (`MARKER_*`)                       | `sysml2`        | `PortUsage`                                                               |
| `CfdDirectiveToSysmlConstraint` | `Directive` (`MACH_NUMBER`, `REYNOLDS_NUMBER`) | `sysml2`        | `ConstraintUsage`                                                         |

## Command Line Interface (`msx cfd`)

```bash
msx cfd <action> [files...] [options]
```

| Action            | Description                                                                                       | Key Options         |
| :---------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | :------------------ |
| **`lint`**        | Validates SU2 and OpenFOAM configuration syntax, boundary markers, and thermodynamic consistency. | —                   |
| **`summary`**     | Prints turbulence model, freestream conditions, reference areas, and configured markers.          | —                   |
| **`inspect`**     | Dumps parsed marker tree, solver settings, and evaluated parametric expressions.                  | —                   |
| **`to-modelica`** | Generates Modelica 1D aerodynamic drag models (`Modelica.Mechanics.Translational`) and ports.     | `--out=<file.mo>`   |
| **`to-dae`**      | Lowers boundary conditions and drag polar into ModelScript linear-memory DAE arena.               | `--out=<file.json>` |
| **`solve`**       | Invokes external or embedded SU2 flow solver iteration for steady/unsteady aerodynamic fields.    | —                   |

### Examples

```bash
# Validate boundary markers and turbulence settings in an SU2 configuration
msx cfd lint transonic_wing.cfg

# Display mesh markers, Mach number, and reference area
msx cfd summary wing_template.cfgt

# Project aerodynamic drag polar to standard Modelica component
msx cfd to-modelica transonic_wing.cfg --out=AeroDrag.mo
```

---

## Diagnostic Rules

### Diagnostics for CFD (SU2 / OpenFOAM) (8 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `C1001` | warning | `cfl-stability-violation` | Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy stability number '<cfl>' exceeds recommended maximum limit for explicit scheme. |
| `C1002` | error | `unresolved-mesh-file` | Referenced grid mesh file '<mesh>' cannot be located or is invalid. |
| `C1003` | warning | `missing-inlet-boundary` | CFD domain '<name>' lacks a declared inlet boundary condition or stagnation state. |
| `C1004` | warning | `missing-outlet-boundary` | CFD domain '<name>' lacks a declared outlet boundary condition or pressure exit. |
| `C1005` | error | `unphysical-freestream-mach` | Freestream Mach number '<mach>' is non-physical or outside valid range [0, 25]. |
| `C1006` | error | `unphysical-reynolds-number` | Freestream Reynolds number '<re>' must be strictly positive. |
| `C1007` | error | `negative-surface-area` | Aerodynamic reference area '<area>' must be strictly positive. |
| `C1008` | warning | `turbulent-viscosity-ratio` | Turbulent eddy viscosity ratio '<ratio>' is non-physical. |

# FEA (CalculiX, Abaqus & NASTRAN)

`@modelscript/fea` (`languages/fea`) provides native parsing, parametric template materialization, 3D CAD boundary condition synthesis, structural theory slicing, and cross-domain TGG synchronization for Finite Element Analysis input decks.

---

## Supported Dialects & Extensions

| Extension | Dialect                               | Key Directives                                                                                                                                                               |
| :-------- | :------------------------------------ | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.inp`    | CalculiX / Abaqus input deck          | `*HEADING`, `*NODE`, `*ELEMENT`, `*NSET`, `*ELSET`, `*MATERIAL`, `*ELASTIC`, `*DENSITY`, `*SOLID SECTION`, `*STEP`, `*STATIC`, `*FREQUENCY`, `*BOUNDARY`, `*CLOAD`, `*DLOAD` |
| `.inpt`   | Parametric CalculiX / Abaqus template | Supports <code v-pre>{{ expression }}</code> mustache substitutions over workspace parameters                                                                                |
| `.bdf`    | NASTRAN Bulk Data Deck                | `SOL`, `CEND`, `BEGIN BULK`, `GRID`, `CTETRA`, `CHEXA`, `PSOLID`, `MAT1`, `SPC1`, `FORCE`, `MOMENT`, `LOAD`, `ENDDATA`                                                       |
| `.fea`    | ModelScript native FEA configuration  | Structured material, mesh, boundary, and load study definitions                                                                                                              |

---

## Parametric Template Materialization (<code v-pre>{{ expr }}</code>)

Input decks (`.inpt`, `.inp`, `.bdf`, `.fea`) can embed parametric expressions enclosed in <code v-pre>{{ ... }}</code> placeholders:

```ini
*MATERIAL, NAME=AL7075
*ELASTIC
{{ E_modulus }}, {{ poisson_ratio }}
*DENSITY
{{ rho_al }}
*CLOAD
LOAD_SET, 3, {{ -tip_mass * 9.81 }}
```

`materializeFeaDeck(templateText, parameters)` (`languages/fea/src/materializer.ts`) evaluates arithmetic expressions (`+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `^`), functions (`sin`, `cos`, `tan`, `sqrt`, `abs`, `min`, `max`, `log`, `exp`), and built-in constants (`PI`, `E`) via `evaluateFeaExpression`, formatting values in engineering notation and recording any unresolved symbols or syntax errors.

---

## 3D CAD Face Boundary Condition & Load Synthesis

When a user selects a topological face in the 3D CAD viewer, `synthesizeFeaBoundary` and `applyBoundaryActionToDeck` (`languages/fea/src/boundary-synthesizer.ts`) automatically generate solver-native boundary and load cards for the target dialect:

| Boundary Kind                            | CalculiX / Abaqus (`.inp`)                                                          | NASTRAN Bulk Data (`.bdf`)                                           |
| :--------------------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Fixed Support (`fixed`)**              | `*BOUNDARY` constraining DOFs `1, 6` (or `1, 3`) on `NSET_<FACE>`                   | `SPC1` card locking DOFs `123456` (or `123`) on `SET_<FACE>`         |
| **Point / Concentrated Force (`force`)** | `*CLOAD` directional nodal force components $(F_x, F_y, F_z)$ along the face normal | `FORCE` card with magnitude and normal unit vector $(n_x, n_y, n_z)$ |
| **Distributed Pressure (`pressure`)**    | `*DLOAD` surface pressure (`P`) applied to `ELSET_<FACE>`                           | `PLOAD4` / `FORCE` cards distributed across face elements            |
| **Torque / Moment (`moment`)**           | `*CLOAD` rotational DOFs `4, 5, 6`                                                  | `MOMENT` card around face normal axis                                |

---

## Structural Theory Slicing & Safety Margin Extraction

`extractFeaSlicingProperties(text)` (`languages/fea/src/language.ts`) extracts structural parameters (`DENSITY`, `VOLUME`, `MAX_VON_MISES_STRESS`, `YIELD_STRENGTH`) directly from the CST and evaluates the structural safety margin:

$$
\text{Safety Factor (SF)} = \frac{\sigma_{\text{yield}}}{\sigma_{\text{von Mises, max}}}, \qquad \text{isSafe} \iff \sigma_{\text{von Mises, max}} \le \sigma_{\text{yield}}
$$

Returning `{ mass, maxVonMisesPa, yieldStrengthPa, safetyFactor, isSafe }` directly to the Multi-Domain Theory Coordinator (`CaeContractOracle`) and SysML v2 requirement verifiers.

---

## Built-In Solver & IDE Actions

`@modelscript/fea` registers three interactive actions in `feaLanguage.actions`:

- **`open_fea_viewer`**: Opens the 3D FEA mesh, boundary condition, and von Mises stress contour viewer.
- **`materialize_deck`**: Evaluates all <code v-pre>{{ expr }}</code> template placeholders against workspace parameters to produce a concrete `.inp` or `.bdf` deck.
- **`run_simulation` (`fea_run_simulation`)**: Parses `*MATERIAL`, `*ELASTIC`, `*BOUNDARY`, and `*CLOAD`/`*DLOAD` sections, solves the 3D tetrahedral finite element stiffness matrix, and returns nodal displacements and element von Mises stress contours.

---

## Polyglot TGG Rules

`@modelscript/fea` defines 6 bidirectional Triple Graph Grammar (TGG) rules in `languages/fea/src/language.ts`:

| Rule Name                       | Source (`fea`)                      | Target Language | Target Construct                                                         |
| :------------------------------ | :---------------------------------- | :-------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `FeaStressMassToModelicaParam`  | `FeaDeck` (`mass`, `maxVonMisesPa`) | `modelica`      | `ComponentClause` (`parameter Real`)                                     |
| `FeaStressMassToSysmlAttribute` | `FeaDeck` (`safetyFactor`, `mass`)  | `sysml2`        | `AttributeUsage`                                                         |
| `FeaMaterialToSysmlAttribute`   | `Section` (`*MATERIAL` / `MAT1`)    | `sysml2`        | `AttributeUsage`                                                         |
| `FeaBoundaryFixToModelicaFixed` | `Section` (`*BOUNDARY` / `SPC1`)    | `modelica`      | `ComponentClause` (`Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody.Parts.Fixed`)           |
| `FeaSpringToModelicaSpring`     | `Section` (`*SPRING`)               | `modelica`      | `ComponentClause` (`Modelica.Mechanics.Translational.Components.Spring`) |
| `FeaLoadCaseToSysmlRequirement` | `Section` (`*STEP` / `SUBCASE`)     | `sysml2`        | `RequirementUsage`                                                       |

## Command Line Interface (`msx fea`)

```bash
msx fea <action> [files...] [options]
```

| Action            | Description                                                                                          | Key Options         |
| :---------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------ |
| **`lint`**        | Validates CalculiX, Abaqus, and NASTRAN syntax, element topologies, material cards, and constraints. | —                   |
| **`summary`**     | Prints structural summary: element count by kind (C3D4, C3D10, CHEXA), materials, and load steps.    | —                   |
| **`inspect`**     | Dumps parsed boundary sets, node coordinates, material elastic moduli, and load cases.               | —                   |
| **`to-modelica`** | Generates Modelica equivalent structural stiffness models and translational boundary ports.          | `--out=<file.mo>`   |
| **`to-dae`**      | Lowers structural mass and stiffness matrices into ModelScript linear-memory DAE arena.              | `--out=<file.json>` |
| **`solve`**       | Solves linear elastostatic stiffness matrix for nodal displacements and von Mises stress contours.   | —                   |

### Examples

```bash
# Validate element connectivity and material properties in an Abaqus deck
msx fea lint BracketAssembly.inp

# Display mesh statistics, node count, and material properties
msx fea summary ChassisStructure.bdf

# Solve linear static displacement and print max von Mises stress
msx fea solve BracketAssembly.inp
```

---

## Diagnostic Rules

| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

| `F1002` | error | `poisson-ratio-limit` | Poisson's ratio '<val>' for material '<mat>' violates physical stability bounds (-1.0 < nu < 0.5). |
| `F1003` | warning | `unconstrained-rigid-body` | Structural mesh '<name>' has only '<count>' constrained boundary nodes; rigid-body motion may be unconstrained. |

# CSV Tabular Data (`.csv`)

`@modelscript/csv` (`languages/csv`) elevates empirical measurement series, calibration look-up tables, and parameter sweeps into first-class typed symbols inside the `WorkspaceIndex`.

---

## Capabilities

1. **Native GLR Parsing & Delimiter Auto-Detection**: Parses RFC 4180 CSV documents into linear-memory CST rows and cells (`csv_document`, `header_row`, `data_row`, `field`, `quoted_field`) while `detectDelimiter` (`languages/csv/src/measurements.ts`) automatically detects comma (`,`), semicolon (`;`), or tab (`\t`) delimiters and handles quoted strings with escaped `""` sequences.
2. **Modelica Package Generation (`parseCsvToModelica`)**: Converts any CSV dataset directly into a strongly typed Modelica `package` containing:
   - `constant Integer numRows` and `constant Integer numCols`
   - A 2D `constant Real values[numRows, numCols]` matrix suitable for `Modelica.Blocks.Tables.CombiTable1D` / `CombiTable2D`
   - Sanitized 1D column vectors (`constant Real <colName>[numRows]`) with automatic duplicate-name disambiguation
3. **Salsa Virtual Component Queries (`CSVVirtualComponent`)**: Exposes every CSV column as a queryable virtual symbol in the `QueryEngine` (`languages/csv/src/queries.ts`):
   - `resolvedType`: Infers `"Real"`, `"Integer"`, `"Boolean"`, or `"String"` from column cells
   - `classInstance`: Maps to `"Modelica.Blocks.Sources.CombiTimeTable"`
   - `variability`: Returns `"constant"`
   - `causality`: Returns `"output"`
   - `resolvedArrayDimensions` / `arrayDimensions`: Returns `[rowCount]`
   - `effectiveModification`: Synthesizes `{ table: "[[...]]" }` array literals from column data
4. **Bidirectional Cell Writeback (`writeback`)**: When a parameter or table entry is modified during calibration or optimization, `csvLanguage.writeback` (`languages/csv/src/language.ts`) updates the exact `[row, col]` cell or column header in place while preserving the file's original delimiter and line endings.

---

## Semantic Linter & Diagnostic Codes

`lintCsv(sourceText)` (`languages/csv/src/linter.ts`) performs six structural and numerical integrity checks on CSV datasets:

| Code                        | Severity  | Condition Checked                                                                                   |
| :-------------------------- | :-------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `CSV_UNCLOSED_QUOTE`        | `error`   | A quoted field contains an unclosed `"` at the end of a line                                        |
| `CSV_EMPTY_HEADER`          | `warning` | A column in the header row has an empty name                                                        |
| `CSV_DUPLICATE_HEADER`      | `warning` | Two or more columns share the same header identifier                                                |
| `CSV_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH` | `error`   | A data row contains fewer or more cells than the header row                                         |
| `CSV_INVALID_NUMERIC_CELL`  | `error`   | A cell in a numeric column (where row 1 is numeric) contains non-numeric text, `NaN`, or `Infinity` |
| `CSV_NON_MONOTONIC_TIME`    | `warning` | The first column (`time` / `t`) is not strictly monotonically increasing ($t_i < t_{i-1}$)          |

---

## Polyglot TGG Rules

`@modelscript/csv` registers 2 bidirectional Triple Graph Grammar (TGG) rules in `languages/csv/src/language.ts`:

| Rule Name                                | Source (`csv`)        | Target (`modelica`)                  | Semantics                                                                          |
| :--------------------------------------- | :-------------------- | :----------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `CsvDocumentToModelicaPackage`           | `CSVDocument`         | `ClassDefinition` (`package`)        | Projects a CSV file into a Modelica data package with `values[numRows, numCols]`   |
| `CsvVirtualComponentToModelicaComponent` | `CSVVirtualComponent` | `ComponentClause` (`parameter Real`) | Binds a typed CSV column to a Modelica parameter vector or `CombiTimeTable` source |

---

## Command Line Interface

```bash
# Lint CSV datasets for column mismatches, unclosed quotes, and non-monotonic time
msx lint trajectory_data.csv

# Output simulation trajectories directly to standard CSV format
msx simulate CircuitModel.mo --stop-time=1.0 --step-size=0.001 --format=csv -o sim_results.csv
```

# C Numerical & Embedded Engineering Integration (`.c`, `.h`)

`@modelscript/c` (`languages/c`) provides native WebAssembly GLR parsing, procedural simulation step compilation, automated Modelica `external "C"` header binding, continuous DAE lowering, and static analysis diagnostics for **ANSI C / C99** engineering blocks, Simulink C MEX S-functions, and PSCAD custom C components.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension | Standard / Format | Description                                                                      |
| :-------- | :---------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.c`      | **C99 / ANSI C**  | Control algorithms, filter routines, ODE integration steps, and S-functions      |
| `.h`      | **C Headers**     | Function prototypes, typedefs, and struct layouts for Modelica external bindings |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. WebAssembly GLR C Parser

- Ahead-of-time compiled WebAssembly GLR parser generated by `@modelscript/dsl` with zero grammar conflicts.
- Parses full C99 translation units, nested functions, `struct`/`union`/`enum` declarations, `typedef` names, control flow (`if`, `while`, `for`, `do-while`), pointer/array operators, and bitwise/arithmetic expressions.

### 2. Automated Modelica External "C" Bridge

- Header Scraper (`scrapeCHeader`) extracts C prototypes, argument names, causalities, and struct fields from `.h` files.
- Modelica Binder (`bindCHeaderToModelica`) auto-generates strongly typed Modelica functions with:
  ```modelica
  function motor_torque
    input Real current;
    input MotorParams p;
    output Real y;
    external "C" y = motor_torque(current, p)
      annotation(Include = "#include \"motor.h\"");
  end motor_torque;
  ```

### 3. Zero-Allocation Simulation Step Compiler

- Compiles procedural C control blocks and discrete filters into low-overhead execution closures executing **100,000 steps in < 30ms** without heap allocations.
- Direct mapping to pre-allocated typed arrays: `statesReal` (`Float64Array`) and `statesInt` (`Int32Array`).
- Built-in support for standard `<math.h>` mathematical functions (`sin`, `cos`, `tan`, `asin`, `acos`, `atan`, `atan2`, `exp`, `log`, `log10`, `sqrt`, `fabs`, `pow`, `fmin`, `fmax`, `floor`, `ceil`).

### 4. Direct DAE Subroutine Lowering

- Translates ODE continuous state derivatives (`dx[i] = ...` / `der_x = ...`) directly into continuous states `der(s_i)` in `@modelscript/runtime`'s `IDaeBuilder` linear memory arena.
- Enables Simulink continuous S-functions and PSCAD C segments to integrate directly into continuous DAE and hybrid ODE solvers.

---

## Static Analysis & Safety Linter Rules

The C analyzer surfaces common numeric defects, memory safety concerns, and algorithmic cycles (`M8401`–`M8410`):

### Diagnostics for C (10 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M8401` | warning | `uninitialized-variable` | Local variable '<varName>' may be read before being initialized. |
| `M8402` | error | `constant-division-by-zero` | Division or modulo by constant zero detected in arithmetic expression. |
| `M8403` | error | `array-bounds-overflow` | Static array subscript '<arrName>[<index>]' exceeds declared dimension bound of <bound>. |
| `M8404` | warning | `unreachable-code` | Unreachable statements detected following unconditional 'return', 'break', or 'goto'. |
| `M8405` | warning | `assignment-in-conditional` | Assignment operator '=' used inside conditional expression; did you mean '=='? |
| `M8406` | error | `algebraic-dependency-cycle` | Procedural algebraic dependency cycle detected without state lag: '<cycle>'. |
| `M8407` | error | `null-pointer-dereference` | Dereference of statically known NULL pointer in expression '<expr>'. |
| `M8408` | error | `function-prototype-mismatch` | Function '<fnName>' signature conflicts with declaration: expected '<expected>', got '<actual>'. |
| `M8409` | error | `missing-return-value` | Non-void function '<fnName>' with return type '<returnType>' reaches end of body without returning a value. |
| `M8410` | info | `implicit-lossy-conversion` | Implicit floating-point to integer conversion from '<fromType>' to '<toType>' may cause lossy truncation. |

---

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Lint C source files or headers
msx lint Controller.c

# Generate Modelica external "C" bindings from header
msx c to-modelica SensorDriver.h -o SensorDriver.mo
```

# Fortran Legacy Engineering Integration (`.f`, `.f90`)

`@modelscript/fortran` (`languages/fortran`) provides native GLR parsing, AST analysis, Triple Graph Grammar (TGG) synchronization, and DAE wrapping for legacy **Fortran 77** and **Fortran 90** computational engines.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension            | Standard / Format               | Description                                                            |
| :------------------- | :------------------------------ | :--------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.f`, `.for`, `.f77` | **Fortran 77** (Fixed Form)     | Column-based legacy engineering subroutines and mathematical libraries |
| `.f90`, `.f95`       | **Fortran 90 / 95** (Free Form) | Free-form modular subroutines, derived types, and array syntax         |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. WebAssembly GLR Fortran Parser

- Built on `@modelscript/dsl`'s ahead-of-time compiled WASM GLR parser table.
- Accurately parses both fixed-form (columns 1-5 label, 6 continuation, 7-72 statements) and modern free-form source files.
- Supports subroutines, functions, `COMMON` blocks, `EQUIVALENCE`, `PARAMETER`, `DATA` statements, multidimensional array indexing, and intrinsic mathematical functions (`SIN`, `COS`, `SQRT`, `EXP`, etc.).

### 2. Bidirectional Triple Graph Grammar (TGG) Rules

- Features formal bidirectional graph rewriting rules (`languages/fortran/src/language.ts`):
  - **`FortranSubroutineToModelicaFunction`**: Maps Fortran `SUBROUTINE` and `FUNCTION` definitions to strongly typed Modelica functions.
  - **`FortranAssignToModelicaEquation`**: Transforms Fortran numerical assignment statements into declarative Modelica equality equations.

### 3. Direct DAE Subroutine Lowering

- Compiles Fortran continuous state derivative subroutines directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` SoA linear memory arena.
- Enables legacy aero-propulsion, ballistics, and nuclear thermal routines to execute within modern hybrid continuous-discrete simulation solvers without manual recoding.

---

## Static Analysis & Modernization Linter Rules

The Fortran analyzer surfaces modernization issues and common numeric defects:

### Diagnostics for Fortran (15 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

| `M4072` | error | `constant-division-by-zero` | Division by constant zero detected in arithmetic expression. |

| `M4076` | warning | `procedural-algebraic-loop` | Algebraic cycle detected among procedural assignments without time-step lag: <cycleStr>. |
| `M4077` | error | `common-block-mismatch` | COMMON block '/<blockName>/' definition conflict: <reason>. |
| `M4078` | error | `array-dimension-underflow` | Array '<arrName>' declared with non-positive dimension size (<dim> <= 0). |

## CLI Usage

Fortran sources are handled by the generic workspace commands. The language is detected from the file extension (`.f`, `.for`, `.f90`, `.f95`, `.f03`, `.f08`).

```bash
# Lint legacy Fortran engineering subroutines
msx lint TurbomachineryModel.f

# Lint only the Fortran files in a mixed-language workspace
msx lint ./src --language fortran

# Print the parse tree of a Fortran source file
msx parse PropulsionAero.f90
```

DAE lowering is available from the package API (there is no dedicated `msx fortran` command yet):

```ts
import { lintFortranSource, lowerFortranToDae } from "@modelscript/fortran";

const diagnostics = lintFortranSource(source);
const result = lowerFortranToDae(builder, source.split("\n"));
```

# JSBSim Aerospace 6-DOF Flight Dynamics (`.xml`)

`@modelscript/jsbsim` (`languages/jsbsim`) provides zero-regex XML parsing, non-linear 6-DOF rigid-body flight dynamics integration, cruise trim stabilization, linear DAE lowering, and Modelica 3.x projection for **JSBSim Flight Dynamics Model (FDM)** fixed-wing and rotorcraft aircraft configurations.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension | Format         | Description                                                                                                    |
| :-------- | :------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.xml`    | JSBSim FDM XML | Aircraft configuration schema encoding metrics, mass balance, propulsion, landing gear, and aerodynamic tables |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Six-Degree-of-Freedom (6-DOF) Non-Linear Equations of Motion

- Integrates the full non-linear Newtonian equations of motion for a rigid aircraft in atmospheric flight:
  - **Translational Accelerations in Body Frame**:
    $$\dot{u} = \frac{F_x}{m} - q w + r v$$
    $$\dot{v} = \frac{F_y}{m} - r u + p w$$
    $$\dot{w} = \frac{F_z}{m} - p v + q u$$
  - **Rotational Accelerations in Principal Axes**:
    $$\dot{p} = \frac{M_x}{I_{xx}} + \frac{I_{yy} - I_{zz}}{I_{xx}} q r$$
    $$\dot{q} = \frac{M_y}{I_{yy}} + \frac{I_{zz} - I_{xx}}{I_{yy}} p r$$
    $$\dot{r} = \frac{M_z}{I_{zz}} + \frac{I_{xx} - I_{yy}}{I_{zz}} p q$$
  - **Euler Angle Kinematics**:
    $$\dot{\phi} = p + (q \sin \phi + r \cos \phi) \tan \theta$$
    $$\dot{\theta} = q \cos \phi - r \sin \phi$$
    $$\dot{\psi} = \frac{q \sin \phi + r \cos \phi}{\cos \theta}$$
  - **Geodetic Altitude Rate of Climb**:
    $$\dot{h} = u \sin \theta - v \sin \phi \cos \theta - w \cos \phi \cos \theta$$

### 2. Aerodynamics & Steady Cruise Trim

- Models lift ($C_L$), drag ($C_D$), side force ($C_Y$), and moments ($C_l, C_m, C_n$) as functions of dynamic pressure $\bar{q} = \frac{1}{2} \rho V^2$, angle of attack $\alpha = \arctan(w / u)$, and sideslip $\beta = \arcsin(v / V)$:
  $$C_L = C_{L0} + C_{L\alpha} \cdot \alpha$$
  $$C_D = C_{D0} + k C_L^2$$
  $$C_m = C_{m\alpha} (\alpha - \alpha_{\text{trim}}) + C_{mq} \left( \frac{q \bar{c}}{2 V} \right)$$
- Computes automatic cruise trim equilibrium where aerodynamic lift cancels aircraft gross weight ($L = mg$):
  $$\alpha_{\text{trim}} = \frac{mg - \bar{q} S C_{L0}}{\bar{q} S C_{L\alpha}}$$
  ensuring stable horizontal flight without pitch oscillation or kinetic energy loss.

### 3. Direct DAE Lowering

- Lowers state variables ($u, v, w, p, q, r, \phi, \theta, \psi, h$) and aero force equations into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` linear memory arena.
- Enables co-simulation between aerodynamic airframes, onboard flight control computers ([`@modelscript/simulink`](./simulink.md)), and satellite navigation systems ([`@modelscript/ccsds`](./ccsds.md)).

### 4. Bidirectional Modelica 3.x Projection

- Projects JSBSim aircraft into `Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody` 6-DOF airframes with aerodynamic force elements.

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics

The JSBSim linter validates aircraft geometry, mass distributions, and inertia tensors:

### Diagnostics for JSBSim (10 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M8901` | error | `missing-aircraft-name` | JSBSim <fdm_config> element is missing required 'name' attribute. |
| `M8902` | error | `non-positive-reference-area` | Wing reference area (<val>) must be strictly positive. |
| `M8903` | error | `non-positive-wingspan-chord` | Wing metric '<param>' (<val>) must be strictly positive. |
| `M8904` | error | `non-positive-empty-weight` | Aircraft empty weight (<val>) must be strictly positive. |
| `M8905` | error | `invalid-inertia-tensor` | Moments of inertia tensor is invalid: <reason>. |
| `M8906` | error | `missing-aerodynamics-section` | Aircraft model does not define any aerodynamic force/moment coefficients in <aerodynamics>. |
| `M8907` | warning | `missing-landing-gear` | Aircraft model defines no landing gear bogies in <ground_reactions>; ground interaction is disabled. |
| `M8908` | error | `negative-engine-thrust` | Engine '<engineName>' specifies negative maximum thrust (<val>). |
| `M8909` | warning | `undefined-fcs-input` | FCS channel '<channelName>' references input property '<inputProperty>' not bound in flight control. |
| `M8910` | warning | `unrealistic-cg-location` | Center of gravity (<cgX>) is significantly far from aerodynamic center (<aeroX>); aircraft may have extreme pitch instability. |

---

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Inspect aircraft metrics, mass balance, engines, and aero coefficients
msx jsbsim inspect Cessna172Skyhawk.xml

# Run pre-flight linting and inertia tensor validation
msx jsbsim lint Cessna172Skyhawk.xml

# Simulate 6-DOF flight dynamics with automatic cruise trim
msx jsbsim simulate Cessna172Skyhawk.xml --duration=15.0 --speed=180.0 --altitude=5000.0

# Lower 6-DOF flight dynamics equations to ModelScript linear DAE arena
msx jsbsim to-dae Cessna172Skyhawk.xml

# Project into Modelica 3.x 6-DOF flight mechanics model
msx jsbsim to-modelica Cessna172Skyhawk.xml -o FlightMechanics.mo
```

# NASA ROCETS Liquid Propulsion Modeling (`.roc`, `.deck`)

The `@modelscript/rocets` package (`languages/rocets`) provides native compilation, simulation, and analysis for **NASA ROCETS (Rocket Engine Transient Simulator)** liquid propellant rocket engine decks and turbomachinery maps. It delivers multi-syntax parsing, embedded Fortran user routine bridge via `@modelscript/fortran`, pre-flight static propulsion diagnostics (`M8001`–`M8014`), direct continuous DAE arena lowering into `@modelscript/runtime` (`IDaeBuilder`), a coupled steady-state power and flow balance solver, dynamic start/shutdown transient integration, multi-domain projections to **Modelica 3.x** and **FMI SSP**, and interactive Piping & Instrumentation Diagram (P&ID) vector schematic generation.

---

## Supported File Specifications

| Extension            | Format              | Key Structural Features                                                                         |
| :------------------- | :------------------ | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **`.roc` / `.deck`** | Engine Model Deck   | Tagged `DECK`, `COMPONENTS`, `PARAMS`, `S0`, `PORTS`, `CONNECTIONS`, `BALANCE` blocks           |
| **`.map` / `.dat`**  | Turbomachinery Maps | Multidimensional speed-flow-head and efficiency performance tables for pumps and turbines       |
| **`.f` / `.for`**    | User Subroutines    | Embedded or external Fortran routines for custom fluid properties and component characteristics |

---

## Architecture & Compilation Pipeline

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    SRC["ROCETS Deck (.roc, .deck, .map)"]

    subgraph FrontEnd["Parser & Static Analysis"]
        PARSER["ROCETS Deck & Map Parsers"]
        FORTRAN["Fortran User Routine Bridge (@modelscript/fortran)"]
        INDEX["RocetsWorkspaceIndex (Symbol Table)"]
        LINT["Pre-Flight Propulsion Linter (M8001–M8014)"]
    end

    subgraph Core["Analytical & Numerical Solvers"]
        THERMO["Propellant Thermodynamics & CEA Equilibrium Curves"]
        DAE["Continuous DAE Arena Lowering (IDaeBuilder)"]
        BAL["Coupled Power & Flow Balance Solver (Newton-Raphson)"]
        TRANS["Dynamic Transient Integrator (Ignition & Ramp Trajectories)"]
    end

    subgraph Projections["Multi-Domain Projections"]
        MO["Modelica 3.x Physical Models (rocetsToModelica)"]
        SSP["FMI SystemStructure.ssd XML (rocetsToSsp)"]
    end

    subgraph Presentation["User Experience & Toolchain"]
        PID["Vector P&ID Flow Diagram (AntV X6 & SVG)"]
        IDE["Visual Custom Editor (VS Code / Web IDE)"]
        CLI["CLI Toolchain (msx rocets, msx lint)"]
        LSP["Language Server Protocol Services"]
    end

    SRC --> PARSER
    SRC --> FORTRAN
    PARSER --> INDEX --> LINT
    PARSER --> THERMO --> BAL
    PARSER --> DAE --> TRANS
    BAL --> PID
    BAL --> MO
    BAL --> SSP
    BAL --> IDE
    BAL --> CLI
    LINT --> LSP
```

---

## Propulsion Component Library

NASA ROCETS provides specialized thermodynamic and turbomachinery modules for rocket engine architectures:

| Module                  | Category       | Description                                                       | Primary Parameters & States                                                     |
| :---------------------- | :------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **`CHAMBER` / `TC`**    | Combustion     | Thrust chamber & convergent-divergent supersonic nozzle expansion | $P_c, A_t, \varepsilon, V_c, c^*, O/F$                                          |
| **`PUMP`**              | Turbomachinery | Centrifugal / axial propellant pump                               | $\Delta P, \eta, \rho, \dot{m}, P_{\text{shaft}}$                               |
| **`TURBINE`**           | Turbomachinery | Gas-driven drive turbine                                          | $PR, \eta, T_{\text{in}}, c_p, P_{\text{shaft}}$                                |
| **`SHAFT`**             | Mechanical     | Turbopump rotating assembly                                       | $J, \omega, N_{\text{rpm}}, \tau_{\text{turb}}, \tau_{\text{pump}}$             |
| **`COOLING_JACKET`**    | Thermal        | Regenerative nozzle cooling jacket                                | $T_{\text{wall}}, Q_{\text{gas}}, Q_{\text{cool}}, h_g, \Delta P_{\text{cool}}$ |
| **`VALVE` / `ORIFICE`** | Fluid          | Throttle, cavitating venturi, or shutoff valve                    | $C_v, \text{position}, \Delta P$                                                |
| **`JUNCTION`**          | Fluid          | Propellant flow splitter or mixing manifold                       | $\sum \dot{m} = 0, P_{\text{node}}$                                             |

---

## Propellants & Thermodynamics

The `@modelscript/rocets` thermo engine provides:

- **Cryogenic & Hydrocarbon Propellants**: Standard properties for Liquid Oxygen (LOX), Liquid Hydrogen (LH2), Liquid Methane (LCH4), and RP-1 kerosene.
- **NASA CEA Combustion Curves**: Chemical equilibrium calculations of characteristic velocity ($c^*$), adiabatic flame temperature ($T_c$), isentropic expansion exponent ($\gamma$), and molecular weight.
- **Gas Dynamics**: Isentropic supersonic nozzle expansion with Mach area relations, vacuum and sea level thrust, and vacuum/SL specific impulse ($I_{sp}$).
- **Bartz Convective Heat Transfer**: Gas-side throat heat transfer coefficient ($h_g$) for regenerative cooling circuit sizing.

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostic Rules

### Diagnostics for NASA ROCETS (14 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

| `M8002` | error | `fluid-type-mismatch` | Incompatible fluid stream connection '<conn>': cannot mix '<fromFluid>' into '<toFluid>' without a combustion chamber. |
| `M8003` | error | `shaft-power-imbalance` | Turbopump shaft '<shaftId>' power imbalance: <reason>. |
| `M8004` | error | `unbalanced-flow-split` | Mass conservation failure at junction '<junct>': inlet and outlet flow mismatch exceeds tolerance (\|\\u0394m\| = <value> kg/s). |
| `M8005` | warning | `pump-cavitation-risk` | Pump '<pumpId>' inlet suction pressure is below required NPSH margin (margin: <value> kPa). Cavitation risk. |
| `M8006` | error | `negative-chamber-pressure` | Non-physical pressure at '<comp>': computed pressure is <val> Pa (must be > 0). |
| `M8007` | warning | `combustion-temperature-limit` | Gas temperature at '<comp>' (<value> K) exceeds throat thermal structural limit (<limitK> K). |
| `M8008` | error | `invalid-valve-schedule` | Invalid valve actuation profile for '<valveId>': <reason>. |

| `M8011` | warning | `extreme-mixture-ratio` | Engine mixture ratio (O/F = <value>) at '<comp>' is outside stable combustion limits. |
| `M8012` | error | `missing-fluid-table` | Propellant fluid table for '<fluid>' is not loaded in the session. |
| `M8013` | warning | `turbine-overspeed-hazard` | Turbopump shaft '<shaft>' speed (<value> RPM) exceeds maximum burst rating (<maxRpm> RPM). |
| `M8014` | error | `closed-flow-circuit` | Pump '<pumpId>' discharge is completely blocked with no open valve or recirculation path. |

## Example ROCETS Engine Deck

```rocets
DECK: GasGeneratorCycleEngine
TITLE: "Gas Generator Cycle Cryogenic Engine"

COMPONENTS:
  OPUMP TYPE=PUMP TITLE="LOX Turbopump" X=100 Y=150
    PARAMS: DELTA_P=14.0E6, ETA=0.78, RHO=1140.0
    PORTS: IN_P=0.3E6 FLUID=LOX DIR=in, OUT_P=14.3E6 FLUID=LOX DIR=out

  FPUMP TYPE=PUMP TITLE="LH2 Turbopump" X=100 Y=320
    PARAMS: DELTA_P=18.0E6, ETA=0.74, RHO=71.0
    PORTS: IN_P=0.2E6 FLUID=LH2 DIR=in, OUT_P=18.2E6 FLUID=LH2 DIR=out

  TURB01 TYPE=TURBINE TITLE="Drive Gas Turbine" X=320 Y=240
    PARAMS: PR=1.65, ETA=0.74, T_IN=950.0
    PORTS: IN_P=15.0E6, OUT_P=9.1E6

  SHAFT01 TYPE=SHAFT TITLE="Main Turbopump Shaft" X=210 Y=240
    PARAMS: INERTIA=0.1, SPEED_RPM=32000.0, MAX_RPM=40000.0
    S0: SPEED_RPM=32000.0

  CHAMBER TYPE=CHAMBER TITLE="Main Thrust Chamber" X=550 Y=240
    PARAMS: PC=10.0E6, MR=6.0, AT=0.035, EPS=50.0, VC=0.02
    S0: PC=10.0E6

  MAIN_OX_VALVE TYPE=VALVE TITLE="Main Oxidizer Valve" X=350 Y=150
    PARAMS: CV=0.005, POSITION=1.0

CONNECTIONS:
  OPUMP.OUT_P -> MAIN_OX_VALVE.IN_P
  MAIN_OX_VALVE.OUT_P -> CHAMBER.IN_OX
  FPUMP.OUT_P -> CHAMBER.IN_FUEL
  TURB01.OUT_P -> CHAMBER.IN_GAS
  SHAFT01.TORQUE_TURB -> TURB01.TORQUE
  SHAFT01.TORQUE_PUMP -> FPUMP.TORQUE
```

## Command Line Interface (`msx rocets`)

ModelScript provides full headless CLI tooling for NASA ROCETS models:

```bash
# Pre-flight linting of an engine deck
msx rocets lint engine.roc

# Print engine architecture summary and flow connections
msx rocets summary engine.roc

# Solve steady-state power and flow balance
msx rocets balance engine.roc --target-pc=12E6 --mr=6.0

# Simulate dynamic ignition and ramp transient
msx rocets simulate engine.roc --t-end=2.0

# Project to executable Modelica 3.x
msx rocets to-modelica engine.roc --out=Engine.mo

# Export to FMI 2.0/3.0 System Structure Description (SSP)
msx rocets to-ssp engine.roc --out=SystemStructure.ssd

# Render vector P&ID flow diagram
msx rocets diagram engine.roc --out=pid.svg
```

## VS Code & Web IDE Custom Editor

The `@modelscript/ide-client` package provides a dedicated dual-mode custom editor (`modelscript.rocetsEditor`):

- **P&ID Vector Schematic**: Interactive diagram with propellant stream color coding, zoom/pan navigation, and SVG export.
- **Engine Balance Panel**: Shaft power metrics, chamber stagnation conditions, sea level / vacuum thrust, and $I_{sp}$.
- **Start Transient Viewer**: Ignition ODE trajectory table and graphs ($P_c(t)$, $\text{RPM}(t)$, $F(t)$, $T_w(t)$).
- **Module Netlist**: Filterable tabular listing of modules, parameters, and ports.
- **Pre-Flight Diagnostics**: Live diagnostic warnings and error badges with click-to-line navigation.
- **Projections**: Side-by-side Modelica and FMI SSP code viewers with one-click export.
