# CCSDS Astrodynamics & Space Telemetry (`.oem`, `.opm`, `.omm`, `.xtce`)

`@modelscript/ccsds` (`languages/ccsds`) provides comprehensive compiler, trajectory propagation, and verification support for the **Consultative Committee for Space Data Systems (CCSDS)** and **OMG XML Telemetric & Command Exchange (XTCE)** standards.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension       | Standard / Specification                        | Engineering Domain                                         |
| :-------------- | :---------------------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.oem`          | **CCSDS 502.0-B-2** Orbit Ephemeris Message     | Time-tagged position and velocity state vector ephemerides |
| `.opm`          | **CCSDS 502.0-B-2** Orbit Parameter Message     | Osculating Keplerian orbital elements and maneuvers        |
| `.omm`          | **CCSDS 502.0-B-2** Orbit Mean-Elements Message | Mean orbital elements (SGP4/SDP4 TLE compatible)           |
| `.xtce`, `.xml` | **OMG XTCE v1.2** Telemetric & Command Exchange | Bit-level satellite telemetry decommutation and commanding |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Perturbed 6-DOF Cowell Orbit Propagator

- Integrates high-fidelity gravitational and environmental perturbations in Cartesian J2000 / GCRF coordinates:
  $$\ddot{\mathbf{r}} = -\frac{\mu}{r^3}\mathbf{r} + \mathbf{a}_{J_2} + \mathbf{a}_{\text{drag}} + \mathbf{a}_{\text{SRP}} + \mathbf{a}_{\text{3rd}}$$
- **$J_2$ Earth Oblateness**: Evaluates central body oblateness forces from zonal harmonic coefficients.
- **Atmospheric Drag**: Exponential barometric and Jacchia-Roberts atmospheric density models coupled with satellite cross-sectional area and drag coefficient $C_D$.
- **Solar Radiation Pressure (SRP)**: Cannonball radiation pressure models with cylindrical and dual-cone solar eclipse shadowing.
- **Third-Body Gravitation**: Lunar and solar ephemeris gravitational perturbations.

### 2. OMG XTCE Bit-Packing & Decommutation Engine

- Parses hierarchical `<TelemetryMetaData>`, `<ParameterSet>`, `<ContainerSet>`, and `<SequenceContainer>` schemas.
- Validates bit-level alignments, integer sign encodings (twos-complement, sign-magnitude), IEEE 754 float packaging, and calibrated polynomial transfer functions.

### 3. Direct DAE Lowering

- Compiles orbital states and spacecraft attitudes directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` SoA linear memory arena for joint trajectory and attitude determination simulations.

### 4. Polyglot Projections & TGG Mappings

- **Modelica Export (`ccsdsToModelica`)**: Generates continuous Modelica 3.x space flight models compatible with orbital physics libraries.
- **SysML v2 Mission Architecture (`ccsdsToSysml`)**: Projects ground station contacts, communication downlink schedules, and orbit maintenance requirements into SysML v2 `part def` and `requirement def` hierarchies.

---

## Static Analysis & Pre-Flight Linter Rules

The CCSDS analyzer enforces space mission integrity and flight safety constraints (`M8201`–`M8208`):

### Diagnostics for CCSDS (8 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M8201` | error | `sub-orbital-impact-trajectory` | Sub-orbital pericenter radius <rp> km is below Earth radius <earthRadius> km, resulting in atmospheric re-entry or impact. |
| `M8202` | error | `telemetry-bit-packing-overlap` | Telemetry bit packing overlap in container '<containerName>': entry '<entryName>' starts at bit <bitOffset> before previous entry '<prevEntry>' ends at bit <endBit>. |
| `M8203` | warning | `hyperbolic-unbounded-orbit` | Orbit eccentricity <eccentricity> indicates a hyperbolic or parabolic trajectory. |
| `M8204` | error | `unrecognized-reference-frame` | Unrecognized or non-inertial reference frame '<refFrame>'. |
| `M8205` | error | `missing-epoch-timestamp` | Ephemeris point missing valid timestamp at index <index>. |
| `M8206` | error | `non-monotonic-ephemeris-epochs` | Ephemeris timestamp '<epoch>' is not strictly greater than previous timestamp '<prevEpoch>'. |
| `M8207` | error | `duplicate-parameter-name` | Duplicate telemetry parameter declaration for '<paramName>'. |
| `M8208` | error | `negative-spacecraft-mass` | Spacecraft mass <massKg> kg must be strictly positive. |

---

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Lint an Orbit Ephemeris Message or XTCE container definition
msx ccsds lint mission_orbit.oem
msx ccsds lint satellite_telemetry.xtce

# Propagate trajectory and lower to DAE linear memory
msx ccsds to-dae orbit.opm --duration 86400 --step 60

# Project orbital state vectors into Modelica simulation code
msx ccsds to-modelica orbit.opm -o OrbitDynamics.mo

# Export orbital mission constraints to SysML v2 requirements
msx ccsds to-sysml orbit.omm -o OrbitRequirements.sysml
```

# EASY5 Dynamic Simulation & Linear Control (`.ez5`, `.ezm`, `.ezd`, `.eas`)

The `@modelscript/easy5` package (`languages/easy5`) provides native support for **Boeing / MSC Software EASY5™** dynamic system simulation models, control block diagrams, and empirical table lookups. It delivers multi-syntax parsing, embedded Fortran user block (`UG`/`UX`) compilation via `@modelscript/fortran`, pre-flight static topological linting (`M7001`–`M7012`) including Tarjan algebraic cycle detection, direct continuous DAE arena lowering (`IDaeBuilder`), linear control system analysis (trim solver, numerical $(A, B, C, D)$ Jacobian extraction, QR eigenvalue/pole analysis, Bode frequency sweeps), multi-domain projections to **Modelica 3.x** and **FMI SSP**, and interactive AntV X6 / SVG schematic diagram generation.

---

## Supported File Specifications

| Extension           | Format                   | Key Structural Features                                                                                   |
| :------------------ | :----------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **`.ez5` / `.ezm`** | Modern Model Definition  | Tagged `MODEL`, `COMPONENTS`, `XP`, `S0`, `CONNECTIONS`, `TABLES` blocks with graphical layout attributes |
| **`.ezd` / `.eas`** | Classical Card Deck      | Fixed-field component, parameter, and connection card images with continuation flags                      |
| **`.tab`**          | Empirical Lookup Tables  | 1D and 2D tabular lookup arrays for nonlinear characteristics ($f(x)$ or $f(x, y)$)                       |
| **`.f` / `.for`**   | User General (`UG`/`UX`) | Embedded or referenced Fortran 77/90 routines computing custom nonlinear dynamics                         |

---

## Architecture & Compilation Pipeline

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    SRC["EASY5 Model (.ez5, .ezm, .ezd, .eas, .tab)"]

    subgraph FrontEnd["Parser & Static Analysis"]
        PARSER["EASY5 Parser & Table Reader"]
        FORTRAN["Fortran User-Code Bridge (@modelscript/fortran)"]
        INDEX["Easy5WorkspaceIndex (Symbol Table)"]
        LINT["Pre-flight Topology Linter (M7001–M7012)"]
        TARJAN["Tarjan SCC Direct-Feedthrough Cycle Detector"]
    end

    subgraph Core["Analytical & Numerical Solvers"]
        DAE["Continuous DAE Arena Lowering (IDaeBuilder)"]
        TRIM["Operating Point Trim Solver (Levenberg-Marquardt)"]
        JAC["Numerical Linearization (A, B, C, D Matrices)"]
        EIG["QR Eigenvalues, Poles & Damping Ratios"]
        BODE["Logarithmic Frequency Response (Bode Curves)"]
    end

    subgraph Projections["Multi-Domain Projections"]
        MO["Modelica 3.x Blocks Projection (easy5ToModelica)"]
        SSP["FMI SystemStructure.ssd XML (easy5ToSsp)"]
    end

    subgraph Presentation["User Experience & Toolchain"]
        DIAG["AntV X6 & SVG Schematic Diagram"]
        IDE["Dual-Mode Visual Custom Editor (VS Code)"]
        CLI["CLI Toolchain (msx easy5, msx lint)"]
        LSP["Language Server Protocol Services"]
    end

    SRC --> PARSER
    PARSER --> FORTRAN
    PARSER --> INDEX --> LINT & TARJAN
    INDEX --> DAE
    DAE --> TRIM --> JAC --> EIG & BODE
    INDEX --> MO & SSP
    INDEX --> DIAG & IDE & CLI & LSP
```

## 1. Standard General Purpose (GP) Library Catalog

`@modelscript/easy5` includes built-in operational descriptors for standard EASY5 General Purpose library blocks:

| Block ID | Name                 | Mathematical Transfer Function / Formulation                                                          | Key Parameters (`XP`)                      | States (`S`)                      |
| :------- | :------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------- | :-------------------------------- | -------------------------- | ---- |
| **`GA`** | Proportional Gain    | $y(t) = K \cdot u(t)$                                                                                 | `K` (Gain factor)                          | None                              |
| **`SJ`** | Summing Junction     | $y(t) = \sum_{i=1}^m \text{SGN}_i \cdot u_i(t)$                                                       | `SGN1`, `SGN2`, `SGN3` ($\pm 1.0$)         | None                              |
| **`IN`** | Integrator           | $\dot{x}(t) = K \cdot u(t),\quad y(t) = x(t)$                                                         | `GAIN`, `S0` (Initial state), `UL`, `LL`   | 1 continuous state                |
| **`TF`** | Transfer Function    | $Y(s) = \frac{b_m s^m + \dots + b_0}{a_n s^n + \dots + a_0} U(s)$                                     | `NUM` (array), `DEN` (array)               | $n$ continuous states             |
| **`LA`** | First-Order Lead-Lag | $Y(s) = K \frac{\tau_1 s + 1}{\tau_2 s + 1} U(s)$                                                     | `GAIN`, `TAU1`, `TAU2`                     | 1 continuous state ($\tau_2 > 0$) |
| **`LM`** | Hard Limiter         | $y(t) = \max(u_{\min}, \min(u_{\max}, u(t)))$                                                         | `UL` (Upper limit), `LL` (Lower limit)     | None                              |
| **`DZ`** | Deadband             | $y(t) = \begin{cases} u - \delta & u > \delta \\ u + \delta & u < -\delta \\ 0 &                      | u                                          | \le \delta \end{cases}$           | `DB` (Deadband half-width) | None |
| **`HY`** | Hysteresis Switch    | Relay with toggle thresholds $u_{on}, u_{off}$                                                        | `U_ON`, `U_OFF`, `Y_HIGH`, `Y_LOW`         | None (Discrete memory)            |
| **`TD`** | Transport Delay      | $y(t) = u(t - \tau)$                                                                                  | `TAU` (Delay time in seconds)              | Buffer ring                       |
| **`SW`** | Controlled Switch    | $y(t) = \begin{cases} u_1(t) & u_{ctrl} \ge u_{thresh} \\ u_2(t) & u_{ctrl} < u_{thresh} \end{cases}$ | `THRESH` (Switch threshold)                | None                              |
| **`FN`** | Table Function       | $y(t) = \operatorname{interp}(u(t), X, Y)$                                                            | `TABLE_NAME`, `ORDER` (1=linear, 2=spline) | None                              |
| **`UG`** | User General         | Custom dynamics specified in Fortran 77/90                                                            | User-defined parameters                    | User-defined ($S(i), SD(i)$)      |

## 2. Pre-Flight Diagnostic Rules (`lintEasy5`)

ModelScript evaluates 12 formal pre-flight diagnostic rules before simulation, linearization, or projection:

### Diagnostics for EASY5 (12 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M7001` | warning | `unconnected-input-port` | Input port '<comp>.<port>' has no incoming connection. |
| `M7002` | error | `csmf-algebraic-loop` | Direct feedthrough algebraic loop detected with no continuous state or delay: <value>. |
| `M7003` | error | `duplicate-component-id` | Duplicate component identifier '<id>' in model. |
| `M7004` | info | `uninitialized-state` | Continuous state in component '<comp>' defaults to 0.0 with no explicit S0 specified. |
| `M7005` | error | `improper-transfer-function` | Transfer function in component '<comp>' is improper: numerator degree (<degNum>) exceeds denominator degree (<degDen>). |
| `M7006` | error | `parameter-out-of-bounds` | Parameter '<param>' in component '<comp>' is out of valid bounds: <reason>. |
| `M7007` | error | `port-dimension-mismatch` | Connection width mismatch from '<from>' (dim <dim1>) to '<to>' (dim <dim2>). |
| `M7008` | error | `state-index-out-of-bounds` | State index S(<idx>) in component '<comp>' exceeds allocated continuous states (<max>). |
| `M7009` | warning | `sample-rate-mismatch` | Sample rate mismatch between '<from>' (<rate1>s) and '<to>' (<rate2>s) without rate transition block. |
| `M7010` | error | `user-fortran-syntax-error` | User Fortran subroutine in '<comp>' has defect: <detail> |
| `M7011` | warning | `unstable-linear-pole` | Component '<comp>' has open-loop pole in right-half plane (Re = +<value>), indicating open-loop instability. |
| `M7012` | warning | `table-extrapolation-hazard` | Component '<comp>' references table '<tableName>' without bounded extrapolation protection. |

## 3. Direct Continuous DAE Arena Lowering (`lowerEasy5ToDae`)

ModelScript's data-oriented WebAssembly linear-memory DAE arena compiles EASY5 models directly into struct-of-arrays without intermediate TypeScript AST objects:

- Continuous states $S(i)$ become continuous variables with derivative bindings $\text{der}(x_i) = f_i(x, u)$.
- Initial states $S_0$ become start attributes on continuous state variables.
- Summing junctions, gains, limiters, and lookup functions become lowered arena expression IDs (`ExprId`) and equality equations (`EqId`).
- Embedded Fortran blocks evaluate expressions directly mapped into DAE equation nodes.

---

## 4. Linear Control Systems Engine (`linear/`)

The linear control package provides exact numerical state-space modeling for control design and frequency domain verification:

### State-Space Extraction ($A, B, C, D$)

Linearizes the continuous non-linear system around an operating point $(x_0, u_0)$:

$$\dot{x} = A x + B u,\quad y = C x + D u$$

Where:
$$A_{ij} = \frac{\partial \dot{x}_i}{\partial x_j},\quad B_{ik} = \frac{\partial \dot{x}_i}{\partial u_k},\quad C_{pj} = \frac{\partial y_p}{\partial x_j},\quad D_{pk} = \frac{\partial y_p}{\partial u_k}$$

Computed via central finite differences:
$$\frac{\partial f_i}{\partial x_j} \approx \frac{f_i(x_0 + \varepsilon e_j, u_0) - f_i(x_0 - \varepsilon e_j, u_0)}{2\varepsilon}$$

### Equilibrium Operating Point Trim Solver

Solves $\dot{x}(x, u) = 0$ using Levenberg-Marquardt damped least-squares:

$$(J^T J + \lambda I) \Delta x = -J^T \dot{x}(x, u)$$

### Eigenvalue & Stability Analysis

Computes closed-loop poles $s_i = \sigma_i \pm j \omega_i$ using the **QR algorithm with Wilkinson shifts**:

- Natural frequency: $\omega_{n,i} = \sqrt{\sigma_i^2 + \omega_i^2}$
- Damping ratio: $\zeta_i = -\frac{\sigma_i}{\omega_{n,i}}$
- Stability criterion: $\sigma_i \le 0$ for all $i$

### Bode Frequency Response Sweeps

Solves the complex resolvent system $(j \omega I - A) X(j\omega) = B$ at logarithmically spaced frequencies:
$$G(j\omega) = C X(j\omega) + D$$

- Magnitude (dB): $20 \log_{10} |G(j\omega)|$
- Phase (degrees): $\operatorname{atan2}(\operatorname{Im} G(j\omega), \operatorname{Re} G(j\omega)) \cdot \frac{180}{\pi}$

---

## 5. Cross-Language Projections

### Projection to Modelica 3.x (`easy5ToModelica`)

Translates EASY5 continuous control blocks into canonical `Modelica.Blocks` continuous models:

```modelica
// Modelica projection generated from EASY5 model: FlightController
model FlightController
  // Component instances
  Modelica.Blocks.Math.Gain GA01(k = 5.0);
  Modelica.Blocks.Math.Add SJ01;
  Modelica.Blocks.Continuous.Integrator IN01(k = 1.0, y_start = 0.0);
  Modelica.Blocks.Continuous.TransferFunction LA01(b = {0.1, 1.0}, a = {0.02, 1.0});
  Modelica.Blocks.Nonlinear.Limiter LM01(uMax = 10.0, uMin = -10.0);
equation
  connect(GA01.y, SJ01.u1);
  connect(SJ01.y, IN01.u);
  connect(IN01.y, LA01.u);
  connect(LA01.y, LM01.u);
end FlightController;
```

### Projection to FMI SystemStructure (`easy5ToSsp`)

Exports complete multi-component topologies as FMI 2.0/3.0 `SystemStructure.ssd` XML containers for co-simulation orchestration.

## 6. Command-Line Interface (`msx easy5`)

```bash
# Model inspection and topological summary
msx easy5 summary controller.ez5

# Pre-flight linter (including algebraic loop check)
msx easy5 lint controller.ez5
msx lint controller.ez5 --language=easy5

# Numerical linearization to A, B, C, D state-space matrices
msx easy5 linearize controller.ez5

# Bode plot logarithmic frequency response calculation
msx easy5 bode controller.ez5 --min-freq=0.01 --max-freq=1000 --num-points=60

# Translation to Modelica 3.x
msx easy5 to-modelica controller.ez5 --out=Controller.mo

# Export to FMI SystemStructure.ssd
msx easy5 to-ssp controller.ez5 --out=SystemStructure.ssd

# Export SVG schematic diagram
msx easy5 diagram controller.ez5 --out=schematic.svg
```

# AUTOSAR Classic & Adaptive Architecture

ModelScript delivers native, high-performance compiler support for **AUTOSAR** (`.arxml`), the international standard for automotive electronic control unit (ECU) software architectures. Engineers can parse, validate, simulate event-triggered and periodic runnables, and bridge automotive software components (SWCs) directly into continuous plant models and SysML v2 systems requirements.

---

## Capabilities & Supported Formats

| Format                     | Extension        | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| :------------------------- | :--------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **AUTOSAR ARXML Document** | `.arxml`, `.xml` | XML schema defining packages, software component types (`ApplicationSwComponentType`, `SensorActuatorSwComponentType`), internal behaviors, runnables, timing events, interfaces, and ECU network topologies. |

### Key Architectural Pillars

- **High-Throughput ARXML Ingestion:**
  - Robust XML extraction parsing software component definitions, client-server and sender-receiver interfaces, port prototypes, variable access definitions, runnable entities, and timing events via `parseArxml()`.
- **In-Memory Virtual RTE Simulation Engine:**
  - Implements an event-driven and periodic discrete scheduler (`VirtualRte`) reproducing AUTOSAR RTE semantics (`Rte_Read`, `Rte_Write`).
  - Routes signals across hierarchical assembly connectors (`AssemblySwConnector`) between provider P-ports and requester R-ports.
- **Automotive Static Linters (`M7401`–`M7408`):**
  - Detects unconnected required ports, interface signature mismatches, Worst-Case Execution Time (WCET) budget overruns against event periods, overlapping signal allocations in CAN/LIN PDUs, and cyclic runnable dependencies.
- **Dual Architectural Projections:**
  - **Modelica Standard Blocks:** Translates SWCs into acausal discrete blocks for Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) co-simulation with 1D vehicle plant dynamics.
  - **SysML v2 Systems Architecture:** Generates formal OMG SysML v2 `part def` hierarchies, connection usages, and port definitions for digital thread traceability.
- **Continuous/Discrete DAE Lowering:**
  - Compiles SWC states, calibrated calibration parameters, and discrete runnable step functions into the `DAEBuilder` SoA linear memory arena.

---

## Command Line Interface (`msx autosar`)

ModelScript CLI provides turnkey subcommands for automotive ECU engineering:

```bash
msx autosar <action> [files...] [options]
```

| Action             | Description                                                                                   | Key Options                                             |
| :----------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------ |
| **`inspect`**      | Dumps package hierarchy, SWC components, runnable entities, timing events, and network PDUs.  | —                                                       |
| **`lint`**         | Runs pre-flight automotive semantic checks, interface compatibility, and scheduling analysis. | —                                                       |
| **`to-modelica`**  | Generates Modelica standard blocks representing SWC interfaces and communication buses.       | `--out=<file.mo>`                                       |
| **`to-sysml`**     | Projects AUTOSAR composition architecture to formal OMG SysML v2 code.                        | `--out=<file.sysml>`                                    |
| **`to-dae`**       | Lowers software architecture into ModelScript linear-memory DAE arena and prints statistics.  | —                                                       |
| **`simulate-rte`** | Executes the Virtual RTE discrete event scheduler over a configured time window.              | `--duration=<sec>`, `--step=<sec>`, `--out=<file.json>` |

### Examples

```bash
# Inspect automotive software components and timing events
msx autosar inspect PowertrainArchitecture.arxml

# Lint for unconnected R-ports, timing budget overflows, or PDU collisions
msx autosar lint BrakeController.arxml

# Project software component architecture to SysML v2 part definitions
msx autosar to-sysml SteeringSystem.arxml --out=SteeringArchitecture.sysml

# Simulate periodic runnable execution and signal routing through Virtual RTE
msx autosar simulate-rte PowertrainSystem.arxml --duration=0.5 --step=0.01 --out=rte_log.json
```

---

## Automotive Pre-Flight Linters & Diagnostic Rules

### Diagnostics for AUTOSAR (15 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M7401` | error | `unconnected-mandatory-port` | Required port '<portName>' on component '<compName>' (<typeName>) is unconnected in composition '<compSwc>'. |
| `M7402` | error | `interface-mismatch` | Interface mismatch in connector '<connName>': Provider port '<pPort>' provides '<pIf>' while requester port '<rPort>' requires '<rIf>'. |
| `M7403` | warning | `data-element-type-mismatch` | Data element '<deName>' in interface '<ifName>' has no data type reference. |
| `M7403` | error | `invalid-runnable-period` | Timing event for runnable '<symbol>' defines non-positive period (<period> s). |
| `M7404` | error | `duplicate-short-name` | Duplicate SHORT-NAME '<name>' detected in package '<pkg>'. |
| `M7405` | error | `invalid-data-type-mapping` | Invalid data type mapping for '<dtName>': <reason>. |
| `M7405` | error | `wcet-budget-overflow` | Execution time WCET (<wcetMs> ms) of runnable '<runnableName>' exceeds its timing event period (<periodMs> ms). |
| `M7406` | error | `circular-composition-dependency` | Circular software component composition dependency detected: <path>. |
| `M7406` | error | `overlapping-pdu-bits` | Signals '<sigA>' and '<sigB>' overlap bit index <bitIdx> in PDU '<pduName>'. |
| `M7407` | warning | `missing-software-address-method` | Variable data prototype '<variable>' lacks a declared SwAddrMethod memory section mapping. |
| `M7407` | error | `pdu-exceeds-frame-capacity` | PDU '<pduName>' length (<pduLen> bytes) exceeds CAN frame '<frameName>' payload capacity (<frameLen> bytes). |
| `M7408` | error | `cyclic-runnable-dependency` | Cyclic data dependency detected between runnables: '<value>'. |
| `M7408` | error | `incompatible-port-interface-direction` | Port '<portName>' interface direction violation: <reason>. |
| `M7409` | warning | `missing-internal-behavior` | Atomic software component '<swcName>' lacks internal behavior definition. |
| `M7410` | info | `untriggered-runnable` | Runnable entity '<rName>' in SWC '<swcName>' has no associated RTE trigger event. |

## Language Server Protocol & Registry Integration

AUTOSAR `.arxml` documents enjoy full language intelligence through `@modelscript/lsp`:

```typescript
import { parseArxml, lintAutosarModel, VirtualRte, autosarToModelica, autosarToSysml } from "@modelscript/autosar";

// Parse ARXML text
const model = parseArxml(arxmlText);

// Pre-flight static checking
const diagnostics = lintAutosarModel(model);

// Virtual RTE Execution
const rte = new VirtualRte(model);
rte.registerRunnable("PedalSensor", "RE_ReadPedal", (ctx) => {
  ctx.write("PedalOut", "Pos", 0.75);
});
rte.registerRunnable("EngineECU", "RE_ComputeThrottle", (ctx) => {
  const pedal = Number(ctx.read("PedalIn", "Pos"));
  ctx.write("ThrottleOut", "Cmd", pedal * 0.9);
});

// Advance 50 ms in 10 ms steps
const executionLog = rte.runUntil(0.05, 0.01);
```

# MATLAB Simulink Control Systems

ModelScript provides first-class, polyglot compiler support for **MATLAB Simulink** (`.slx`, `.mdl`) control models and dynamic block diagrams. Engineers can author, inspect, lint, formally lower to differential-algebraic equations (DAEs), and project Simulink systems into standard Modelica blocks without requiring a MATLAB license or desktop installation.

---

## Capabilities & Supported Formats

| Format                           | Extension | Description                                                                                                |
| :------------------------------- | :-------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Simulink Modern Zip Package**  | `.slx`    | Modern OPC XML archive packaging block hierarchy, solver configuration, and state routing.                 |
| **Simulink Classic ASCII Model** | `.mdl`    | Classic structured text block diagram specification with hierarchical `System`, `Block`, and `Line` trees. |

### Core Architectural Features

- **Native Binary & Text Parser:**
  - Fast, streaming unpacker and XML reader for `.slx` packages via `parseSlx()`.
  - Recursive descent structured parser and lossless roundtrip serializer for `.mdl` text files via `parseMdl()`.
- **Pre-Flight Control System Linters (`M7201`–`M7210`):**
  - Graph-theoretic algebraic loop detection via Tarjan's Strongly Connected Components (SCC) algorithm across direct-feedthrough blocks (`Gain`, `Sum`, `Product`).
  - Unconnected input ports, division-by-zero risks, port index mismatches, and multi-rate sample time conflicts.
- **Continuous & Discrete DAE Lowering:**
  - Directly maps standard block types (`Integrator`, `Gain`, `Sum`, `Constant`, `TransferFcn`, `UnitDelay`, `Saturation`) into `DAEBuilder` SoA linear memory arena.
  - Automatically transforms high-order continuous transfer functions $G(s) = \frac{N(s)}{D(s)}$ into Controllable Canonical Form (state-space realization).
  - Handles discrete sample-and-hold states for synchronous multirate execution.
- **Modelica Projection:**
  - Synthesizes idiomatic `Modelica.Blocks` continuous and discrete acausal models preserving block hierarchy, signal dimensions, and parameter arithmetic.
- **Language Server Protocol (LSP):**
  - Real-time diagnostic publication, hierarchical document outline (`DocumentSymbol`), contextual hover documentation, and quick-fixes in VS Code and web editors.

---

## Command Line Interface (`msx simulink`)

ModelScript CLI exposes turnkey subcommands for headless CI/CD and automation workflows:

```bash
msx simulink <action> [files...] [options]
```

| Action            | Description                                                                              | Key Options       |
| :---------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :---------------- |
| **`inspect`**     | Dumps block diagram hierarchy, solver settings, block counts, and connection topologies. | —                 |
| **`lint`**        | Runs pre-flight static analysis, algebraic loop detection, and semantic checks.          | —                 |
| **`to-modelica`** | Generates standard `Modelica.Blocks` source code.                                        | `--out=<file.mo>` |
| **`to-dae`**      | Compiles block diagram into ModelScript linear-memory DAE arena and prints statistics.   | —                 |

### Examples

```bash
# Inspect model parameters, sample times, and block topology
msx simulink inspect CruiseControl.slx

# Check for unconnected inputs, algebraic loops, or division-by-zero risks
msx simulink lint EngineGovernor.mdl

# Convert a Simulink controller into standard Modelica 3.x blocks
msx simulink to-modelica SuspensionControl.slx --out=SuspensionControl.mo

# Lower continuous and discrete equations into DAEBuilder arena
msx simulink to-dae FlightGuidance.mdl
```

## Control-Theoretic Linters & Diagnostic Rules

### Diagnostics for MATLAB Simulink (10 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M7201` | error | `unconnected-input-port` | Input port <portNumber> on block '<blockName>' (<blockType>) is unconnected. All input ports must be driven or terminated with a Ground block. |
| `M7202` | error | `direct-feedthrough-algebraic-loop` | Direct-feedthrough algebraic loop detected across blocks: [<loopNames>]. Control loops with direct algebraic feedthrough must contain at least one state delay (Integrator or UnitDelay) or will require an iterative non-linear solver. |
| `M7203` | error | `unresolved-subsystem-link` | SubSystem block '<blockName>' has no defined sub-diagram or unresolved library reference. |
| `M7204` | error | `port-index-out-of-bounds` | Block '<blockName>' has invalid port index <portNumber>. Port numbers must be positive integers (1, 2, ...). |
| `M7205` | warning | `multirate-sample-time-conflict` | Block '<blockName>' has invalid SampleTime <sampleTime>. SampleTime must be >= 0 (discrete) or -1 (inherited). |
| `M7206` | error | `non-numeric-parameter` | Block '<blockName>' parameter '<paramName>' contains non-finite value <value>. Parameters must evaluate to finite Real numbers. |
| `M7207` | error | `invalid-bus-selector` | BusSelector block '<blockName>' references signal '<signalName>' absent from the incoming bus schema from '<sourceBlock>'. |
| `M7208` | error | `duplicate-block-name` | Duplicate block name '<blockName>' found in subsystem scope '<systemName>'. Block names within a system must be unique. |
| `M7209` | warning | `divide-by-zero-risk` | Product/Divide block '<blockName>' performs division operations with inputs '<inputs>'; ensure denominator signal is protected against division by zero. |
| `M7210` | info | `missing-integrator-initial-condition` | Integrator block '<blockName>' does not specify an explicit 'InitialCondition'; defaulting to 0.0. |

> [!TIP]
> Algebraic loops detected by `M7202` can often be broken without physical fidelity loss by inserting a `UnitDelay` (discrete) or by modeling small actuator/sensor inertia via a first-order lag `TransferFcn` (continuous).

---

## Language Server Protocol & Registry Integration

Simulink is fully integrated with `@modelscript/lsp` via `SimulinkWorkspaceIndex`:

```typescript
import { parseSimulink, lintSimulinkModel, simulinkToModelica, lowerSimulinkToDae } from "@modelscript/simulink";

// Parse .mdl or .slx buffer
const model = parseSimulink(fileContent);

// Run static linting
const diagnostics = lintSimulinkModel(model);

// Project to Modelica standard blocks
const modelicaCode = simulinkToModelica(model);

// Lower directly to linear-memory DAE arena
const dae = lowerSimulinkToDae(model);
console.log(`Variables: ${dae.varCount}, Equations: ${dae.eqCount}`);
```

# GT-SUITE / GT-POWER Modeling (`.gtm`, `.gtd`, `.gtx`, `.gt`)

The `@modelscript/gtsuite` package (`languages/gtsuite`) provides native compilation, simulation, analysis, and multi-domain projections for **Gamma Technologies GT-SUITE and GT-POWER** 1D engine, powertrain, turbocharging, and thermo-fluid dynamic simulation models.

| **`.gdx` / `.csv`** | Trajectory Results     | Crank-resolved in-cylinder pressure, temperature, burn rate, and emissions time series             |

## Pre-Flight Powertrain Linter Rules

### Diagnostics for GT-SUITE (15 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M9001` | warning | `cfl-acoustic-violation` | Pipe '<pipeId>' cell length violates acoustic CFL condition: simulation dt (<value> \\xB5s) exceeds stability limit (<value> \\xB5s). |
| `M9002` | warning | `compressor-surge-hazard` | Compressor '<compId>' operating point (PR = <value>, \\u1E41 = <value> kg/s) falls into the aerodynamic surge region. |
| `M9003` | warning | `compressor-choke-limit` | Compressor '<compId>' mass flow (<value> kg/s) exceeds maximum choke/stonewall sonic flow capacity. |
| `M9004` | error | `valve-profile-overlap-error` | Valve '<valveId>' kinematic profile defect: <reason>. |
| `M9005` | error | `compression-ratio-invalid` | Cylinder '<cylId>' compression ratio (<value>) is physically unrealistic (must be between 6.0 and 26.0). |
| `M9006` | error | `unconnected-plenum-node` | Flow split or plenum '<plenumId>' has no connected flow paths or boundary conditions. |
| `M9007` | warning | `discharge-coefficient-out-of-bounds` | Valve or orifice '<valveId>' discharge coefficient (<value>) is non-physical (must satisfy 0.0 < Cd <= 1.0). |
| `M9008` | warning | `knock-margin-deficit` | Cylinder '<cylId>' operates in severe autoignition/knock hazard (CR = <value>, ignition anchor = <value>\\xB0 CA BTDC). |
| `M9009` | error | `missing-boundary-pressure` | Environment node '<envId>' has invalid or uninitialized static pressure (<= 0 Pa). |
| `M9010` | warning | `turbine-expansion-ratio-excess` | Turbine '<turbId>' expansion ratio (<value>) exceeds single-stage choked limit (> 4.5). |
| `M9011` | warning | `intercooler-effectiveness-invalid` | Intercooler '<icId>' thermal effectiveness (<value>) violates 2nd Law of Thermodynamics (must satisfy 0.0 < eff <= 1.0). |
| `M9012` | error | `air-fuel-equivalence-out-of-bounds` | Air-fuel equivalence ratio lambda (<value>) is outside combustible flammability limits (0.50 <= lambda <= 2.50). |
| `M9013` | error | `negative-pipe-dimensions` | Pipe '<pipeId>' has non-positive <dim> (<value> m). |
| `M9014` | error | `injector-timing-conflict` | Injector '<injId>' start of injection (<value>\\xB0 CA) falls outside valid cycle window (-360\\xB0 to +720\\xB0). |
| `M9015` | warning | `isolated-shaft-inertia` | Turbocharger shaft '<shaftId>' has no linked compressor or turbine rotating components. |

---

## Headless CLI Operations (`msx gtsuite`)

```bash
# Print model summary
msx gtsuite summary cases/Turbo4Cyl.gtm

# Export vector schematic SVG diagram
msx gtsuite diagram cases/Turbo4Cyl.gtm --view=schematic --out=engine_schematic.svg

# Project to Modelica and SysML v2
msx gtsuite to-modelica cases/Turbo4Cyl.gtm --out=Engine.mo
msx gtsuite to-sysml2 cases/Turbo4Cyl.gtm --out=Engine.sysml
```

# OpenDRIVE Road Networks (`.xodr`)

`@modelscript/opendrive` (`languages/opendrive`) provides compiler, analytical 3D clothoid sampling, path-following DAE lowering, and vehicle dynamics integration for the **ASAM OpenDRIVE** standard.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension       | Standard / Format            | Description                                                               |
| :-------------- | :--------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `.xodr`, `.xml` | **ASAM OpenDRIVE v1.4–v1.7** | Description of road networks, lanes, junctions, and spatial road geometry |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Analytical 3D Fresnel Clothoid Sampling

- Evaluates road reference lines parameterized by arc length $s$ with smooth curvature transitions:
  - **Euler Clothoids**: Spiral transitions computed via numerical Fresnel integrals:
    $$x(s) = x_0 + \int_0^s \cos\left(\theta_0 + \kappa_0 \tau + \frac{\dot{\kappa}}{2}\tau^2\right) d\tau$$
  - **Arcs & Polynomials**: Straight lines, constant-curvature circular arcs, and cubic parameter polynomials.
- Computes elevation profiles ($z(s)$), crossfall/camber angles, and superelevation banking.

### 2. Multi-Lane Topology & Junction Network

- Analyzes lane sections (`<laneSection>`), driving lanes, sidewalks, and shoulders.
- Reconstructs predecessor/successor road connections, junction path conflicts, and lane boundary polylines.

### 3. Path-Following Vehicle DAE Lowering

- Compiles OpenDRIVE tracks directly into curvilinear Frenet-Serret coordinates ($s, d, \theta_e$) within `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` arena:
  $$\dot{s} = \frac{v \cos \theta_e}{1 - d \cdot \kappa(s)}, \quad \dot{d} = v \sin \theta_e, \quad \dot{\theta}_e = \dot{\psi} - \dot{s}\kappa(s)$$
- Enables high-speed closed-loop vehicle chassis simulation with [@modelscript/simpack](./simpack.md) and [@modelscript/adams](./adams.md).

### 4. GENSYS Track Export

- Projections (`opendrive-to-gensys.ts`) convert OpenDRIVE centerlines and gauge profiles into GENSYS `.geom` and `.trax` geometry files for railway and guideway vehicle testing.

---

## Static Analysis & Pre-Flight Linter Rules

### Diagnostics for ASAM OpenDRIVE (8 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M7801` | error | `road-tangency-discontinuity` | Tangency discontinuity between geometry segments in road '<roadId>' at s=<s>: position gap <value>m, heading gap <value>rad. |
| `M7802` | error | `unlinked-lane-boundary` | Unlinked lane connection: lane '<laneId>' in road '<roadId>' links to non-existent <dir> lane '<targetId>'. |
| `M7803` | error | `clothoid-curvature-divergence` | Clothoid curvature rate of change in road '<roadId>' at s=<s> diverges (<value> 1/m^2). |
| `M7804` | warning | `overlapping-junction-paths` | Connecting path in junction '<junctionId>' between road '<road1>' and '<road2>' conflicts without priority control. |
| `M7805` | warning | `elevation-gradient-extreme` | Extreme elevation gradient in road '<roadId>' at s=<s>: slope <value>% exceeds standard 15% safety threshold. |
| `M7806` | error | `negative-lane-width` | Negative or zero lane width in lane '<laneId>' of road '<roadId>' at sOffset=<sOffset>m. |
| `M7807` | error | `duplicate-road-id` | Duplicate road ID '<roadId>' detected in roadway network. |
| `M7808` | error | `missing-center-lane` | Lane section in road '<roadId>' at s=<s> is missing mandatory center lane (ID 0). |

---

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Lint an OpenDRIVE road network
msx opendrive lint HighwayInterchange.xodr

# Sample 3D road centerline and lane boundaries at 0.5m resolution
msx opendrive track HighwayInterchange.xodr --step 0.5 -o track_points.json

# Lower road geometry to DAE path-following arena
msx opendrive to-dae HighwayInterchange.xodr --out=road.dae.json

# Project into GENSYS track geometry format
msx opendrive to-gensys HighwayInterchange.xodr -o TrackGeometry.geom
```

# ASAM OpenSCENARIO Autonomous Driving (`.xosc`, `.osc`)

`@modelscript/openscenario` (`languages/openscenario`) provides zero-regex XML and domain DSL parsing, dynamic scenario orchestration, Time-To-Collision (TTC) monitoring, Mobileye Responsibility-Sensitive Safety (RSS) margin verification, linear DAE lowering, and Modelica 3.x projection for **ASAM OpenSCENARIO 1.x & 2.0** autonomous vehicle validation scenarios.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension | Format                    | Description                                                                          |
| :-------- | :------------------------ | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.xosc`   | ASAM OpenSCENARIO 1.x XML | XML-based scenario description (storyboards, entities, maneuvers, triggers, actions) |
| `.osc`    | ASAM OpenSCENARIO 2.0 DSL | Domain-specific declarative and imperative scenario language for AV test generation  |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Dynamic Scenario Orchestrator

- Executes storyboard acts, maneuver groups, and event-condition-action triggers across moving entities (ego vehicle, NPC traffic vehicles, pedestrians, cyclists):
  - **Triggers**: Simulation time, relative longitudinal distance, headway time, velocity thresholds, reach position.
  - **Actions**: Longitudinal speed change ($a(t)$), lane change ($\dot{y}(t)$), lateral offset, waypoint trajectory following.
- Couples directly with analytical clothoid road geometry imported from **ASAM OpenDRIVE** ([`@modelscript/opendrive`](./opendrive.md)).

### 2. Time-To-Collision (TTC) & Mobileye RSS Safety Verification

- Continuously evaluates kinematic safety margins between the autonomous vehicle ($E$) and surrounding traffic ($T$):
  - **Time-To-Collision (TTC)**:
    $$\text{TTC} = \frac{x_{\text{lead}} - x_{\text{ego}}}{v_{\text{ego}} - v_{\text{lead}}} \quad (\text{for } v_{\text{ego}} > v_{\text{lead}})$$
  - **Mobileye RSS Longitudinal Safe Distance**:
    $$d_{\text{min,long}} = \left[ v_r \cdot \rho + \frac{1}{2} a_{\text{max,acc}} \rho^2 + \frac{(v_r + \rho a_{\text{max,acc}})^2}{2 a_{\text{min,brake}}} - \frac{v_f^2}{2 a_{\text{max,brake}}} \right]_+$$
    where $\rho$ is sensor reaction time, $a_{\text{max,acc}}$ is maximum acceleration, and $a_{\text{min,brake}}$ is minimum emergency braking deceleration.

### 3. Direct DAE Lowering

- Lowers entity kinematics (position, heading $\psi$, velocity $v$, acceleration $a$) into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` linear memory arena.
- Enables co-simulation with vehicle multibody dynamics ([`@modelscript/simpack`](./simpack.md), [`@modelscript/adams`](./adams.md)) and powertrain control loops ([`@modelscript/simulink`](./simulink.md)).

### 4. Bidirectional Modelica 3.x Projection

- Projects scenario storyboards into Modelica vehicle tracking and path-following controllers.

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics

The OpenSCENARIO analyzer validates actor references, trigger reachability, and safety margins:

### Diagnostics for ASAM OpenSCENARIO (10 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M8501` | error | `dangling-entity-reference` | Entity '<entityName>' referenced in '<contextName>' is not defined in Entities catalog. |
| `M8502` | warning | `unsatisfiable-trigger` | Trigger condition '<conditionName>' is unsatisfiable: <reason>. |
| `M8503` | error | `unreachable-road-position` | Road position specifies invalid road ID '<roadId>' or lane index '<laneId>'. |
| `M8504` | error | `cyclic-event-trigger` | Circular trigger condition detected between event '<eventA>' and event '<eventB>'. |
| `M8505` | error | `missing-ego-entity` | Scenario does not define an autonomous vehicle under test ('ego' vehicle). |
| `M8506` | error | `negative-speed-target` | Speed action '<actionName>' specifies negative target velocity '<speed>' m/s. |
| `M8507` | warning | `excessive-deceleration` | Action demands deceleration '<decel>' m/s² for '<entityName>', exceeding vehicle limit '<limit>' m/s². |
| `M8508` | error | `imminent-collision-initial-state` | Initial positions for '<entityA>' and '<entityB>' violate collision envelope (distance: <value> m). |
| `M8509` | warning | `empty-maneuver-group` | Maneuver group '<groupName>' specifies no actors or no maneuvers. |
| `M8510` | error | `invalid-condition-delay` | Trigger condition '<condName>' specifies negative activation delay '<delay>' s. |

---

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Inspect entities, maneuvers, and triggers in an OpenSCENARIO file
msx openscenario inspect HighwayCutIn.xosc

# Run pre-flight linting and trigger feasibility checks
msx openscenario lint HighwayCutIn.xosc

# Simulate scenario execution and evaluate TTC / RSS safety margins
msx openscenario simulate HighwayCutIn.xosc --duration=10.0

# Lower scenario kinematic equations to ModelScript linear DAE arena
msx openscenario to-dae HighwayCutIn.xosc

# Project into Modelica 3.x vehicle kinematics model
msx openscenario to-modelica HighwayCutIn.xosc -o ScenarioSimulation.mo
```

# GENSYS Railway Dynamics (`.calc`, `.sub`, `.geom`, `.trax`, `.wheel`)

ModelScript provides native support for **GENSYS**, the world standard railway vehicle dynamics, track-vehicle interaction, and vehicle running safety simulation environment.

---

## Capabilities

- **Command Deck Parsing**: Full support for `.calc`, `.run`, and `.sub` structured card records defining rigid car bodies, bogies, wheelsets, and primary/secondary spring-damper couplings.
- **Track Geometry & Irregularities**: Ingests `.geom` and `.trax` files with longitudinal distance, horizontal/vertical irregularities, cant (crosslevel), and curvature $1/R$.
- **Kalker FASTSIM & Polach Contact Mechanics**: Discretizes rolling contact ellipses into elastic/slip zones to compute tangential creep forces ($F_x$, $F_y$) and spin moment ($M_z$) with non-linear saturation.
- **WebAssembly Contact Mechanics Kernel**:
  - High-performance AssemblyScript linear memory kernel (`contact.wasm`) executing Kalker FASTSIM 8-slice strip integration and Polach creep mechanics.
  - High-throughput multi-axle batched contact patch solvers (`batchFastsim`, `batchPolach`).
- **EN 14363 / UIC 518 Vehicle Acceptance**: Automated safety evaluation of the derailment quotient ($Y/Q \le 0.8$) and Prud'homme lateral track shifting force limits.
- **Ride Comfort & Equivalent Conicity**: Evaluates Sperling ride index ($W_z$) and wheel-rail equivalent conicity ($\lambda$).
- **DAE Lowering & MultiBody Export**: Direct lowering to linear-memory `DAEBuilder` and automated projection to standard `Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody` components.
- **FMI 2.0 / 3.0 Co-Simulation FMU Export**: Packages complete vehicle and track dynamics into standalone `.fmu` archives with standardized vehicle states, running safety outputs, and C co-simulation wrapper runtime.
- **Interactive 3D Viewport**: WebGL/Three.js 3D visualization rendering carbody shells, front/rear bogie frames, wheelsets, and primary/secondary spring dampers with orbit controls.

---

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Pre-flight linting of GENSYS vehicle deck
msx gensys lint coach.calc

# Direct DAE simulation in WebAssembly arena with CSV trajectory export
msx gensys simulate coach.calc --stop-time=5.0 --step=0.005 --out=results.csv

# Export vehicle dynamics as an FMI 2.0/3.0 Co-Simulation FMU
msx gensys to-fmu coach.ins --out=PassengerCoach.fmu

# Export to standard Modelica MultiBody model
msx gensys to-modelica coach.calc --out=PassengerCoach.mo

# Verify EN 14363 running safety criteria
msx gensys verify --y-force=28.5 --q-force=82.0 --axle-load=160.0
```

---

## Benchmarks

- **Manchester Benchmark for Railway Vehicle Dynamics** (`languages/gensys/testsuite/ManchesterBenchmark.ins`):
  - Standard passenger coach benchmark (Iwnicki et al.): 32-ton passenger carbody, two 3.2-ton bogie frames, four 1.8-ton wheelsets running at $V = 40\text{ m/s}$ (144 km/h).
  - Validates secondary and primary suspension settling dynamics, 8-patch FASTSIM contact in WASM, and EN 14363 / UIC 518 derailment safety limits.

---

## MCP Tools

AI agents interacting via the ModelScript MCP server have access to:

- `gensys_lint`: Validates body parameters, mass positivity, and suspension couplings.
- `gensys_verify_en14363`: Assesses derailment quotient and lateral track shift limits.
- `gensys_fastsim`: Computes rolling contact tangential creep forces and adhesion saturation.

## Diagnostic Rules

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `G1001` | error | `invalid-body-mass` | Body '<name>' has non-positive mass (<mass> kg). |
| `G1002` | error | `non-positive-inertia` | Body '<name>' has non-positive principal inertia tensor components. |
| `G1003` | error | `dangling-body1-reference` | Coupling '<name>' references unknown body1 '<body1>'. |
| `G1004` | error | `dangling-body2-reference` | Coupling '<name>' references unknown body2 '<body2>'. |
| `G1005` | error | `invalid-track-gauge` | Track specification defines non-positive or unphysical gauge (<gauge> m). |
| `G1006` | warning | `unclosed-rail-profile` | Wheel-rail contact profile '<profileName>' curve has discontinuous slope or is unclosed. |

# SIMPACK Multibody Dynamics (`.spck`, `.sim`, `.mbs`)

ModelScript integrates native support for **SIMPACK** (Dassault Systèmes), the premier high-frequency vibration, kinematic, and spatial multibody dynamics (MBD) simulation system.

---

## Capabilities

- **Modern & Classic Ingestion**:
  - Ingests modern SIMPACK XML models (`.spck`) containing `<body/>`, `<marker/>`, and `<joint/>` tags.
  - Ingests classic ASCII keyword decks (`.sim`, `.mbs`) with `$BODY`, `$MARKER`, and `$JOINT` cards.
- **Grübler-Kutzbach Mobility Analysis**:
  - Calculates mechanism degrees of freedom ($M = 6n - \sum c_i$) in 3D spatial mechanisms.
  - Automatically identifies overconstrained kinematic loops ($M < 0$).
- **WebAssembly Kinematics Kernel**:
  - Zero-allocation AssemblyScript linear memory kernel (`kinematics.wasm`) evaluating 3D Euler/Cardan rotation matrices, Rodrigues rotation, and spatial joint constraint equations (revolute, spherical, prismatic, cylindrical, planar, universal).
  - High-throughput batched transformations and residual evaluations.
- **Closed Kinematic Chains**:
  - Evaluates cut-joint loop closure residual vectors for spatial mechanisms.
- **Direct DAE Lowering**:
  - Lowers 3D translational and rotational kinematic relations directly into `DAEBuilder` in linear WebAssembly memory.
- **FMI 2.0 / 3.0 Co-Simulation FMU Export**:
  - Packages complete multibody assemblies into standalone `.fmu` archives with `modelDescription.xml`, C co-simulation wrappers, and kinematic state telemetry.
- **Interactive 3D Viewport**:
  - WebGL/Three.js 3D visualization rendering rigid bodies, joint couplings, coordinate markers, and spring elements with orbit navigation.
- **Modelica Projection**:
  - Automatically translates SIMPACK mechanisms into standard `Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody` components.

---

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Check structural references and joints
msx simpack lint mechanism.spck

# Analyze degrees of freedom and overconstrained loops
msx simpack mobility mechanism.spck

# Direct DAE simulation in WebAssembly arena with CSV trajectory export
msx simpack simulate suspension.spck --stop-time=5.0 --step=0.005 --out=results.csv

# Export mechanism as an FMI 2.0/3.0 Co-Simulation FMU
msx simpack to-fmu suspension.spck --out=Suspension.fmu

# Export mechanism to standard Modelica MultiBody
msx simpack to-modelica suspension.sim --out=Suspension.mo
```

---

## Benchmarks

- **Automotive Double-Wishbone Suspension** (`languages/simpack/testsuite/DoubleWishbone.spck`):
  - 5 moving bodies (lower control arm, upper control arm, wheel hub, tie rod, chassis mount), 12 markers, 5 spatial joints, and coilover spring-damper strut.
  - Mobility analysis verifies $M = 9$ spatial DOFs (6 free chassis DOFs, 1 vertical jounce DOF, 1 steering DOF, 1 wheel spin DOF).

---

## MCP Tools

AI agents interacting via the ModelScript MCP server have access to:

- `simpack_lint`: Checks marker references, parent bodies, and joint validity.
- `simpack_mobility`: Evaluates Grübler-Kutzbach spatial degrees of freedom and overconstraint status.

## Diagnostic Rules

| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

| `K7002` | error | `dangling-body-reference` | Marker '<markerId>' references unknown parent body '<bodyId>'. |
| `K7003` | error | `unknown-from-marker` | Joint '<jointId>' references unknown from-marker '<marker>'. |
| `K7004` | error | `unknown-to-marker` | Joint '<jointId>' references unknown to-marker '<marker>'. |

# PSCAD & Electromagnetic Transients (`.pscx`, `.pslx`, `.pswx`, `.psmx`, `.psout`, `.cfg`, `.dat`)

The `@modelscript/pscad` language plugin (`languages/pscad`) provides native support for **PSCAD™ / EMTDC™** projects, multi-project workspaces, component libraries, and **IEEE C37.111 COMTRADE** transient waveform recordings. It integrates directly with ModelScript's polyglot `WorkspaceIndex`, the **Dommel Companion-Circuit EMT Solver** (`@modelscript/simulate`), and the **Triple Graph Grammar (TGG)** synchronization engine.

---

## Supported File Formats

| Extension | Format                        | Description                                                                                                           |
| :-------- | :---------------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.pscx`   | PSCAD Case XML                | Schematic canvas, wire segments, bus nodes, RLC/transformer/converter components, T-lines, and EMT runtime settings   |
| `.pslx`   | PSCAD Library XML             | Custom user-defined component definitions, port graphics, parameter forms, and embedded FORTRAN/EMTDC script sections |
| `.pswx`   | PSCAD Workspace XML           | Multi-project workspace manifest indexing `.pscx` cases and `.pslx` libraries via `PscadWorkspaceIndex`               |
| `.psmx`   | PSCAD Consolidated Module XML | Consolidated simulation module metadata, hierarchy mappings, and build outputs                                        |
| `.psout`  | PSCAD V5+ Binary Waveform     | Slotted-page binary waveform container with multi-run traces, channel descriptors, and fast random access             |
| `.cfg`    | IEEE C37.111 Configuration    | COMTRADE station metadata, analog/digital channel definitions, primary/secondary scaling factors, and sampling rates  |
| `.dat`    | IEEE C37.111 Data             | ASCII or 16/32-bit Binary transient waveform time-series samples                                                      |

---

## Architecture & Pipeline

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph Input["PSCAD & COMTRADE Artifacts"]
        PSCX[".pscx / .pslx / .pswx / .psmx"]
        COM[".cfg + .dat (COMTRADE)"]
    end

    subgraph Parser["@modelscript/pscad"]
        GLR["WASM GLR XML Parser"]
        EXT["Schematic & Netlist Extractor"]
        LINT["EMT Semantic Linter (PSCAD001–007)"]
    end

    subgraph Runtime["Compilation & Co-Simulation"]
        PROJ_MO["Modelica Projection (.mo)"]
        PROJ_SSD["SSP Topology Projection (.ssd)"]
        DOMMEL["Dommel Nodal EMT Solver (G·v = i_hist)"]
        BERGERON["Bergeron Traveling-Wave Lines"]
    end

    PSCX --> GLR --> EXT --> LINT
    EXT --> PROJ_MO
    EXT --> PROJ_SSD
    EXT --> DOMMEL
    DOMMEL <--> BERGERON
    COM --> DOMMEL
```

---

## 1. Schematic & Netlist Extraction (`emt-netlist.ts`, `pscx-parser.ts`)

PSCAD `.pscx` files represent schematics visually using a 2D coordinate grid (`User` component instances and orthogonal `Wire` segments) rather than an explicit netlist. `@modelscript/pscad` reconstructs the electrical topology deterministically:

1. **Local `master.pslx` Dynamic Ingestion**: Automatically discovers user-provided licensed `master.pslx` files via `PSCAD_MASTER_LIB_PATH` or workspace roots (`master.pslx`, `.pscad/master.pslx`, `.cache/pscad-corpus/`). When present, component definitions, multi-tab parameter forms, port configurations, and FlyBy documentation are dynamically synthesized into LSP catalogs and UI palettes with zero manual authoring.
2. **Topological Wire Snapping & Junction Synthesis**: Performs geometric point-on-segment intersection across all orthogonal `<Wire>` segments and component pin coordinates. Synthesizes topological junction nodes (`junc_${x}_${y}`) at wire-to-wire T-junctions and crossings, eliminating unattached dangling edges and reaching over 94% wire attachment on complex multi-layer industrial benchmarks.
3. **100% Component Lowering Coverage**: Lowers schematic graphs into a structured `EmtNetlist` with 100% component lowering coverage across industrial benchmarks (e.g. `DC_EMT_compare.pscx` with 1433/1433 lowered components and `DC_EMT_demo.pscx` with 597/597 lowered components):
   - AC/DC Thévenin sources, battery energy storage systems (`battery`), controlled current sources (`src_ccin_1`)
   - 6th-order synchronous machines, 5th-order induction/DFIG wind machines, and wound-rotor induction machines (`wound_rotor`)
   - Distributed-parameter Bergeron traveling-wave lines, lumped $\pi$-sections, and multi-conductor cables
   - Non-linear MOV surge arresters, VSC PWM converters, 6-pulse thyristor bridges, and MMC converter stations
   - 20+ CSMF control transfer-function blocks (`const`, `gain`, `pi_ctlr`, `realpole`, `leadlag`, `limit`, `sum`, `rms3ph`, `abcdq0`) and black-box vendor IBR FMUs.
4. **Workspace Indexing (`PscadWorkspaceIndex`)**: Resolves cross-file references across `.pswx` workspaces, linking custom `<Definition>` blocks in `.pslx` libraries to `<User>` instances in `.pscx` cases.

---

## 2. Pre-Flight Electrical Lint Rules

`@modelscript/pscad` enforces 17 electromagnetic transient modeling best practices before simulation starts, providing 1-click LSP Quick-Fix actions:

### Diagnostics for PSCAD / EMTDC (17 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M6001` | error | `floating-electrical-node` | Electrical node '<nodeName>' is floating with no closed connections. |
| `M6002` | warning | `transformer-winding-mismatch` | Transformer '<xfmrName>' <side> rating (<ratedKv> kV) does not match connected bus base (<busKv> kV). |
| `M6003` | error | `invalid-parameter-bounds` | Component '<elemName>' parameter '<paramName>' = <val> is invalid: <reason>. |
| `M6004` | warning | `weak-grid-warning` | Point of Interconnection '<poiBus>' has low Short-Circuit Ratio (SCR = <value> < 1.5). IBR control stability risks detected. |
| `M6005` | error | `csmf-unresolved-input` | CSMF control block '<blockId>' references unresolved upstream signal block '<missingInputId>'. |
| `M6006` | error | `line-travel-time-underflow` | Transmission line '<lineId>' wave propagation delay (<value> us) is smaller than simulation time step (<value> us). Reduce time step or use a lumped pi-section model. |
| `M6007` | error | `sync-machine-reactance-order` | Synchronous machine '<machineId>' violates physical d-axis reactance hierarchy (Xd=<xd> >= Xd'=<xdPrime> >= Xd''=<xdSub> pu required). |
| `M6008` | warning | `mov-arrester-under-rated` | MOV surge arrester '<arresterId>' reference voltage (<value> kV) is below connected bus '<busName>' nominal phase-to-ground peak voltage (<value> kV), causing continuous thermal conduction. |
| `M6009` | error | `duplicate-component-id` | Duplicate component or bus ID '<id>' declared in schematic module '<modName>'. |
| `M6010` | error | `bus-voltage-conflict` | Conductive net shorts bus '<busA>' (<kvA> kV) directly to bus '<busB>' (<kvB> kV) without an intervening transformer. |
| `M6011` | error | `port-domain-mismatch` | Wire '<wireId>' connects control signal port '<sigPort>' directly to 3-phase electrical port '<elecPort>'. |
| `M6012` | error | `csmf-algebraic-loop` | CSMF control blocks form an algebraic loop with no state or delay element: <cycle>. |
| `M6013` | error | `parallel-ideal-sources` | Ideal voltage sources <sourceIds> are connected in parallel at bus '<busName>', making the nodal matrix singular. |
| `M6014` | warning | `parallel-low-impedance-sources` | Voltage sources <sourceIds> are connected in parallel at bus '<busName>' with no declared source impedance; a stiff default impedance is assumed and large circulating currents may result. |
| `M6015` | warning | `limiter-permanently-saturated` | Limiter '<blockId>' is permanently saturated: its input stays within [<inLo>, <inHi>] but its output limits are [<limLo>, <limHi>]. |
| `M6016` | error | `component-check-failed` | Component '<cmpName>' check failed: <reason>. |
| `M6017` | warning | `component-check-warning` | Component '<cmpName>' check warning: <reason>. |

---

## 3. IEEE 2800-2022 & NERC PRC-029-1 Grid-Code Verification

`@modelscript/pscad` includes an automated verification engine for Inverter-Based Resource (IBR) grid interconnection standards (`verifyIeee2800Compliance`):

- **Phasor & Sequence Extraction**: Sliding 1-cycle fundamental DFT computes symmetrical components ($V_0, V_1, V_2, I_0, I_1, I_2$) and synchronous $dq$-frame currents ($I_{1d}, I_{1q}$).
- **Mandatory Clauses**:
  - **Clause 5.3.2 / 7.2.2.3**: Low/High Voltage Ride-Through (LVRT/HVRT) and Prohibition of Momentary Cessation.
  - **Clause 5.4.1 / 7.2.2.3.5**: Fast Dynamic Reactive Current Response ($T_{90\%} \le 50\text{ ms}$).
  - **Clause 5.4.2 / 7.2.2.1**: Post-Fault Transient Overvoltage Ceiling ($V_{\text{peak}} \le 1.20\text{ pu}$).
  - **Clause 7.2.2.1 / NERC PRC-029-1**: Piecewise Time-Voltage Ride-Through Envelope.
  - **Clause 7.2.2.3.4**: Incremental Positive & Negative-Sequence Reactive Current Droop ($k_1, k_2$).
  - **Clause 7.2.2.3.5**: Post-Fault Active Power Recovery ($\ge 90\%$ within $1.0\text{ s}$).
  - **Clause 7.3.2**: Frequency, RoCoF ($\ge 5\text{ Hz/s}$), and Instantaneous Phase-Angle Jump ($\ge 25^\circ$) Ride-Through.

---

## 4. Polyglot Projections & 15 TGG Synchronization Rules

### Modelica & SSP Projections (`projections/modelica.ts`, `projections/ssp.ts`)

- **`pscadToModelica(doc)`**: Projects a `.pscx` schematic and its reconstructed electrical nodes into standard Modelica models using `Modelica.Electrical.Analog` (`Resistor`, `Inductor`, `Capacitor`, `IdealTransformer`, `SineVoltage`, `OLine`) and `Modelica.Blocks`.
- **`pscadToSsd(doc)`**: Projects multi-subsystem PSCAD networks and T-line decoupled partitions into an **SSP 1.0 `.ssd`** System Structure Description XML document for FMI Co-Simulation.

### Bidirectional TGG Rules

15 bidirectional **Triple Graph Grammar (TGG)** rules synchronize PSCAD models with Modelica and SysML v2:
`PscadProjectToModelicaModel`, `PscadResistorToModelicaResistor`, `PscadInductorToModelicaInductor`, `PscadCapacitorToModelicaCapacitor`, `PscadTLineToModelicaOLine`, `PscadMachineToModelicaMachine`, `PscadConverterToModelicaConverter`, `PscadCsmfToModelicaBlock`, and `PscadComponentToSysmlPart`.

---

## 5. Dommel Companion EMT Solver (`@modelscript/simulate`)

For high-frequency power electronics and transient studies, `@modelscript/simulate` provides a high-performance **Electromagnetic Transient (EMT)** companion solver (`EmtSolver` in `packages/simulate/src/solvers/emt/emt-solver.ts`):

- **Dommel Trapezoidal Companion Models**: Discretizes inductors ($G_L = \frac{\Delta t}{2L}$) and capacitors ($G_C = \frac{2C}{\Delta t}$) into constant nodal conductance matrices $\mathbf{G}\mathbf{v}(t) = \mathbf{i}_{\text{hist}}(t - \Delta t) + \mathbf{i}_{\text{src}}(t)$.
- **Critical Damping Adjustment (CDA)**: Automatically switches from Trapezoidal to Backward Euler for one half-step following any breaker or power-electronic switching event to eliminate artificial numerical chatter.
- **Bergeron Traveling-Wave Lines**: Decouples sub-networks separated by transmission lines of delay $\tau \ge \Delta t$, enabling parallel sub-grid nodal solves.
- **Grounded Simulation Honesty**: Connects passive buses with realistic high-impedance ground conductances ($G = 10^{-5}\text{ S}$) without injecting artificial 230 kV reference sources, ensuring true physical fidelity.

Zero-dependency parser and serializer for IEEE Std C37.111-1999 / 2013 **COMTRADE** files (`.cfg`, `.dat`, `.cff`):

```ts
import { parseComtrade, writeComtrade, EmtSolver } from "@modelscript/pscad";

// Export an EMT simulation directly to IEEE C37.111 (.cfg + .dat)
const { cfg, dat } = writeComtrade({
  stationName: "SUB_230KV",
  recDevId: "MODELSCRIPT_EMT",
  lineFrequency: 60,
  timeTimestamps: result.time,
  analogChannels: [
    { id: "VA_BUS1", unit: "V", values: result.nodeVoltages.get(1)! },
    { id: "IA_LINE1", unit: "A", values: result.branchCurrents.get("BRK1")! },
  ],
});
```

## 7. PSCAD V5+ Binary Waveform Container (`.psout`)

PSCAD V5+ replaces legacy ASCII `.out` files with `.psout`, a high-performance slotted-page binary container format. ModelScript provides complete, zero-dependency read and write support for `.psout` across the CLI, Web IDE, and TypeScript APIs via an in-WASM AssemblyScript codec.

### Slotted-Page Binary Architecture

A `.psout` file is organized into 1024-byte pages:

- **Page 0 (Header)**: Magic version (`0x00010001`), total page count, page size, 128-bit project GUID, creation timestamp, and floating-point verification constants (`-1.0e-30`, `1.0e30`, `1.0e-30`).
- **Page 1 (Run Map)**: Array mapping simulation run indices to their root Call pages.
- **Page 2 (Call Map)**: Links simulation calls to their variable lists and trace descriptors.
- **Pages 3+ (String Table & Trace Descriptors)**: Null-terminated string pool for channel identifiers, units, group names, and trace metadata.
- **Trace Pages**: Slotted 64-bit IEEE 754 floating-point sample pages with forward/backward linked page lists for $O(1)$ sequential streaming and fast random seeking.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    H["Page 0: Header & GUID"] --> RM["Page 1: Run Map"]
    RM --> CM["Page 2: Call Map"]
    CM --> ST["Pages 3+: String Table & Trace Map"]
    ST --> TD["Trace Descriptors (Name, Unit, Min, Max)"]
    TD --> DATA["1024-Byte Data Pages (Float64 Vectors)"]
```

### Programmatic TypeScript API

```ts
import { readPscadPsout, writePscadPsout } from "@modelscript/pscad";

// 1. Reading and inspecting a .psout file
const bytes = new Uint8Array(fs.readFileSync("Cigre.psout"));
const doc = readPscadPsout(bytes);

console.log(`Version: ${doc.header.version}, Pages: ${doc.header.pageCount}`);
console.log(`Created: ${doc.header.createdOn.toISOString()}`);

// Access traces and convert to standard SimulationResult
const run0 = doc.run(0);
for (const [id, trace] of run0.traces) {
  console.log(`Channel ${id}: ${trace.name} [${trace.unit}] (${trace.values.length} samples)`);
}

const simResult = doc.toSimulationResult(0);
console.log(`Time vector length: ${simResult.time.length}`);

// 2. Writing simulation results to .psout
const outBytes = await writePscadPsout(simResult, {
  projectName: "IEEE_39_Bus",
  version: 1,
});
fs.writeFileSync("output.psout", outBytes);
```

### Command-Line Interface (`msx pscad`)

#### 1. Simulation Export to `.psout`

```bash
# Simulate a PSCAD case and export directly to .psout
msx pscad sim models/benchmark.pscx --format=psout --out=results.psout
```

#### 2. Binary Inspection & Format Conversion

```bash
# Print formatted ANSI metadata table and channel telemetry
msx pscad psout results.psout

# Convert .psout to CSV
msx pscad psout results.psout --out=telemetry.csv

# Convert .psout to IEEE C37.111 COMTRADE (.cfg + .dat)
msx pscad psout results.psout --format=comtrade
```

### Web IDE Waveform Studio (`modelscript.psoutViewer`)

When opening any `*.psout` file in the ModelScript Web IDE, the custom editor provides a dark-mode waveform analysis studio:

1. **Multi-Channel Canvas Chart**: High-performance 60 FPS HTML5 canvas rendering with LTTB (Largest-Triangle-Three-Buckets) decimation for multi-million-sample transients.
2. **Dual Measurement Cursors**: Live measurement HUD calculating time difference ($\Delta t$), instantaneous frequency ($f = 1/\Delta t$), amplitude change ($\Delta y$), and rate-of-change ($\text{dy/dt}$ slope).
3. **Channel Palette**: Real-time signal search filter, group filtering, color chips, and visibility toggles.
4. **Quick Export**: One-click toolbar actions to export displayed channels to CSV or IEEE C37.111 COMTRADE.

# PSS/E Transmission Power Flow (`.raw`)

The `@modelscript/psse` language package (`languages/psse`) provides native support for **Siemens PSS®E RAW (`.raw`)** transmission grid power flow base cases (Revisions 30 through 35). It delivers streaming parsing, round-trip serialization, pre-flight topological linting (`P1001`–`P4001`), sparse nodal admittance matrix ($Y_{bus} = G + jB$) assembly, in-engine non-linear AC power flow solving (Newton-Raphson & Fast Decoupled), multi-domain projections to **Modelica** and **PSCAD/EMT**, interactive Single-Line Diagrams (SLD) via AntV X6, and a dual-mode VS Code custom webview editor.

---

## Supported File Specifications

| Revision     | Specification        | Key Structural Features                                                                          |
| :----------- | :------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **PSS/E-30** | Legacy Planning Deck | 6-character bus names, integer area/zone codes, fixed branch thermal rating blocks               |
| **PSS/E-32** | Extended Format      | 12-character alphanumeric bus names, expanded DC line modeling, switched shunt blocks            |
| **PSS/E-33** | Modern Standard      | Canonical 12-character names, multi-section lines, 2-terminal & VSC DC transmission, GIC records |
| **PSS/E-34** | Substation-Oriented  | Node-breaker topologies, explicit substation IDs, multi-terminal DC grids                        |
| **PSS/E-35** | High-Density Matrix  | Extended branch identifiers, expanded transformer winding data, flexible rating vectors          |

## 1. Pre-Flight Electrical Diagnostic Rules

| `P3002` | error | `generator-power-limits-inverted` | Generator '<genId>' at bus <busId> has inverted active power limits: Pmin (<pMin> MW) > Pmax (<pMax> MW). |

| `P4001` | error | `branch-invalid-reactance` | Transmission branch '<ckt>' between bus <fromBus> and <toBus> has zero or negative reactance X = <x> p.u. |
| `P4002` | warning | `branch-base-kv-mismatch` | Branch '<ckt>' connects bus <fromBus> (<fromKv> kV) to bus <toBus> (<toKv> kV) without a transformer. |
| `P4003` | warning | `transformer-tap-out-of-bounds` | Transformer '<ckt>' between bus <fromBus> and <toBus> has off-nominal tap ratio <ratio> outside typical limits [0.7, 1.3]. |

---

## 2. Sparse Nodal Admittance Matrix ($Y_{bus}$)

The network admittance matrix $\mathbf{Y}_{\text{bus}} \in \mathbb{C}^{N \times N}$ is extracted via `extractPowerFlowNetlist()` in `languages/psse/src/netlist/powerflow-netlist.ts`:

### Transmission Lines ($\pi$-Equivalent)

For a branch connecting buses $i$ and $j$ with series impedance $z = r + jx$ and total charging susceptance $b$:
$$y_s = \frac{1}{r + jx} = \frac{r - jx}{r^2 + x^2} = g_s + j b_s$$
$$Y_{ij} = -y_s,\quad Y_{ji} = -y_s$$
$$Y_{ii} \mathrel{+}= y_s + j\frac{b}{2},\quad Y_{jj} \mathrel{+}= y_s + j\frac{b}{2}$$

### Transformers with Complex Tap Ratio

For a transformer with off-nominal turns ratio magnitude $a$ and phase shift $\phi$, the complex tap is $\bar{a} = a e^{j\phi} = a_{\text{re}} + j a_{\text{im}}$:
$$Y_{ii} \mathrel{+}= \frac{y_s}{|\bar{a}|^2},\quad Y_{jj} \mathrel{+}= y_s$$
$$Y_{ij} = -\frac{y_s}{\bar{a}^*},\quad Y_{ji} = -\frac{y_s}{\bar{a}}$$

---

## 3. In-Engine Non-Linear AC Power Flow Solver

`@modelscript/psse` includes an exact, non-linear AC Power Flow engine (`solvePowerFlow()` in `languages/psse/src/solver/ac-powerflow.ts`) supporting both **Newton-Raphson** and **Fast Decoupled Power Flow (FDPF)**:

### Mismatch Formulation

For each bus $i \in \{1, \dots, N\}$ with voltage $\bar{V}_i = V_i e^{j\theta_i}$:
$$P_i(V, \theta) = V_i \sum_{k=1}^N V_k \left( G_{ik} \cos\theta_{ik} + B_{ik} \sin\theta_{ik} \right)$$
$$Q_i(V, \theta) = V_i \sum_{k=1}^N V_k \left( G_{ik} \sin\theta_{ik} - B_{ik} \cos\theta_{ik} \right)$$
where $\theta_{ik} = \theta_i - \theta_k$. Active and reactive mismatches are:
$$\Delta P_i = P_i^{\text{spec}} - P_i(V, \theta),\quad \Delta Q_i = Q_i^{\text{spec}} - Q_i(V, \theta)$$

### Analytical Jacobian & Adaptive Damping

The linearized Newton system at each iteration $k$ is:
$$\begin{bmatrix} \Delta P \\ \Delta Q \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} H & N \\ M & L \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} \Delta \theta \\ \Delta V / V \end{bmatrix}$$

- **$H_{ik} = \frac{\partial P_i}{\partial \theta_k} = V_i V_k (G_{ik} \sin\theta_{ik} - B_{ik} \cos\theta_{ik})$** ($k \ne i$), and $H_{ii} = -Q_i - B_{ii} V_i^2$.
- **$N_{ik} = V_k \frac{\partial P_i}{\partial V_k} = V_i V_k (G_{ik} \cos\theta_{ik} + B_{ik} \sin\theta_{ik})$** ($k \ne i$), and $N_{ii} = P_i + G_{ii} V_i^2$.
- **$M_{ik} = \frac{\partial Q_i}{\partial \theta_k} = -V_i V_k (G_{ik} \cos\theta_{ik} + B_{ik} \sin\theta_{ik})$** ($k \ne i$), and $M_{ii} = P_i - G_{ii} V_i^2$.
- **$L_{ik} = V_k \frac{\partial Q_i}{\partial V_k} = V_i V_k (G_{ik} \sin\theta_{ik} - B_{ik} \cos\theta_{ik})$** ($k \ne i$), and $L_{ii} = Q_i - B_{ii} V_i^2$.

### Generator $Q$-Limit Clamping & PV-to-PQ Switching

When $Q_g > Q_{\max}$ or $Q_g < Q_{\min}$, the generator bus is clamped at its reactive limit and dynamically converted to a PQ bus for remaining iterations, preventing unrealistic voltage regulation.

---

## 4. Multi-Domain Interoperability Projections

### Projection to Modelica (`psseToModelica`)

Projects a `.raw` case into a clean, strongly-typed Modelica physical system model:

- **Buses** mapped to equipotential AC pins.
- **Generators** mapped to sinusoidal voltage sources (`Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Sources.SineVoltage`).
- **Branches** mapped to series R-L models (`Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Basic.Resistor` + `Inductor`).
- **Loads** mapped to constant active and reactive impedance networks.

```modelica
model Ieee14Test
  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Basic.Ground ground;
  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Sources.SineVoltage gen_1_1(V = 106.0, f = 60.0);
  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Basic.Resistor line_1_2_r(R = 0.01938);
  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Basic.Inductor line_1_2_l(L = 0.0001569);
equation
  connect(gen_1_1.n, ground.p);
  connect(gen_1_1.p, line_1_2_r.p);
  connect(line_1_2_r.n, line_1_2_l.p);
end Ieee14Test;
```

### Projection to PSCAD / EMT Netlist (`psseToEmtNetlist`)

Generates multi-bus companion-circuit netlists compatible with ModelScript's Dommel EMT solver (`@modelscript/simulate`) for transient stability and electromagnetic switching studies.

---

## 5. Command-Line Interface (`msx psse`)

ModelScript's CLI provides headless inspection, linting, diagram rendering, and power flow solving:

```bash
# Display summary of buses, generators, loads, branches, and MW totals
msx psse summary case.raw

# Run pre-flight electrical topology and bounds linter
msx psse lint case.raw

# Solve non-linear AC power flow with Newton-Raphson (default)

# Solve with Fast Decoupled algorithm and custom tolerance
msx psse solve case.raw --algorithm=fdpf --tol=1e-5 --max-iter=30

# Export publication-quality Single-Line Diagram SVG
msx psse diagram case.raw --out=grid.svg

# Inspect sparse Ybus non-zero entry metrics
msx psse netlist case.raw
```

## 6. Custom Visual Webview Editor (`modelscript.rawEditor`)

Opening any `.raw` file in the ModelScript IDE or VS Code launches the custom dual-mode editor:

- **Single-Line Diagram View**: Interactive pan/zoom SVG canvas with voltage-tier color coding (345 kV red, 138 kV blue, 69 kV green), power flow overlays, and generator/transformer glyphs.
- **High-Density Tabular Grid**: Live-filterable tables for Buses, Generators, Branches, Transformers, and Loads with search.
- **Overload & Violation Badges**: Automatic highlight of under-voltage ($V < 0.95\text{ pu}$), over-voltage ($V > 1.05\text{ pu}$), and thermal line overloads ($S_{ij} > \text{Rate A}$).
- **Export Toolbar**: Export to SVG diagrams, Modelica `.mo` packages, and PSCAD/EMT netlists.
