# OpenDSS Distribution Grids & DERs (`.dss`)

`@modelscript/opendss` (`languages/opendss`) provides zero-regex parsing, unbalanced multi-phase power flow solving, distributed energy resource (DER) hosting capacity analysis, linear DAE lowering, and Modelica 3.x projection for **EPRI OpenDSS** radial and meshed electrical distribution networks.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension | Format               | Description                                                                                     |
| :-------- | :------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.dss`    | OpenDSS Command Deck | Distribution grid feeders, multi-phase line codes, transformers, distributed PV/wind, and loads |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Multi-Phase Unbalanced AC Power Flow

- Solves unbalanced radial and weakly meshed 3-phase/4-wire distribution networks via the **nodal admittance matrix ($Y_{\text{bus}}$)** formulation and **Forward-Backward Sweep (FBS)**:
  $$I_{\text{inj}}(V) = Y_{\text{bus}} V$$
- Models constant power ($PQ$), constant current ($I$), and constant impedance ($Z$) loads:
  $$I_i(V_i) = \left( \frac{P_i + j Q_i}{V_i} \right)^*$$
- Accurately tracks mutual coupling across multi-conductor overhead lines and underground concentric neutral cables using Carson's equations for earth return path impedance.

### 2. DER Hosting Capacity & Reverse Power Flow

- Models distributed solar photovoltaic (PVSystem) generators, battery energy storage systems (Storage), and wind generators.
- Analyzes thermal line loading limits and voltage regulation limits (ANSI C84.1 Range A: $0.95 \le |V| \le 1.05\text{ p.u.}$):
  $$\Delta V \approx \frac{R P_{\text{DER}} + X Q_{\text{DER}}}{V_0}$$
- Identifies reverse power flow hazards where generation exceeds local demand, pushing power back through substation transformers into the transmission bulk grid ([`@modelscript/psse`](./psse.md)).

### 3. Direct DAE Lowering

- Compiles lines, transformers, and voltage-dependent loads into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` linear memory arena.
- Enables co-simulation between distribution feeders, electromagnetic transients in inverter controllers ([`@modelscript/pscad`](./pscad.md)), and building thermal energy consumption ([`@modelscript/energyplus`](./energyplus.md)).

### 4. Bidirectional Modelica 3.x Projection

- Projects OpenDSS circuits into standard multi-phase Modelica or OpenIPSL electrical network models with acausal electrical pins (`v`, `i`).

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics

The OpenDSS linter verifies electrical connectivity and DER operating envelopes:

### Diagnostics for OpenDSS (10 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M8401` | error | `unconnected-bus-node` | <elemType> '<elemName>' references undefined bus node '<busName>'. |
| `M8402` | error | `phase-count-mismatch` | Element '<elemName>' (<elemPhases> phases) connected to bus '<busName>' with different phase count (<busPhases>). |
| `M8402` | error | `transformer-impedance-zero` | Transformer '<xfmrName>' specifies non-positive leakage reactance (xhl=<xhl>); must be > 0. |
| `M8403` | warning | `load-pf-out-of-range` | Load '<loadName>' specifies power factor (<pf>) outside valid range (0 < \|pf\| <= 1.0). |
| `M8403` | warning | `transformer-voltage-mismatch` | Transformer '<xfmrName>' winding <winding> rated voltage (<value> kV) differs from nominal bus voltage (<value> kV). |
| `M8404` | warning | `reverse-power-hosting-risk` | Total DER generation capacity on feeder '<feederName>' (<value> kW) exceeds upstream transformer thermal rating (<value> kVA). |
| `M8405` | error | `missing-circuit-definition` | OpenDSS script defines circuit elements without declaring a 'New Circuit' voltage source. |
| `M8406` | error | `negative-load-power` | Load '<loadName>' specifies negative active power (<value> kW); use Generator or Storage for net generation. |
| `M8407` | error | `zero-or-negative-line-length` | Line '<lineName>' specifies invalid non-positive length (<len>). |
| `M8408` | error | `missing-line-code` | Line '<lineName>' references undefined LineCode '<codeName>'. |

---

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Inspect distribution buses, lines, transformers, and DER units
msx opendss inspect IEEE13NodeFeeder.dss

# Run pre-flight linting and connectivity verification
msx opendss lint IEEE13NodeFeeder.dss

# Solve multi-phase AC power flow and print bus voltages
msx opendss powerflow IEEE13NodeFeeder.dss

# Lower circuit into ModelScript linear DAE arena
msx opendss to-dae IEEE13NodeFeeder.dss

# Project into Modelica 3.x electrical power model
msx opendss to-modelica IEEE13NodeFeeder.dss -o DistributionFeeder.mo
```

# OLGA Multiphase Flow Assurance

ModelScript provides first-class, polyglot support for **OLGA** (High-Fidelity Dynamic Multiphase Flow Simulation). Engineers can author, simulate, lint, formally verify, and co-simulate multiphase production flowlines, deepwater catenary risers, and slug catchers directly within ModelScript's unified digital thread.

---

## Supported File Formats

| Format                   | Extension         | Description                                                                                                                         |
| :----------------------- | :---------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **OLGA XML GUI Project** | `.opi`, `.xml`    | Complete graphical network model defining wells, pipes, chokes, separator terminals, and operational controllers.                   |
| **Legacy Keyword Deck**  | `.key`, `.genkey` | Standard industrial keyword decks specifying flowpath geometry, branch connections, boundary conditions, and valve schedules.       |
| **PVT Flash Tables**     | `.tab`            | Compositional and black-oil tabular fluid files for bilinear interpolation of fluid densities, gas-liquid ratios, and viscosities.  |
| **Simulation Trends**    | `.tpl`            | High-frequency time-series trend files containing arbitrary multi-axis channel catalogs ($P$, $T$, $\alpha_L$, $Q_L$, $U_G$, etc.). |
| **Spatial Profiles**     | `.ppl`            | Spatial profile snapshots along pipeline coordinate $X$ with multi-variable channels, flow regime decoding, and time scrubbing.     |

---

## 3-Tier Execution Architecture

ModelScript implements a 3-tier operational execution framework, accommodating headless cloud workflows, system-level co-simulation, and ground-truth industrial verification:

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[OLGA Model: .opi / .key] --> B{Execution Mode}
    B -->|Tier 1: In-WASM DAE| C[Native WebAssembly 1D Drift-Flux Solver]
    B -->|Tier 2: Co-Simulation| D[FMI 2.0/3.0 & SSP OlgaCoSimParticipant]
    B -->|Tier 3: Native Engine| E[OLGA Batch Runner & TPL Trajectory Ingestion]
    C --> F[Flow Assurance Limits Verification]
    D --> F
    E --> F
    F --> G[Dual-View SVG Visualizer & SysML v2 Projection]
```

### 1. Tier 1: Native In-WASM Drift-Flux Solver

- **Zero Intermediate Allocations:** Lowers directly into ModelScript's `DAEBuilder` linear memory arena.
- **Transient Hydrodynamics:** Solves staggered-grid mass, momentum, and energy balances coupled with Zuber-Findlay drift-flux gas-liquid slip.
- **Mechanistic Physics:**
  - **Taitel-Dukler (1976) & Barnea (1987) Flow Regime Map**: Exact geometric wetted perimeters ($S_i, S_G, S_L$) and Andritsos-Hanratty wave friction enhancement.
  - **Pal & Rhodes (1989) Emulsion Inversion**: Captures apparent viscosity peaks during water breakthrough ($WC_{\text{inv}} \approx 42\%$).
  - **Lagrangian Slug Tracker**: Propagates discrete moving slug bodies, resolving slug length distributions ($L_{s,\text{mean}}, L_{s,95}$) and riser-base severe cyclic slugging.
  - **Dynamic Pipeline Scraper Pig (`OlgaPig`)**: Solves pig motion ODEs ($M dv/dt = \Delta P \cdot A - F_{\text{friction}} - M g \sin\theta$) and liquid slug sweep volume accumulation.

### 2. Tier 2: FMI 2.0/3.0 & SSP Co-Simulation

Exposes standard FMI input and output ports via `OlgaCoSimParticipant` in `@modelscript/exchange`:

- **Input Ports:** `choke.opening`, `wellhead.mass_rate`, `separator.pressure`, `ambient.temperature`.
- **Output Ports:** `inlet.pressure`, `arrival.temperature`, `arrival.liquid_holdup`, `arrival.liquid_rate`, `slug.surge_volume`, `hydrate.subcooling`, `maop.margin`, `slug.mean_length`, `slug.frequency`, `pig.position`.

### 3. Tier 3: Industrial OLGA Engine Orchestration

Automates invocation of local Schlumberger OLGA executable engines (`olga.exe` / `olga-cli`), dynamically ingesting binary `.tpl` trajectories into ModelScript's data structures for verification.

---

## Command Line Interface (`msx olga`)

ModelScript CLI provides headless subcommands for flowline engineering:

```bash
# Run 1D transient simulation and export trajectory to CSV
msx olga simulate subsea_tieback.opi --duration=3600 --out=trajectory.csv

# Pre-flight flow assurance diagnostic check
msx olga lint deepwater_riser.key

# Verify formal flow assurance limits (MAOP, Hydrate Margin, Slug Catcher Capacity)
msx olga verify flowline.genkey --maop=250 --margin=3.0 --capacity=150.0

# Generate standalone SVG bathymetry elevation profile
msx olga diagram subsea_tieback.opi --view=profile --out=bathymetry.svg

# Convert legacy keyword deck to modern XML or SysML v2 operating procedures
msx olga convert input.key --to=opi --out=project.opi
msx olga convert input.opi --to=sysml2 --out=procedures.sysml
```

## Flow Assurance Verification & Lint Rules

ModelScript includes automated pre-flight linter diagnostics and limit verifications:

### Diagnostics for OLGA (13 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M7001` | error | `cfl-condition-violation` | Simulation timestep maxDt (<maxDt> s) violates convective/acoustic CFL stability limit (<value> s). |
| `M7002` | error | `invalid-pipe-dimensions` | Pipe section '<sectionId>' has invalid geometry: <reason>. |
| `M7003` | error | `missing-boundary-condition` | Flowpath '<flowpath>' has no defined <missing> boundary condition. |
| `M7004` | warning | `steep-elevation-warning` | Pipe section '<sectionId>' has steep inclination (<value>\\xB0), risking hydrodynamic slugging. |
| `M7005` | error | `fully-closed-choke-hazard` | Choke valve '<chokeName>' is fully closed (opening = 0) with no active bypass route. |
| `M7006` | warning | `severe-slugging-hazard` | Severe slugging geometry detected on flowpath '<flowpath>' (seabed dip to steep riser). |
| `M7007` | error | `pig-stuck-hazard` | Pig '<pigName>' required differential pressure (<value> bar) exceeds maximum available (<value> bar). |
| `M7008` | error | `pvt-table-missing-or-invalid` | PVT fluid table validation error: <detail>. |
| `M7009` | warning | `wax-deposition-risk` | Fluid temperature (<value>\\xB0C) on flowpath '<flowpath>' drops below Wax Appearance Temperature (<value>\\xB0C). |
| `M7010` | warning | `sand-erosion-or-dropout-hazard` | Sand transport issue on section '<sectionId>': <reason>. |
| `M7011` | error | `sour-service-metallurgy-violation` | H2S partial pressure (<value> bar) on flowpath '<flowpath>' violates NACE MR0175 material limit (<value> bar). |
| `M7012` | warning | `asphaltene-precipitation-hazard` | Operating pressure (<value> bar) on flowpath '<flowpath>' enters Asphaltene Onset Pressure envelope (<value> bar). |
| `M7013` | error | `heatexchanger-parameter-violation` | Heat exchanger '<hxName>' parameter violation: <detail>. |

## Dual-View SVG Visualization

ModelScript renders dual-view vector diagrams for every OLGA network:

1. **Topological P&ID Schematic:** Wells, manifolds, choke valves, flowpath pipes, and topside slug catchers.
2. **Pipeline Elevation Bathymetry $Z(X)$:**
   - High-contrast seabed-to-platform elevation profile.
   - In-situ liquid holdup ($\alpha_L$) segment color heatmaps.
   - Active discrete slug bubbles highlighted along the flowline path.
   - Real-time scraper pig marker displaying traveling velocity and differential drive pressure.
   - Hydrate subcooling margin callout ($T_{\text{fluid}} - T_{\text{hyd}}$).

## SysML v2 Operating Procedure Integration

OLGA models can be formally projected into SysML v2 packages (`@modelscript/olga` $\to$ SysML v2):

```sysml
package Subsea_Tieback_System {
    import ScalarValues::*;

    part def FlowlineAssembly {
        attribute totalLength: Length = 4450.0 [m];
        attribute maopRating: Pressure = 250.0 [bar];
    }

    state def SubseaFlowlineOperatingProcedure {
        entry; then SteadyProduction;

        state SteadyProduction {
            doc /* Continuous production at nominal design rates */
        }
        accept ESD_Trip_Signal then EmergencyShutIn;
        accept Turndown_Command then LowTurndown;

        state EmergencyShutIn {
            doc /* Choke closed; cooldown clock active */
        }
        accept Depressurize_Command when wallTemperature > 18.0 [degC] then ControlledBlowdown;
        accept Cooldown_Timeout when shutInDurationHours >= 8.0 [hr] then ChemicalInhibitionFlushing;

        state ControlledBlowdown;
        state ChemicalInhibitionFlushing;
    }
}
```

## State Checkpointing & Zero-Discontinuity Warm Restart

Long-duration or multi-stage pipeline flow assurance operations can be snapshot to disk and resumed with zero trajectory discontinuity:

```bash
# Snapshot simulation state at completion
msx olga simulate subsea_tieback.opi --duration=3600 --checkpoint-out=t3600.rst

# Resume simulation from t=3600s
msx olga simulate subsea_tieback.opi --duration=7200 --restart=t3600.rst --out=second_stage.csv
```

The `.rst` snapshot encapsulates complete distributed states across the spatial grid:

- Cell pressure $P$, temperature $T$, phase holdups ($\alpha_L, \alpha_G$), and velocities ($u_L, u_G$)
- Active Lagrangian slug states (tail/front positions, slug lengths, propagation velocities)
- Scraper pig position, speed, and accumulated swept liquid volume
- Machinery operating states and closed-loop controller integral accumulators

## Autonomous Field History Matching & Parameter Calibration

Calibrate flowline simulation models to match production SCADA telemetry and test separator observations using bounded Nelder-Mead simplex optimization:

```bash
msx olga tune subsea_tieback.opi field_telemetry.csv \
  --tune=roughness,choke-cd,heat-transfer \
  --max-evals=150 \
  --out=calibrated_model.opi \
  --report=tuning_report.md
```

The optimizer automatically estimates:

- Effective pipe hydraulic roughness ($\epsilon$)
- Overall ambient heat transfer coefficient ($U_{\text{ambient}}$)
- Choke discharge coefficients ($C_d$)
- Well productivity index (PI) / reservoir inflow rates

Outputs comprehensive statistical goodness-of-fit metrics ($R^2$, RMSE in bar and Kelvin) and ready-to-run calibrated `.opi` / `.genkey` models.

## Native In-WASM Cubic Equation of State (PR78 & SRK)

ModelScript includes a native WebAssembly cubic equation of state solver executing directly in linear memory with zero intermediate AST wrapper overhead.

### Governing Thermodynamic Formulations

The general two-parameter cubic EOS takes the form:

$$P = \frac{R T}{v - b} - \frac{a(T)}{v^2 + u b v + w b^2}$$

| EOS Model                     | $u$ | $w$  | $\Omega_a$ | $\Omega_b$ | Temperature Correction $\alpha(T_r, \omega)$                                                    |
| :---------------------------- | :-: | :--: | :--------: | :--------: | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Peng-Robinson (1978)**      | $2$ | $-1$ | $0.45724$  | $0.07780$  | $\left[ 1 + m (1 - \sqrt{T_r}) \right]^2$, with $m = 0.37464 + 1.54226\omega - 0.26992\omega^2$ |
| **Soave-Redlich-Kwong (SRK)** | $1$ | $0$  | $0.42748$  | $0.08664$  | $\left[ 1 + m (1 - \sqrt{T_r}) \right]^2$, with $m = 0.480 + 1.574\omega - 0.176\omega^2$       |

### Van der Waals Mixing Rules with Binary Interaction ($k_{ij}$)

For multicomponent reservoir and hydrocarbon fluids:

$$a = \sum_{i=1}^N \sum_{j=1}^N z_i z_j \sqrt{a_i a_j} (1 - k_{ij}), \quad b = \sum_{i=1}^N z_i b_i$$

### Rachford-Rice Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium (VLE) Flash

Isothermal-isobaric flash equilibrium is determined by solving the objective function for vapor fraction $\beta = V/F$:

$$\sum_{i=1}^N \frac{z_i (K_i - 1)}{1 + \beta (K_i - 1)} = 0, \quad \text{where } K_i = \frac{y_i}{x_i} = \frac{\phi_i^L}{\phi_i^V}$$

Accelerated by successive substitution initialized via Wilson's heuristic $K$-value correlations and accelerated by Cardano analytical cubic root solving.

### Dense Fluid Transport Properties

- **Lohrenz-Bray-Clark (LBC) Viscosity:** Computes high-pressure gas and liquid dynamic viscosities from reduced mixture densities $\rho_r = \rho / \rho_c$:
  $$[(\mu - \mu_0)\xi + 10^{-4}]^{1/4} = a_0 + a_1 \rho_r + a_2 \rho_r^2 + a_3 \rho_r^3 + a_4 \rho_r^4$$
- **Macleod-Sugden Parachor Surface Tension:** Evaluates gas-liquid interfacial tension $\sigma$ from parachors $P_i$:
  $$\sigma = \left[ \sum_{i=1}^N P_i \left( x_i \frac{\rho_L}{M_L} - y_i \frac{\rho_G}{M_G} \right) \right]^4$$

### Command Line EOS Flash & Grid Synthesis

```bash
# Evaluate multi-component P-T flash and trace saturation envelope
msx olga flash --comp="C1:0.75,C2:0.10,C3:0.08,nC4:0.04,C7:0.03" \
  --p=55.0 --t=295.15 --model=pr --envelope --out=flash_summary.csv

# Synthesize a 2D tabular PVT file (.tab) for 1D drift-flux simulation
msx olga flash --comp="C1:0.80,C2:0.10,C3:0.06,C7:0.04" \
  --model=srk --out=reservoir_fluid.tab
```

## Active Topside Anti-Slug Closed-Loop Feedback Control

Topside choke throttling stabilizes severe cyclic slugging in deepwater catenary risers by dynamically manipulating backpressure using high-frequency subsea pressure transmitter measurements.

```mermaid
graph LR
    SubseaPT[Subsea PT_inlet] --> Washout[High-Pass Washout Filter: H_w]
    Washout --> Err[Error: e_f = P_sp - P_meas]
    Err --> PI[Gain-Scheduled PI Controller]
    TopsideSurge[Slug Catcher Volume] --> Override[High-Liquid Surge Override]
    PI --> Slew[Slew-Rate Limiter: |dZ/dt| <= R_max]
    Override --> Slew
    Slew --> TopsideChoke[Topside Choke Valve Z]
```

### Mathematical Architecture

1. **Subsea PT Feedback Error:** $e(t) = P_{\text{sp}} - P_{\text{inlet}}(t)$
2. **Washout High-Pass Filter:** Isolates oscillatory slug resonance from slow reservoir depletion:
   $$\tau_w \frac{d e_f}{dt} + e_f = \tau_w \frac{d e}{dt}$$
3. **Gain-Scheduled PI Control:** Compensates for non-linear choke valve flow characteristics:
   $$K_p(Z) = K_{p0} \cdot [1 + \gamma (1 - Z)]$$
   $$Z(t) = Z_{\text{baseline}} + K_p(Z) \left[ e_f(t) + \frac{1}{\tau_i} \int_0^t e_f(\tau) d\tau \right]$$
4. **Physical Actuator Slew-Rate Constraints:** Clamps valve motion rate to realistic hydraulic actuator speeds:
   $$\left| \frac{dZ}{dt} \right| \le R_{\max} \quad (\text{e.g. } 5\% / \text{s})$$
5. **Slug Catcher Surge Override:** Emergency high-liquid override closes choke if topside separator approaches liquid carryover capacity ($V_{\text{surge}} > 0.8 V_{\text{cap}}$).

### CLI Anti-Slug Simulation

```bash
msx olga simulate subsea_catenary_riser.opi \
  --duration=3600 \
  --anti-slug \
  --slug-setpoint=52.0 \
  --slug-kp=1.5e-6 \
  --slug-ti=30.0 \
  --slug-washout=20.0 \
  --slug-choke=0.50 \
  --out=stabilized_trajectory.csv
```

## Coupled Multi-Branch Gathering Network Transient Solver

Simultaneously models converging multi-well subsea gathering manifolds, shared export lines, and platform separators with dynamic acoustic relaxation:

```mermaid
graph LR
    Well1[Wellbore 1 / IPR] --> Flowline1[Flowpath 1: Seabed Tieback]
    Well2[Wellbore 2 / IPR] --> Flowline2[Flowpath 2: Seabed Tieback]
    Flowline1 --> Manifold((Subsea Manifold Accumulator: V_J))
    Flowline2 --> Manifold
    Manifold --> ExportRiser[Export Riser Line]
    ExportRiser --> TopsideSep[Topside Facility Separator]
```

### Governing Manifold Dynamic Balances

1. **Dynamic Junction Mass Continuity:**
   $$V_J \frac{d(\rho_L \alpha_L)_J}{dt} = \sum_{\text{in}} \dot{m}_{L,\text{in}} - \sum_{\text{out}} \dot{m}_{L,\text{out}}$$
   $$V_J \frac{d(\rho_G \alpha_G)_J}{dt} = \sum_{\text{in}} \dot{m}_{G,\text{in}} - \sum_{\text{out}} \dot{m}_{G,\text{out}}$$
2. **Mixture Thermal Energy Accumulation:**
   $$\frac{d(m u)_J}{dt} = \sum_{\text{in}} (\dot{m}_{\text{in}} h_{\text{in}}) - \sum_{\text{out}} (\dot{m}_{\text{out}} h_J)$$
3. **Acoustic Pressure Relaxation:**
   $$\frac{dP_J}{dt} = \frac{c_m^2}{V_J} \left( \sum \dot{m}_{\text{in}} - \sum \dot{m}_{\text{out}} \right)$$

### Well Trip & Flowline Shut-In Redistribution

```bash
# Simulate 2-well gathering network with emergency Well 1 trip at t=20s
msx olga network gathering_manifold.opi \
  --duration=120 \
  --dt=0.5 \
  --junction-vol=8.0 \
  --trip="WELL_1:20" \
  --out=network_transient.csv
```

## Flow Assurance CI/CD Safety Gate & 3D Bathymetry Survey

### Automated Pull Request Safety Gate (`msx olga gate`)

Integrates flow assurance validation directly into automated GitHub Actions / GitLab CI pipelines:

```bash
msx olga gate subsea_tieback.opi \
  --max-surge=85.0 \
  --min-hydrate-margin=3.0 \
  --max-wax="2mm" \
  --max-corrosion="0.1mm/yr" \
  --out-report=audit_gate_report.md
```

Generates a markdown audit report detailing compliance matrices and exits with non-zero status upon constraint violations.

### 3D Seabed Bathymetry Survey Ingestion (`msx olga survey`)

Ingests ROV/multibeam sonar seabed bathymetry CSV survey logs ($Easting, Northing, Depth$) and computes 3D pipeline curvature, span lengths, and dogleg severity:

```bash
msx olga survey bathymetry_survey.csv \
  --diameter=0.254 \
  --roughness=4.5e-5 \
  --out=flowline_model.opi
```

# PipelineStudio (LPS / TGNET & TLNET)

ModelScript provides first-class, polyglot support for **Emerson / Energy Solutions PipelineStudio**, including its dual simulation kernels:

- **TGNET** (_Transient Gas Network_): Compressible gas hydraulics, real-gas equations of state (AGA-8 Detailed Characterization & Peng-Robinson), line pack dynamics, compressor stations, gas heating value tracking, and hydrogen blending.
- **TLNET** (_Transient Liquid Network_): Incompressible/liquid hydraulics, multi-product batch tracking (gasoline/diesel/jet fuel interfaces), transmix dispersion, pump stations, drag-reducing agents (DRA), and water hammer / acoustic surge analysis.

---

## Supported File Formats

| Format                     | Extension      | Description                                                                                                                  |
| :------------------------- | :------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **PipelineStudio Project** | `.lps`, `.xml` | Complete graphical network model defining nodes, pipes, compressor stations, pump stations, regulators, and study scenarios. |
| **TGNET Gas Study**        | `.tgx`, `.psg` | Dedicated compressible gas transmission network studies with gas composition and line pack profiles.                         |
| **TLNET Liquid Study**     | `.tlx`, `.psl` | Dedicated liquid transmission network studies with batch injection schedules and fluid property libraries.                   |
| **Legacy Keyword Decks**   | `.tgn`, `.tln` | Standard industrial keyword decks specifying network geometry, equipment ratings, and boundary conditions.                   |

---

## 3-Tier Execution Architecture

ModelScript implements a 3-tier operational execution framework for pipeline networks:

```mermaid
graph TD
    A["PipelineStudio Model: .lps / .tgx / .tgn"] --> B{Execution Mode}
    B -->|Tier 1: In-WASM DAE| C[Native WebAssembly 1D Gas Euler & Surge Solver]
    B -->|Tier 2: Co-Simulation| D[FMI 3.0 / SSP Gas-Power Sector Coupling]
    B -->|Tier 3: Engine Batch| E[Emerson TGNET / TLNET Orchestration]
    C --> F[Safety Limits & MAOP Verification]
    D --> F
    E --> F
    F --> G[Dual-View SVG Visualizer & SysML v2 Projection]
```

### 1. Tier 1: In-WASM DAE Solvers

- **Zero Intermediate Allocations:** Lowers directly into ModelScript's `DAEBuilder` linear memory arena.
- **High-Accuracy Thermodynamics:**
  - **AGA-8 (ISO 20765-1)**: High-precision calculation of compressibility factor $Z(P, T, \mathbf{y})$, molar density, speed of sound, and Joule-Thomson cooling.
  - **Hydrogen Blending**: Native support for $H_2$ blending in natural gas from 0% to 100%, capturing density drop, speed of sound increases, and compressor power shifts.
  - **Peng-Robinson Cubic EOS**: General flash calculation for heavy hydrocarbons and dense-phase supercritical $CO_2$ pipeline transport.
- **Transient Compressible Gas Dynamics**:
  - Solves 1D staggered-grid continuity and momentum equations:
    $$\frac{\partial P}{\partial t} = -\frac{a^2}{A} \frac{\partial w}{\partial x}$$
    $$\frac{\partial w}{\partial t} = -A \frac{\partial P}{\partial x} - \frac{f w |w|}{2 \rho D A} - \rho g A \sin\theta$$
  - Simulates dynamic line packing, demand drafting, and decompression acoustic waves.
- **Water Hammer & Surge Analysis**:
  - Solves Joukowsky acoustic wave propagation ($\Delta P = \rho a \Delta v$) during rapid emergency shutdown (ESD) valve closures and pump trips.
  - Monitors transient pressure spikes against ASME B31.4 limits ($P \le 1.1 \times \text{MAOP}$) and screens for liquid column separation / cavitation.
- **Multi-Product Liquid Batch Tracking**:
  - Tracks discrete fuel slugs (Diesel, Regular Gasoline, Jet-A) along transmission pipelines.
  - Austin-Palfrey interface mixing length and transmix volume calculation at delivery manifold cut-points.

### 2. Tier 2: Gas-Power Sector Coupling & Co-Simulation

Enables cross-vector energy system co-simulation via FMI 2.0/3.0 and SSP:

- **Coupled with [`@modelscript/psse`](./psse):** Simulates how rapid ramp-up of gas-fired combined-cycle power plants (CCGTs) draws on pipeline line pack, ensuring minimum delivery pressures are sustained during electric grid peaks.
- **Coupled with [`@modelscript/pscad`](./pscad):** Evaluates fast sub-second electrical generator trips and their acoustic pressure waves on pipeline fuel supply manifolds.
- **Power-to-Gas:** Simulates green hydrogen injection from wind/solar electrolyzers into regional gas grids.

### 3. Tier 3: Industrial Engine Orchestration

Automates invocation of local Emerson PipelineStudio CLI engines (`tgnet.exe` / `tlnet.exe`), dynamically ingesting results into ModelScript for unified verification.

---

## Pre-Flight Pipeline Diagnostic Linter

### Diagnostics for PipelineStudio (12 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M8001` | error | `maop-exceeded` | Pipe '<pipeName>' operating pressure (<value> bar) exceeds Maximum Allowable Operating Pressure (<value> bar). |
| `M8002` | error | `compressor-surge-hazard` | Compressor '<compName>' operating flow (<value> m\\xB3/h) is below the aerodynamic surge limit (<value> m\\xB3/h). |
| `M8003` | warning | `compressor-stonewall-limit` | Compressor '<compName>' throughput (<value> m\\xB3/h) approaches sonic choke/stonewall limit (<value> m\\xB3/h). |
| `M8004` | error | `unconnected-pipeline-node` | Node '<nodeName>' is isolated and has no connecting pipes or equipment links. |
| `M8005` | error | `delivery-pressure-deficit` | Delivery node '<nodeName>' is hydraulically unreachable from any supply or storage cavern. |
| `M8006` | warning | `erosional-velocity-hazard` | Gas velocity in pipe '<pipeName>' (<value> m/s) exceeds API RP 14E erosional limit (<value> m/s). |
| `M8007` | error | `liquid-column-separation` | Transient pressure in pipe '<pipeName>' (<value> bar) drops below liquid vapor pressure (<value> bar), risking cavitation. |
| `M8008` | warning | `hydrogen-embrittlement-risk` | Hydrogen blend fraction in pipe '<pipeName>' (<value>%) exceeds 10% on steel without fracture toughness certification. |
| `M8009` | warning | `batch-transmix-excess` | Batch transmix interface on pipe '<pipeName>' exceeds allowable contamination threshold: <detail>. |
| `M8010` | warning | `joule-thomson-freezing` | Joule-Thomson throttling across regulator '<regName>' reduces outlet temperature to <value>\\xB0C, risking ice/hydrate blockage. |
| `M8011` | error | `pump-npsh-deficit` | Pump '<pumpName>' net positive suction head available (<value> m) is below required NPSHr (<value> m). |
| `M8012` | warning | `line-pack-depletion-risk` | Network total line pack is depleting rapidly: <detail>. |

---

## Programmatic Usage

```typescript
import {
  parseLps,
  lintLpsModel,
  SteadyNetworkSolver,
  LinePackEngine,
  GasEulerDaeSolver,
  lpsToSysml2,
  PipelineVerifier,
} from "@modelscript/lps";

// 1. Ingest PipelineStudio XML or ASCII keyword deck
const model = parseLps(sourceText);

// 2. Run Pre-Flight Diagnostic Linter
const diagnostics = lintLpsModel(model);

// 3. Solve Steady-State Network Hydraulics
const steady = SteadyNetworkSolver.solve(model);

// 4. Evaluate Line Pack Storage & Deliverability Reserves
const linePack = LinePackEngine.analyze(model, steady);
console.log(`Total Line Pack: ${(linePack.totalLinePackSm3 / 1e6).toFixed(2)} MMSm3`);
console.log(`Energy Stored: ${linePack.totalEnergyStoredGWh.toFixed(1)} GWh`);

// 5. Verify Formal Safety & MAOP Compliance
const report = PipelineVerifier.verifySteady(model, steady);
console.log("Verification passed:", report.passed);

// 6. Simulate 1D Transient Dynamics
const trajectory = GasEulerDaeSolver.simulate(model, {
  durationSeconds: 7200,
  timeStep: 10,
});

// 7. Generate Formal SysML v2 Architecture
const sysmlCode = lpsToSysml2(model);
```

---

## Advanced Machinery, Thermodynamics & Physical Models

### 1. Multi-Wheel Compressor Maps & Anti-Surge Control

ModelScript supports non-dimensional head-flow parameterization ($\Psi$ vs $\Phi$) for multi-stage centrifugal compressors:

- **Affinity Scaling**: Speed governor modulates $\omega \in [\omega_{\min}, \omega_{\max}]$ to maintain target discharge pressure setpoints.
- **Surge Line & Anti-Surge Recycle Valve**: Parabolic surge locus detection with automatic recycle valve modulation maintaining a minimum $10\%$ safety buffer.
- **Stonewall (Choke)**: Detects maximum volumetric throughput beyond which sonic shock waves restrict further flow.

### 2. Centrifugal Pump Station Curves & NPSH Verification

Centrifugal pipeline booster pumps are modeled via cubic polynomial head $H(Q)$ and hydraulic efficiency $\eta(Q)$ curves with variable frequency drive (VFD) affinity scaling:
$$H(Q, \alpha) = \alpha^2 H_{\text{rated}}(Q / \alpha), \quad \alpha = \omega / \omega_{\text{rated}}$$

- Computes Net Positive Suction Head Available ($NPSHA$) against liquid vapor pressure.
- Triggers diagnostic `M8011` if $NPSHA < NPSHR(Q)$, preventing catastrophic impeller cavitation.

### 3. GERG-2008 Helmholtz Free-Energy EOS (ISO 20765-2)

Implements the multi-fluid Helmholtz free-energy formulation $\alpha(\delta, \tau) = \alpha^0(\delta, \tau) + \alpha^r(\delta, \tau)$ for 21 natural gas components:

- Covers gas, liquid, supercritical dense phase, LNG cryogenic, and hydrogen blending regimes.
- Computes speed of sound $w$, isobaric heat capacity $C_p$, isochoric heat capacity $C_v$, and Joule-Thomson coefficient $\mu_{JT}$.

### 4. Slack Line Open-Channel Gravity Flow in Steep Pipelines

For pipelines traversing mountain passes with steep downward slopes, liquid column separation occurs when pressure drops to liquid vapor pressure ($P \le P_{\text{sat}}$):

- Transitions from pressurized pipe flow to open-channel gravity flow governed by the Manning-Gauckler-Strickler equation ($Q = \frac{1}{n} A R_h^{2/3} S^{1/2}$).
- Tracks dynamic void fraction $\alpha_{\text{void}}(x, t) = 1 - A_{\text{flow}} / A_{\text{pipe}}$ and calculates slack collapse re-pressurization surge spikes upon valley impact.

### 5. 1D Radial Cylindrical Soil Thermal Conduction Mesh

Discretizes the ground surrounding buried transmission pipelines into a 10-layer concentric radial cylindrical finite-difference mesh:

- Solves $\rho_{\text{soil}} c_{\text{soil}} \frac{\partial T}{\partial t} = \frac{1}{r}\frac{\partial}{\partial r}(k_{\text{soil}} r \frac{\partial T}{\partial r})$.
- Captures ground thermal inertia, depth-dependent seasonal phase lag, and pipeline cooldown following emergency station shutdowns.

### 6. Station Supervisory Multi-Variable PID Overrides

SCADA compressor and pump station automation with min/max auctioneering selector gates:

- Arbitrates between discharge pressure control, low-suction override, driver shaft power limits, and flow dispatch.
- Integrates velocity PID controllers with anti-windup tracking, synchronizing inactive integrator loops to prevent reset overshoot during control transfer.

### 7. Hot-Start State Checkpointing (`.sav` / `.rst`)

Zero-copy state snapshot serialization with SHA-256 integrity verification:

- Saves all nodal pressures, pipe mass flows, fluid temperatures, soil thermal layers, and controller integrator states.
- Enables instantaneous resumption of multi-day transient simulations and what-if contingency branching.

---

## Command-Line Interface (`msx lps`)

```bash
# Pre-flight safety linting
msx lps lint network.lps

# Steady-state hydraulics with slack line & soil thermal analysis
msx lps solve network.lps --slack --soil --eos=GERG2008

# Line pack inventory & deliverability buffer
msx lps linepack network.lps

# Transient simulation with hot-start checkpointing
msx lps simulate network.lps --duration=7200 --step=10 --save-checkpoint=state.sav

# Resume simulation from intermediate snapshot
msx lps simulate network.lps --duration=3600 --restart=state.sav

# Export formal SysML v2 architectural model
msx lps sysml network.lps -o network.sysml
```

# Schlumberger ECLIPSE Reservoir Engineering (`.data`, `.dat`, `.inc`)

`@modelscript/eclipse` (`languages/eclipse`) provides zero-regex parsing, multiphase Darcy material balance solving, Peaceman well inflow modeling, linear DAE lowering, and Modelica 3.x projection for **Schlumberger ECLIPSE 100 (Black Oil) & 300 (Compositional)** reservoir simulation decks.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension       | Format               | Description                                                                                     |
| :-------------- | :------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.data`         | ECLIPSE Master Deck  | Structured keyword deck defining grid geometry, rock/fluid properties, and well schedules       |
| `.dat` / `.inc` | ECLIPSE Include File | Modular sub-decks for PVT tables (`PROPS`), well completions (`SCHEDULE`), or permeability maps |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Sectioned Deck Architecture & Table Records

- Parses all standard ECLIPSE keyword sections:
  - **`RUNSPEC`**: Phases (OIL, WATER, GAS, DISGAS), grid dimensions ($N_x \times N_y \times N_z$), unit systems (FIELD, METRIC, LAB).
  - **`GRID`**: Block dimensions (`DX`, `DY`, `DZ`), top depths (`TOPS`), porosity (`PORO`), and directional permeabilities (`PERMX`, `PERMY`, `PERMZ`).
  - **`PROPS`**: Multi-phase relative permeability curves (`SWOF`, `SGOF`) and PVT tables (`PVDO`, `PVTW`, `PVDG`).
  - **`REGIONS`**: Fluid and equilibrium region partitions.
  - **`SOLUTION`**: Initial equilibrium pressure and saturation distributions (`PRESSURE`, `SWAT`, `SOIL`).
  - **`SCHEDULE`**: Well specifications (`WELSPECS`), completion intervals (`COMPDAT`), production controls (`WCONPROD`), and water/gas injection controls (`WCONINJE`).

### 2. Multiphase Darcy Flow & Material Balance Solver

- Computes original hydrocarbons in place:
  - **Stock Tank Oil Initially In Place (STOIIP)**:
    $$\text{STOIIP} = \sum_{k} \frac{V_{b,k} \cdot \phi_k \cdot S_{o,k}}{B_{oi}}$$
  - **Gas Initially In Place (GIIP)**:
    $$\text{GIIP} = \sum_{k} \frac{V_{b,k} \cdot \phi_k \cdot (S_{g,k} + S_{o,k} R_{si})}{B_{gi}}$$
- Evaluates dynamic reservoir depletion using the generalized **Havlena-Odeh material balance equation**:
  $$N_p \left[ B_o + (R_p - R_s) B_g \right] + W_p B_w = N \left[ (B_o - B_{oi}) + (R_{si} - R_s) B_g \right] + m N B_{oi} \left( \frac{B_g}{B_{gi}} - 1 \right) + (1 + m) N B_{oi} \frac{c_w S_{wi} + c_f}{1 - S_{wi}} \Delta P + W_{\text{inj}} B_w$$
- Evaluates well deliverability via the **Peaceman well model**:
  $$q_p = PI \cdot (P_{\text{block}} - P_{\text{bh}}), \quad PI = \frac{2 \pi k h}{\mu B \left( \ln \frac{r_o}{r_w} + s \right)}$$
  where $r_o = 0.28 \frac{\sqrt{(k_y / k_x)^{1/2} \Delta x^2 + (k_x / k_y)^{1/2} \Delta y^2}}{(k_y / k_x)^{1/4} + (k_x / k_y)^{1/4}}$ is Peaceman's equivalent block radius.

### 3. Direct DAE Lowering

- Lowers reservoir grid pore volumes, multi-phase flow equations, and well drawdown constraints into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` linear memory arena.
- Enables co-simulation between subterranean porous media flow and surface transient multiphase gathering pipelines ([`@modelscript/olga`](./olga.md)) and process facilities ([`@modelscript/aspen`](./aspen.md)).

### 4. Bidirectional Modelica 3.x Projection

- Projects reservoir blocks and production wells into `Modelica.Fluid` porous media volumes and source boundaries.

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics

The ECLIPSE validator inspects grid bounds, PVT table monotonicity, and well completions:

### Diagnostics for ECLIPSE (10 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M8701` | error | `missing-reservoir-phases` | RUNSPEC section does not specify any active fluid phases ('OIL', 'WATER', or 'GAS'). |
| `M8702` | error | `invalid-grid-dimensions` | Reservoir grid dimensions must be strictly positive integers (got <nx> x <ny> x <nz>). |
| `M8703` | error | `porosity-out-of-range` | Reservoir porosity (<val>) must be strictly positive and less than 1.0. |
| `M8704` | error | `negative-permeability` | Reservoir permeability '<prop>' (<val> mD) must be strictly positive. |
| `M8705` | error | `non-monotonic-pvt-table` | PVT table '<table>' has non-monotonic pressure progression (<prevP> -> <curP>). |
| `M8706` | error | `dangling-well-completion` | Well completion for '<wellName>' at (<i>,<j>,<k>) exceeds grid boundary (<nx>,<ny>,<nz>). |
| `M8707` | error | `non-monotonic-saturation-table` | Relative permeability table '<table>' has non-monotonic saturation progression (<prevSat> -> <curSat>). |
| `M8708` | error | `undefined-well-reference` | Keyword '<contextKeyword>' references well '<wellName>' not defined in WELSPECS. |
| `M8709` | error | `invalid-well-control-target` | Well '<wellName>' specifies invalid control target for '<mode>' (<val>). |
| `M8710` | error | `negative-formation-volume-factor` | PVT property specifies non-positive formation volume factor B_<phase> (<fvf>). |

# RELAP5 Nuclear Reactor Thermal-Hydraulics (`.i`, `.inp`, `.r5`)

`@modelscript/relap5` (`languages/relap5`) provides high-fidelity 80-column card deck parsing, non-equilibrium two-phase hydrodynamic modeling, 6-group delayed neutron point kinetics solving, DAE lowering, and Modelica 3.x projection for **INL RELAP5-3D** nuclear reactor systems, thermal-hydraulic loops, and safety margin evaluations.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension     | Format                 | Description                                                                                             |
| :------------ | :--------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `.i` / `.inp` | RELAP5 Input Card Deck | Fixed-column card deck specifying hydrodynamic volumes, junctions, heat structures, trips, and kinetics |
| `.r5`         | RELAP5-3D System Deck  | Multi-loop PWR/BWR coolant systems, steam generators, emergency core cooling systems (ECCS)             |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Two-Phase Non-Equilibrium Hydrodynamics

- Employs a full **6-equation two-fluid formulation** with separate mass, momentum, and energy conservation equations for liquid and vapor phases:
  - **Phase Mass Conservation**:
    $$\frac{\partial}{\partial t} (\alpha_k \rho_k) + \frac{1}{A} \frac{\partial}{\partial x} (\alpha_k \rho_k v_k A) = \Gamma_k \quad (k \in \{l, v\})$$
  - **Phase Momentum Conservation**:
    $$\alpha_k \rho_k \frac{\partial v_k}{\partial t} + \alpha_k \rho_k v_k \frac{\partial v_k}{\partial x} = -\alpha_k \frac{\partial P}{\partial x} + \alpha_k \rho_k g \cos \theta - F_{\text{wall},k} - F_{\text{inter},k} + \Gamma_k (v_{ki} - v_k)$$
  - **Phase Energy Conservation**:
    $$\frac{\partial}{\partial t} (\alpha_k \rho_k u_k) + \frac{1}{A} \frac{\partial}{\partial x} (\alpha_k \rho_k u_k v_k A) = -P \left[ \frac{\partial \alpha_k}{\partial t} + \frac{1}{A} \frac{\partial}{\partial x} (\alpha_k v_k A) \right] + Q_{\text{wall},k} + Q_{\text{inter},k} + \Gamma_k h_{ki}$$
- Tracks interphase friction, bubbly/slug/annular flow regime transitions, and subcooled boiling.

### 2. 6-Group Delayed Neutron Point Kinetics & Reactivity Feedback

- Solves the stiff differential equations of reactor core power during transients and reactor SCRAM:
  $$\frac{dP}{dt} = \frac{\rho(t) - \beta}{\Lambda} P(t) + \sum_{i=1}^{6} \lambda_i C_i(t)$$
  $$\frac{dC_i}{dt} = \frac{\beta_i}{\Lambda} P(t) - \lambda_i C_i(t) \quad (i = 1, \dots, 6)$$
  where $P$ is normalized thermal power, $\Lambda$ is prompt neutron generation time, and $\beta = \sum \beta_i$ is delayed neutron fraction.
- Incorporates dynamic physical reactivity feedback:
  $$\rho(t) = \rho_{\text{control}}(t) + \alpha_{\text{Doppler}} \left( \sqrt{T_{\text{fuel}}} - \sqrt{T_{\text{fuel},0}} \right) + \alpha_{\text{density}} (\rho_{\text{mod}} - \rho_{\text{mod},0})$$
  ensuring negative Doppler fuel temperature feedback stabilizes reactor transients.

### 3. Direct DAE Lowering

- Compiles hydrodynamic volumes, inter-volume junctions, and heat structures into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` linear memory arena.
- Enables co-simulation between nuclear primary coolant loops, secondary steam turbine power plants, and electrical generator controls ([`@modelscript/psse`](./psse.md)).

### 4. Bidirectional Modelica 3.x Projection

- Projects RELAP5 primary loops and core volumes into `Modelica.Fluid` two-phase thermal hydraulic circuits and nuclear reactor models.

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics

The RELAP5 parser and validator enforce card syntax, hydrodynamic connectivity, and trip cutset safety:

### Diagnostics for RELAP5-3D (10 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M8601` | error | `dangling-volume-connection` | Junction '<junctionId>' specifies undefined <end>-volume '<volId>'. |
| `M8602` | error | `unclosed-trip-logic-cutset` | Trip logic '<parentTripId>' references undefined child trip ID '<childTripId>'. |
| `M8603` | error | `negative-heat-capacity` | Heat structure '<hsId>' specifies non-positive conductivity (<k> W/m-K) or capacity (<cp> J/m³-K). |
| `M8604` | warning | `sonic-choked-flow-singularity` | Junction '<junctionId>' flagged for critical sonic choked flow transition. |
| `M8605` | error | `missing-kinetics-delayed-groups` | Point kinetics model specifies <count> delayed groups; standard reactor kinetics requires 6 precursor groups. |
| `M8606` | error | `negative-prompt-neutron-lifetime` | Prompt neutron generation time '<lambda>' s must be strictly positive. |
| `M8607` | warning | `adverse-volume-elevation` | Volume '<volId>' elevation change dz (<dz> m) exceeds physical volume length (<length> m). |
| `M8608` | error | `negative-junction-loss-coefficient` | Junction '<junctionId>' specifies negative form loss coefficient (K_forw=<kForw>, K_rev=<kRev>). |
| `M8609` | error | `invalid-time-step-bounds` | Minimum time step (<minDt> s) exceeds maximum time step (<maxDt> s). |

---

## Regulatory Verification & In-WASM Solvers

### 1. DNV-OS-E301 & DNV-ST-0119 Compliance

Evaluates line tension safety factors against Minimum Breaking Load (MBL):
$$S_F = \frac{T_{\text{MBL}}}{T_{\text{max}}} \ge 1.67 \quad (\text{Intact Condition})$$
$$S_F = \frac{T_{\text{MBL}}}{T_{\text{max}}} \ge 1.25 \quad (\text{Damaged / Single Line Broken})$$

### 2. Watch Circle & Touchdown Zone Verification

Computes vessel 6-DOF horizontal mean offset ellipse under coupled wind, wave drift, and current loads against allowable excursion limits (typically $\le 8\%$ water depth for intact, $\le 12\%$ for damaged). Checks fairlead declination angles ($\le 75^\circ$) and ensures anchor uplift angle is exactly $0^\circ$ for drag-embedment anchors.

### 3. ASTM E1049 Rainflow Fatigue & Palmgren-Miner Cumulative Damage

Extracts stress/tension reversal cycles using the ASTM E1049-85 four-point rainflow algorithm and computes cumulative fatigue damage using Palmgren-Miner's rule ($D = \text{DFF} \cdot \sum \frac{n_i}{N_i}$) against DNV-OS-E301 S-N curves for studless chain, stud link, spiral strand wire, and polyester ropes.

### 4. Cummins 6-DOF Dynamics with Rational State-Space Radiation

Replaces the integro-differential retardation convolution integral with an $O(p)$ rational linear state-space system ($\dot{z} = A_r z + B_r \dot{x}$, $\mu = C_r z + D_r \dot{x}$), converting the frequency-dependent memory terms into continuous 1st-order ODEs lowered directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` in linear WebAssembly memory.

---

## Headless CLI Operations (`msx sima`)

```bash
# Lint a SIMO / RIFLEX card deck or .sima XML archive

# Evaluate DNV-OS-E301 line tension safety factors against MBL
msx sima verify cases/OC4_Semi.inp --consequence-class=2

# Inspect floater watch circle, horizontal excursion, and touchdown clearances
msx sima offset cases/OC4_Semi.inp

# Inspect model summary (vessels, fairleads, lines, waves, wind)

# Synthesize acausal Modelica 6-DOF physical floater model
msx sima to-modelica cases/OC4_Semi.inp --out=OC4_Platform.mo

# Export multi-FMU SystemStructure.ssd co-simulation manifest
msx sima to-ssp cases/OC4_Semi.inp --out=SystemStructure.ssd

# Export formal SysML v2 architectural parts, ports, and DNV requirements
msx sima to-sysml2 cases/OC4_Semi.inp --out=OC4_Semi.sysml
```

# SPICE Electronics & Analog Circuit Simulation

ModelScript features high-performance native support for **SPICE** (`.cir`, `.sp`, `.net`, `.lib`) netlists and analog circuit analysis. Engineers can validate electrical schematics, detect topological faults (floating nodes, voltage source loops), execute pure in-WASM circuit simulations, and export to Modelica or ECAD netlist graphs.

---

## Capabilities & Supported Formats

| Format                  | Extension             | Description                                                                                                                                                                     |
| :---------------------- | :-------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **SPICE Netlist**       | `.cir`, `.sp`, `.net` | Circuit description specifying passive components (R, L, C), active semiconductors (diode, BJT, MOSFET), independent/dependent sources, subcircuits, and simulation directives. |
| **SPICE Model Library** | `.lib`, `.mod`        | Device physics parameters for transistors, diodes, op-amps, and macro-models.                                                                                                   |

### Key Architectural Features

- **Engineering Unit Netlist Parser:**
  - Robust lexer parsing metric prefixes (`f`, `p`, `n`, `u`, `m`, `k`, `meg`, `g`, `t`), curly brace math expressions `{R1 * 2}`, line continuations (`+`), and subcircuit definitions (`.SUBCKT` / `.ENDS`).
  - Lossless round-trip serializer (`serializeSpice()`).
- **Native Numerical Solvers:**
  - **DC Operating Point (`.OP`):** Assembles Modified Nodal Analysis (MNA) matrix $\mathbf{G} \mathbf{v} = \mathbf{i}$ with Newton-Raphson iteration for non-linear PN junctions.
  - **Transient Simulation (`.TRAN`):** Numerical companion-circuit integration supporting Trapezoidal rule with damping for reactive elements ($L, C$).
  - **AC Small-Signal Frequency Sweep (`.AC`):** Complex admittance matrix $\mathbf{Y}(j\omega)$ solving decade/octave/linear frequency sweeps and bode response.
- **Circuit Linter Rules (`M7101`–`M7109`):**
  - Identifies single-connection floating nodes, parallel ideal voltage sources, cutsets of ideal current sources, non-positive passives, and subcircuit pin mismatches.
- **Bilateral Modelica & ECAD Projections:**
  - Translates SPICE netlists to standard `Modelica.Electrical.Analog` components.
  - Projects to generic `NetlistGraph` data structures for PCB layout, schematic capture, and Design Rule Checking (DRC).

---

## Command Line Interface (`msx spice`)

```bash
msx spice <action> [files...] [options]
```

| Action            | Description                                                                        | Key Options                                                                           |
| :---------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **`simulate`**    | Runs DC operating point, transient, or AC analysis (AC sweep from the `.AC` card). | `--analysis op\|tran\|ac`, `--tstep`, `--tstop`, `--format table\|json\|csv`, `--out` |
| **`lint`**        | Runs pre-flight structural and electrical rule checks.                             | `--format`                                                                            |
| **`inspect`**     | Dumps topology, component breakdown, nodes, models, subcircuits, and directives.   | `--format`, `--out`                                                                   |
| **`to-modelica`** | Translates the netlist to Modelica 3.x electrical components and connections.      | `--out`                                                                               |
| **`to-ecad`**     | Projects the netlist to an ECAD netlist graph for PCB routing and DRC.             | `--out`                                                                               |
| **`to-dae`**      | Lowers the netlist directly into the linear-memory DAE arena.                      | `--format`, `--out`                                                                   |
| **`diagram`**     | Renders the circuit schematic to SVG or a JSON graph.                              | `--format`, `--out`                                                                   |
| **`sync`**        | Synchronizes tuned parameters and topology from Modelica back into the netlist.    | `--from-modelica`, `--strategy`, `--out`                                              |

### Examples

```bash
# Calculate DC bias voltages on all circuit nodes
msx spice simulate LowPassFilter.cir --analysis op

# Simulate transient step response and export trajectory
msx spice simulate PowerSupply.cir --analysis tran --tstep 1e-6 --tstop 0.01 --out transient.csv

# Run the AC frequency response defined by the netlist's .AC directive
msx spice simulate AudioAmplifier.sp --analysis ac --format csv --out bode.csv

# Lint netlist for floating electrical nodes and ground connectivity
msx spice lint SensorFrontEnd.net
```

---

## Electrical Linters & Diagnostic Rules

### Diagnostics for SPICE (10 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M7101` | error | `spice-floating-node` | Floating node '<nodeName>' has no DC reference path to ground. |
| `M7102` | error | `spice-voltage-loop` | Voltage source '<vName>' forms a closed loop of ideal voltage sources without series resistance. |
| `M7103` | error | `spice-current-cutset` | Node '<nodeName>' is connected strictly to ideal current sources (current cutset). |
| `M7104` | error | `spice-unresolved-subcircuit` | Subcircuit '<subName>' is referenced by '<compName>' but not defined. |
| `M7105` | error | `spice-invalid-passive-value` | Passive component '<compName>' has invalid non-positive value <val>. |
| `M7106` | error | `spice-timestep-violation` | Transient analysis directive specifies invalid timestep '<tstep>' or stop time '<tstop>'. |
| `M7107` | error | `spice-duplicate-device` | Duplicate component name '<compName>' detected in circuit scope. |
| `M7108` | error | `spice-missing-model` | Active device '<compName>' references undefined model '<modelName>'. |
| `M7109` | error | `spice-pin-count-mismatch` | Subcircuit instance '<compName>' connects <nodeCount> pins but definition '<subName>' expects <portCount> ports. |
| `M7110` | warning | `spice-malformed-directive` | Malformed or unsupported directive '<dirName>'. |

# Verilog-A & Verilog-AMS Compact Modeling (`.va`, `.vams`)

`@modelscript/verilog-a` (`languages/verilog-a`) provides compiler, analog behavioral simulation, continuous DAE lowering, and SPICE netlist export for the **IEEE 1857 Verilog-A** and **Verilog-AMS** analog compact modeling language.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension | Standard / Format             | Description                                                     |
| :-------- | :---------------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.va`     | **IEEE 1857 / OVI Verilog-A** | Continuous-time analog behavioral hardware description language |
| `.vams`   | **Accellera Verilog-AMS**     | Mixed-signal analog/digital compact device modeling             |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Analog Behavioral Disciplines & Natures

- Native support for physical disciplines and cross-domain nature definitions:
  - **Electrical**: Potential `Voltage` ($V$), Flow `Current` ($I$).
  - **Thermal**: Potential `Temperature` ($T$), Flow `Power` ($P$).
  - **Rotational / Mechanical**: Potential `Angle` ($\theta$), Flow `Torque` ($\tau$).
- Supports branch formulation, reference nodes (`ground`), and conservative multi-port Kirchhoff networks.

### 2. Analog Contribution Statements & Dynamic Operators

- Full evaluation of continuous-time analog contribution operators (`<+`):
  $$I(p, n) <+ I_{\text{sat}} \left( \exp\left(\frac{V(p, n)}{n V_t}\right) - 1 \right) + \frac{d}{dt}\left( C_j V(p, n) \right)$$
- **Dynamic Operators**: Time derivative `ddt(x)`, time integration `idt(x)`, transport delay `absdelay(x, td)`, and transition filters.
- **Transistor Compact Models**: Enables high-speed simulation of BSIM, EKV, diode, and custom micro-electro-mechanical (MEMS) behavioral models.

### 3. Direct DAE Lowering

- Lowers continuous behavioral equations, branch relations, and small-signal Jacobians directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` linear memory arena.
- Eliminates intermediate C-code generation or proprietary simulator compiling steps.

### 4. Polyglot Projections

- **Modelica (`verilogAToModelica`)**: Translates Verilog-A modules into acausal `Modelica.Electrical.Analog` component classes.
- **SPICE (`verilogAToSpice`)**: Generates equivalent SPICE subcircuit netlists (`.subckt`) with nonlinear behavioral voltage/current sources (`B`-sources).

---

## Static Analysis & Device Modeling Linter Rules

The Verilog-A linter detects compact modeling bugs and numerical convergence pitfalls:

### Diagnostics for Verilog-A / AMS (10 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M7601` | error | `unassigned-analog-branch` | Electrical port pair '<p>' and '<n>' has no constitutive branch equation in analog block. |
| `M7602` | warning | `discontinuous-derivative-expression` | Discontinuous time-derivative operator '<func>()' used inside conditional branch statement. |
| `M7603` | error | `invalid-parameter-range` | Parameter '<name>' default value <val> violates declared range '<range>'. |
| `M7604` | warning | `unbounded-exponential-growth` | Unbounded exponential function 'exp()' used instead of safe 'limexp()' in '<ctx>'. |
| `M7605` | error | `port-discipline-mismatch` | Port '<port>' has no declared discipline or mismatch with module domain. |
| `M7606` | error | `undefined-node-reference` | Branch access '<branch>' references undeclared node '<node>'. |
| `M7607` | error | `duplicate-module-declaration` | Duplicate module declaration for '<name>'. |
| `M7608` | error | `zero-resistance-branch` | Potential contribution '<branch>' forms an unconstrained ideal short-circuit. |
| `M7609` | warning | `floating-internal-node` | Internal node '<node>' is declared but never referenced in any analog branch equation. |
| `M7610` | warning | `unsupported-analog-primitive` | Unsupported or deprecated analog primitive '<primitive>'. |

---

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Lint a Verilog-A semiconductor device model
msx verilog-a lint MOS_Transistor.va

# Lower analog behavioral equations to ModelScript linear DAE arena
msx verilog-a to-dae MOS_Transistor.va --out=transistor.dae.json

# Project into standard Modelica 3.x acausal analog component
msx verilog-a to-modelica MOS_Transistor.va -o MOS_Transistor.mo

# Export to SPICE subcircuit with nonlinear behavioral sources
msx verilog-a to-spice MOS_Transistor.va -o MOS_Transistor.sub
```

# IBIS Semiconductor Buffer Modeling (`.ibs`)

`@modelscript/ibis` (`languages/ibis`) provides zero-regex parsing, non-linear driver I/V interpolation, dynamic VT ramp synthesis, package parasitics RLC lowering, and Modelica 3.x projection for **ANSI/EIA-656 IBIS 3.2–7.1** input/output buffer information specifications.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension | Format                    | Description                                                                         |
| :-------- | :------------------------ | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.ibs`    | IBIS Device Specification | Behavioral non-linear I/V tables, switching ramps, package parasitics, pin mappings |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Behavioral Non-Linear Driver & Receiver Formulation

- Replaces proprietary transistor-level SPICE netlists with behavioral table lookups that preserve intellectual property while accelerating high-speed digital signal integrity analysis:
  $$I_{\text{out}}(t) = k_u(t) \cdot I_{\text{pullup}}(V_{dd} - V_{\text{out}}) + k_d(t) \cdot I_{\text{pulldown}}(V_{\text{out}}) + I_{\text{gndclamp}}(V_{\text{out}}) + I_{\text{pwrclamp}}(V_{\text{out}} - V_{dd})$$
  where $k_u(t)$ and $k_d(t) \in [0, 1]$ are time-varying switching coefficients derived from the `[Ramp]` and `[Rising/Falling Waveform]` tables:
  $$\frac{dV}{dt} = \frac{V_{\text{swing}}}{t_r}, \quad \frac{dV}{dt} = \frac{V_{\text{swing}}}{t_f}$$
- Implements piecewise-linear monotonic cubic spline interpolation across Min/Typ/Max process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) operating corners.

### 2. Multi-Pin Package Parasitics

- Models chip-to-board interconnect parasitics via lumped RLC matrices and per-pin package values:
  $$V_{\text{pin}} - V_{\text{die}} = R_{\text{pkg}} I_{\text{pin}} + L_{\text{pkg}} \frac{dI_{\text{pin}}}{dt}$$
  $$I_{\text{die}} = I_{\text{pin}} - C_{\text{comp}} \frac{dV_{\text{die}}}{dt} - C_{\text{pkg}} \frac{dV_{\text{pin}}}{dt}$$
  where $C_{\text{comp}}$ is the silicon die capacitance.

### 3. Direct DAE Lowering

- Emits combined package RLC and non-linear buffer DAE equations into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` linear memory arena.
- Enables co-simulation with multi-port S-parameter channel macromodels ([`@modelscript/touchstone`](./touchstone.md)) to assess eye diagrams, timing jitter, and simultaneous switching noise (SSN).

### 4. Bidirectional Modelica 3.x Projection

- Projects IBIS buffers into `Modelica.Electrical.Analog` non-linear controlled current sources and package RLC networks.

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics

The IBIS validator enforces monotonic I/V behavior and physical bounds:

### Diagnostics for IBIS (9 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M8303` | warning | `non-monotonic-iv-curve` | IBIS model '<modelName>' contains non-monotonic slope in '<tableType>' table between <value>V and <value>V. |
| `M8305` | error | `missing-pin-model-binding` | Component pin '<pinName>' references undefined model '<modelName>'. |
| `M8316` | error | `missing-component-pins` | Component '<compName>' declaration has no defined pins in '[Pin]' section. |
| `M8317` | error | `invalid-voltage-range` | IBIS model '<modelName>' has invalid [Voltage Range]: min (<value>V) is greater than max (<value>V). |
| `M8318` | warning | `clamping-diode-divergence` | Model '<modelName>' clamp table '<clampType>' diverges to excessive current (<value>A). |
| `M8319` | error | `missing-pullup-pulldown` | Driver model '<modelName>' of type '<modelType>' is missing both I/V tables ([Pullup]/[Pulldown]) and [Ramp] slew rates. |
| `M8320` | error | `negative-die-capacitance` | IBIS model '<modelName>' specifies non-positive die capacitance C_comp '<val>'. |
| `M8321` | error | `negative-package-parasitic` | Component '<compName>' package parasitic '<param>' has non-positive value '<val>'. |
| `M8322` | error | `no-models-defined` | IBIS file contains no buffer [Model] definitions. |

---

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Inspect pins, models, and package parasitics in an IBIS file
msx ibis inspect Ddr4Driver.ibs

# Run pre-flight linting and table monotonicity checks
msx ibis lint Ddr4Driver.ibs

# Evaluate driver dynamic currents and output resistance
msx ibis eval Ddr4Driver.ibs

# Lower buffer and package equations to ModelScript linear DAE arena
msx ibis to-dae Ddr4Driver.ibs

# Project into Modelica 3.x electrical analog component
msx ibis to-modelica Ddr4Driver.ibs -o Ddr4Buffer.mo
```

# Touchstone RF & Signal Integrity (`.sNp`, `.ts`)

`@modelscript/touchstone` (`languages/touchstone`) provides high-performance zero-regex parsing, Vector Fitting rational macromodeling, Hamiltonian passivity enforcement, linear DAE lowering, and Modelica 3.x projection for **Touchstone 1.0 & 2.0** multi-port RF, microwave, and high-speed digital interconnect decks.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension              | Format             | Description                                                                                                   |
| :--------------------- | :----------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `.s1p`                 | 1-Port Network     | Reflection coefficient ($S_{11}$) for antennas, terminations, and single-ended loads                          |
| `.s2p`                 | 2-Port Network     | Transmission ($S_{21}, S_{12}$) and reflection ($S_{11}, S_{22}$) for filters, amplifiers, transmission lines |
| `.s3p`, `.s4p`, `.sNp` | Multi-Port Network | Multi-pin connectors, differential transmission lines, crosstalk matrices                                     |
| `.ts`                  | Touchstone 2.0     | Advanced multi-port specification with mixed-mode S-parameters and per-port reference impedances              |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Multi-Format Parameter Formats

- Parses multi-port frequency grids with automatic unit conversion (Hz, kHz, MHz, GHz) and parameter types:
  - **S-Parameters** (Scattering matrix)
  - **Y-Parameters** (Admittance matrix)
  - **Z-Parameters** (Impedance matrix)
  - **H / G Parameters** (Hybrid matrices)
- Supports all standard data formats:
  - **DB**: Magnitude in decibels ($20 \log_{10} |S|$), phase in degrees ($\angle S$)
  - **MA**: Linear magnitude ($|S|$), phase in degrees ($\angle S$)
  - **RI**: Real and imaginary components ($\text{Re}(S) + j \text{Im}(S)$)
- Enforces strict Touchstone matrix ordering conventions (e.g., $S_{21}, S_{12}$ transpose ordering for 2-port networks).

### 2. Vector Fitting & Rational Macromodeling

- Converts discrete frequency-domain tabulated measurements into continuous-time rational transfer functions via **Vector Fitting**:
  $$S_{ij}(s) \approx \sum_{m=1}^{P} \frac{r_m}{s - p_m} + d + s \cdot e$$
  where $p_m$ are complex conjugate pole pairs in the open left half-plane ($\text{Re}(p_m) < 0$), ensuring stability.
- Synthesizes a state-space realization:
  $$\dot{x}(t) = A x(t) + B u(t), \quad y(t) = C x(t) + D u(t)$$
  which lowers directly into ODE time-domain solvers without inverse FFT convolution lag.

### 3. Passivity Verification & Hamiltonian Matrix

- Verifies that the $N$-port network does not generate net energy across all frequencies:
  $$\|S(j\omega)\|_2 \le 1 \quad \forall \omega \in [0, \infty)$$
- Computes the eigenvalues of the **Hamiltonian matrix**:
  $$H = \begin{bmatrix} A + B (I - D^T D)^{-1} D^T C & B (I - D^T D)^{-1} B^T \\ -C^T (I - D D^T)^{-1} C & -(A + B (I - D^T D)^{-1} D^T C)^T \end{bmatrix}$$
  where purely imaginary eigenvalues identify exact passivity violation frequency crossover points.

### 4. Direct DAE Lowering & Modelica Projection

- Lowers state-space companion matrices directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` SoA linear memory arena.
- Projects multiport networks into `Modelica.Electrical.Analog` pin networks for joint electro-mechanical and power electronic simulations ([`@modelscript/spice`](./spice.md)).

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics

The Touchstone linter checks physical validity and numerical stability:

### Diagnostics for Touchstone (10 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M8301` | error | `passivity-violation` | N-port scattering matrix violates passivity criterion (spectral norm <norm> > 1.0) at frequency <freq>. |
| `M8302` | error | `causality-violation` | Kramers-Kronig causality relation violated across frequency sweep: '<detail>'. |
| `M8304` | error | `frequency-grid-non-monotonic` | Frequency grid is not monotonically increasing: step from <prevFreq> to <currFreq> is non-increasing. |
| `M8306` | warning | `missing-option-line` | Missing '#' option line; defaulting to '# GHz S MA R 50'. |
| `M8307` | error | `invalid-parameter-format` | Invalid Touchstone parameter token or format '<token>'. |
| `M8308` | error | `incomplete-matrix-data` | Incomplete N-port matrix row: expected <expected> values, received <received>. |
| `M8309` | error | `negative-reference-resistance` | Reference resistance '<r>' must be strictly positive. |
| `M8310` | warning | `asymmetric-reciprocal-network` | Asymmetry in reciprocal S-parameter network: \|S<i><j> - S<j><i>\| = <diff> exceeds threshold. |
| `M8311` | error | `no-frequency-points` | Touchstone file contains no valid frequency parameter points. |
| `M8312` | error | `duplicate-frequency-point` | Duplicate frequency sample point '<freq>' encountered in sweep. |

---

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Inspect Touchstone port count, frequency range, and impedance
msx touchstone inspect BandpassFilter.s2p

# Run pre-flight linting and validity checks
msx touchstone lint BandpassFilter.s2p

# Verify S-parameter passivity and compute maximum singular value
msx touchstone passivity BandpassFilter.s2p

# Fit rational state-space macromodel via Vector Fitting
msx touchstone fit BandpassFilter.s2p --order=6

# Lower state-space model to ModelScript linear DAE arena
msx touchstone to-dae BandpassFilter.s2p

# Project into Modelica 3.x electrical analog component
msx touchstone to-modelica BandpassFilter.s2p -o FilterModel.mo
```

# URDF & Xacro Robot Kinematics

ModelScript provides first-class support for **URDF** (`.urdf`) and **Xacro** (`.xacro`), the robotics industry and ROS (Robot Operating System) standard for describing kinematic trees, inertial properties, visual geometry, and joint limits of robotic manipulators, humanoids, and autonomous vehicles.

---

## Capabilities & Supported Formats

| Format                               | Extension       | Description                                                                                                                                                       |
| :----------------------------------- | :-------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Unified Robot Description Format** | `.urdf`, `.xml` | XML schema defining kinematic links, joints (revolute, continuous, prismatic, fixed, floating, planar), inertial parameters, collision bounds, and visual meshes. |
| **Xacro Macro Template**             | `.xacro`        | Parametric XML preprocessor adding variables (`<xacro:property>`), mathematical expressions, and reusable macros (`<xacro:macro>`).                               |

### Key Architectural Features

- **Xacro Expansion & Parser:**
  - Robust XML reader with automatic in-memory macro expansion (`<xacro:macro>`) and mathematical expression evaluation before parsing.
  - Generates strongly typed robot AST representation via `parseUrdf()`.
- **Topological Kinematic Tree & Featherstone Algorithms:**
  - Traverses joint-link connectivity starting from the root base link.
  - Implements **Recursive Newton-Euler Algorithm (RNEA)** for inverse dynamics: calculates required joint torques $\boldsymbol{\tau}$ given joint positions $\mathbf{q}$, velocities $\dot{\mathbf{q}}$, and accelerations $\ddot{\mathbf{q}}$.
  - Implements **Articulated-Body Algorithm (ABA)** for forward dynamics: evaluates forward acceleration $\ddot{\mathbf{q}} = \mathbf{M}(\mathbf{q})^{-1} (\boldsymbol{\tau} - \mathbf{C}(\mathbf{q}, \dot{\mathbf{q}}) - \mathbf{g}(\mathbf{q}))$ in $O(N)$ operations.
- **Robotics Linters (`M7501`–`M7508`):**
  - Detects dangling parent/child link references, disconnected kinematic sub-trees, inverted joint limits (`lower > upper`), zero joint axis vectors, missing inertia tags, and non-physical inertia tensors.
- **Multi-Target Projections:**
  - **Modelica MultiBody:** Synthesizes `Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody` robotic arms with joint friction and actuator controllers.
  - **MSC Adams:** Exports Adams `.adm` solver datasets.
  - **SIMPACK:** Generates SIMPACK `.spck` mechanisms.
  - **3D CAD:** Projects robot geometry into CSG primitives and STEP visual meshes.

---

## Command Line Interface (`msx urdf`)

```bash
msx urdf <action> [files...] [options]
```

| Action            | Description                                                                   | Key Options         |
| :---------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------ |
| **`lint`**        | Runs kinematic tree validation, joint limit checks, and inertia verification. | —                   |
| **`rnea`**        | Evaluates inverse dynamics (RNEA) at test joint coordinates.                  | `--gravity`         |
| **`to-modelica`** | Generates standard `Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody` robot system.               | `--out=<file.mo>`   |
| **`to-adams`**    | Projects robot mechanism into MSC Adams `.adm` solver dataset.                | `--out=<file.adm>`  |
| **`to-simpack`**  | Projects robot mechanism into SIMPACK XML `.spck` model.                      | `--out=<file.spck>` |
| **`to-dae`**      | Lowers kinematic state equations directly into `DAEBuilder` arena.            | —                   |

### Examples

```bash
# Evaluate inverse dynamics (RNEA) at test joint coordinates
msx urdf rnea KukaIiwa14.urdf

# Check for inverted joint limits or dangling parent links
msx urdf lint MobileManipulator.urdf

# Convert robot description into standard Modelica 3.x
msx urdf to-modelica PandaArm.urdf --out=PandaArm.mo

# Export to MSC Adams for vehicle-mounted robot simulation
msx urdf to-adams RoverArm.urdf --out=RoverArm.adm
```

---

## Robotics Linters & Diagnostic Rules

### Diagnostics for URDF / Xacro (8 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M7501` | error | `unresolved-parent-link` | Joint '<jointName>' references non-existent parent link '<linkName>'. |
| `M7502` | error | `kinematic-loop` | Closed kinematic chain or duplicate parent detected at link '<linkName>' (URDF requires open tree). |
| `M7503` | error | `invalid-inertia-tensor` | Link '<linkName>' defines non-physical inertia tensor: <reason>. |
| `M7504` | error | `invalid-joint-limits` | Joint '<jointName>' defines invalid limits (lower: <lower> >= upper: <upper>). |
| `M7505` | warning | `missing-mesh-resource` | Visual mesh URI '<uri>' on link '<linkName>' may not resolve at runtime. |
| `M7506` | warning | `massless-link` | Link '<linkName>' has zero mass and no inertial specification. |
| `M7507` | error | `zero-norm-joint-axis` | Joint '<jointName>' defines a zero-norm rotation/translation axis [0, 0, 0]. |
| `M7508` | warning | `continuous-joint-with-limits` | Joint '<jointName>' is declared 'continuous' but specifies upper/lower limits. |

# PLCopen XML & IEC 61131-3 Industrial Automation (`.xml`, `.st`)

`@modelscript/plcopen` (`languages/plcopen`) provides compiler, Virtual PLC cyclic execution, sampled-data DAE lowering, and formal verification for **IEC 61131-3** industrial control software and **PLCopen XML** interchange models.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension          | Standard / Format               | Description                                                                    |
| :----------------- | :------------------------------ | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.xml`, `.plcopen` | **PLCopen XML v2.01 / v2.0**    | XML exchange format for IEC 61131-3 control programs, POUs, and configurations |
| `.st`              | **IEC 61131-3 Structured Text** | Textual structured control language for PLCs and industrial controllers        |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. IEC 61131-3 Program Organization Units (POUs)

- Full support for standard control logic paradigms:
  - **Structured Text (ST)**: Variable declarations, conditionals (`IF-THEN-ELSE`), case selection, loops (`FOR`, `WHILE`), and mathematical expressions.
  - **Function Blocks (FB)**: State-retaining functional blocks including standard timers (`TON`, `TOF`, `TP`), counters (`CTU`, `CTD`, `CTUD`), and bistable multivibrators (`SR`, `RS`).
  - **Functions (FUN)**: Pure stateless mathematical computations.

### 2. High-Speed Deterministic Virtual PLC Engine

- Features a cycle-accurate Virtual PLC execution runtime (`VirtualPlc`):
  - **Sampled Scan Cycle**: Deterministic three-phase execution: input latching $\to$ logic evaluation $\to$ output write.
  - **Configurable Scan Period**: Executes discrete scan rates (e.g., $1\,\text{ms}$, $10\,\text{ms}$, $50\,\text{ms}$) coupled with continuous physical models.

### 3. Direct Sampled-Data DAE Lowering

- Compiles discrete state variables, zero-order holds (ZOH), and timer registers into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` arena.
- Enables closed-loop hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulation of PLC control algorithms coupled with continuous Modelica physics (e.g., thermal plants, robotic actuators, motor drives).

### 4. Polyglot Projections

- **Modelica (`plcopenToModelica`)**: Lowers PLC function blocks into standard synchronous Modelica clocked state machines.
- **SysML v2 (`plcopenToSysML`)**: Maps IEC 61131-3 control architectures to SysML v2 `action def` successions and state machines.

---

## Static Analysis & Safety Linter Rules

### Diagnostics for PLCopen / IEC 61131-3 (10 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M7701` | error | `unassigned-variable-read` | Variable '<name>' is read before being assigned or initialized in POU '<pouName>'. |
| `M7702` | warning | `cyclic-task-overrun` | Computational complexity in task '<taskName>' (<stmtCount> statements) may exceed cycle time '<interval>'. |
| `M7703` | error | `recursive-pou-call` | Recursive invocation of POU '<calleeName>' detected in '<callerName>'. Recursion is prohibited in IEC 61131-3. |
| `M7704` | error | `io-mapping-collision` | Hardware I/O address collision at '<address>': multiple variables ('<var1>', '<var2>') assigned to same output. |
| `M7705` | error | `type-mismatch-assignment` | Type mismatch in assignment to '<varName>': expected '<expectedType>', got '<actualType>'. |
| `M7706` | error | `timer-preset-negative` | Timer preset time '<value>' for '<timerName>' cannot be negative. |
| `M7707` | warning | `unbounded-loop-detected` | Loop in POU '<pouName>' does not have a deterministic bounded termination condition. |
| `M7708` | error | `unknown-pou-type` | Unknown or unresolvable POU or function block type '<typeName>' instantiated in '<instanceName>'. |
| `M7709` | warning | `unreachable-code` | Unreachable code detected after '<stmtKind>' statement in POU '<pouName>'. |
| `M7710` | error | `invalid-task-interval` | Task '<taskName>' specifies invalid or non-positive periodic interval '<interval>'. |

---

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Lint an IEC 61131-3 PLCopen XML project
msx plcopen lint AutomationController.xml

# Run 50 discrete scan cycles (dt = 10ms) through the Virtual PLC engine
msx plcopen run-scan AutomationController.xml --cycles 50 --dt 10

# Lower control logic to DAE arena for closed-loop physics co-simulation
msx plcopen to-dae AutomationController.xml --out=controller.dae.json

# Project into Modelica synchronous clocked state machine components
msx plcopen to-modelica AutomationController.xml -o ControllerBlocks.mo
```
